5.38.43: yatra strī yatra kitavo bālo yatrānuśāsitā,
5.38.44: prayojaneṣu ye saktā na viśeṣeṣu bhārata,
tānahaṁ paṇḍitān manye viśeṣā hi prasaṅginaḥ ॥44॥
5.38.45: yaṁ praśaṁsanti kitavā yaṁ praśaṁsanti cāraṇāḥ,
yaṁ praśaṁsanti bandhakyo na sa jīvati mānavaḥ ॥45॥
5.38.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi prajāgaraparvaṇi viduravākye aṣṭātriṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥38॥
5.39.3: mantramūlabalenānyo yaḥ priyaḥ priya eva saḥ ॥3॥
5.39.4: dveṣyo na sādhurbhavati na medhāvī na paṇḍitaḥ,
priye śubhāni kāryāṇi dveṣye pāpāni caiva ha ॥4॥
5.39.6: na vr̥ddhirbahu mantavyā yā vr̥ddhiḥ kṣayamāvahet,
kṣayo’pi bahu mantavyo yaḥ kṣayo vr̥ddhimāvahet ॥6॥
5.39.7: na sa kṣayo mahārāja yaḥ kṣayo vr̥ddhimāvahet,
kṣayaḥ sa tviha mantavyo yaṁ labdhvā bahu nāśayet ॥7॥
5.39.9: na cotsahe sutaṁ tyaktuṁ yato dharmastato jayaḥ ॥9॥
5.39.12: sadoṣaṁ darśanaṁ yeṣāṁ saṁvāse sumahad bhayam,
arthādāne mahān doṣaḥ pradāne ca mahad bhasam ॥12॥
5.39.13: ye vai bhedanaśīlāstu sakāmā nistrapāḥ śaṭhāḥ,
ye pāpā iti vikhyātāḥ saṁvāse parigarhitāḥ ॥13॥
5.39.15: yā caiva phalanirvr̥ttiḥ sauhr̥de caiva yat sukham,
5.39.17: niśamya nipuṇaṁ buddhyā vidvān dūrād vivarjayet,
5.39.19: kulavr̥ddhiṁ ca rājendra tasmāt sādhu samācara,
5.39.22: evaṁ loke yaśaḥ prāptaṁ bhaviṣyati narādhipa,
vr̥ddhena hi tvayā kāryaṁ putrāṇāṁ tāta śāsanam ॥22॥
5.39.23: mayā cāpi hitaṁ vācyaṁ viddhi māṁ tvaddhitaiṣiṇam,
5.39.24: jñātibhiḥ saha kāryāṇi na virodhaḥ kadācana ॥24॥
5.39.26: suvr̥tto bhava rājendra pāṇḍavān prati mānada,
5.39.27: digdhahastaṁ mr̥ga iva sa enastasya vindati ॥27॥
5.39.28: tān vā hatān sutān vāpi śrutvā tadanucintaya ॥28॥
5.39.29: ādāveva na tat kuryādadhruve jīvite sati ॥29॥
5.39.38: dvārāṇyetāni yo jñātvā saṁvr̥ṇoti sadā nr̥pa,
5.39.41: matyā parīkṣya medhāvī buddhyā sampādya cāsakr̥t,
5.39.46: duṣkulīnaḥ kulīno vā maryādāṁ yo na laṅghayet,
5.39.47: yayościttena vā cittaṁ nibhr̥taṁ nibhr̥tena vā,
sameti prajñayā prajñā tayormaitrī na jīryati ॥47॥
5.39.57: anirvedaḥ śriyo mūlaṁ lābhasya ca śubhasya ca,
5.39.59: arthānarthau samau yasya tasya nityaṁ kṣamā hitā ॥59॥
5.39.60: yat sukhaṁ sevamāno’pi dharmārthābhyāṁ na hīyate,
5.39.66: na sa tasya phalaṁ pretya bhuṅkte’rthasya durāgamāt ॥66॥
5.39.67: udyateṣu ca śastreṣu nāsti sattvavatāṁ bhayam ॥67॥
5.39.68: samīkṣya ca samārambho viddhi mūlaṁ bhavasya tu ॥68॥
5.39.69: tapo balaṁ tāpasānāṁ brahma brahmavidāṁ balam,
5.39.70: aṣṭau tānyavrataghnāni āpo mūlaṁ phalaṁ payaḥ,
5.39.71: na tat parasya sandadhyāt pratikūlaṁ yadātmanaḥ,
5.39.72: jayet kadaryaṁ dānena jayet satyena cānr̥tam ॥72॥
5.39.73: caure kr̥taghne viśvāso na kāryo na ca nāstike ॥73॥
5.39.75: arervā praṇipātena mā sma teṣu manaḥ kr̥thāḥ ॥75॥
5.39.77: adhvā jarā dehavatāṁ parvatānāṁ jalaṁ jarā,
asambhogo jarā strīṇāṁ vākśalyaṁ manaso jarā ॥77॥
5.39.80: suvarṇasya malaṁ rūpyaṁ rūpyasyāpi malaṁ trapu,
jñeyaṁ trapumalaṁ sīsaṁ sīsasyāpi malaṁ malam ॥80॥
5.39.81: na svapnena jayennidrāṁ na kāmena jayet striyaḥ,
nendhanena jayedagniṁ na pānena surāṁ jayet ॥81॥
5.39.82: yasya dānajitaṁ mitraṁ śatravo yudhi nirjitāḥ,
5.39.84: yat pr̥thivyāṁ brīhiyavaṁ hiraṇyaṁ paśavaḥ striyaḥ,
nālamekasya tat sarvamiti paśyan na muhyati ॥84॥
5.39.85: rājan bhūyo bravīmi tvāṁ putreṣu samamācara,
samatā yadi te rājan sveṣu pāṇḍusuteṣu vā ॥85॥
5.39.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi prajāgaraparvaṇi viduravākye ekonacatvāriṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥39॥
5.40.3: anr̥te ca samutkarṣo rājagāmi ca paiśunam,
5.40.5: ālasyaṁ madamohau ca cāpalaṁ goṣṭhireva ca,
ete vai sapta doṣāḥ syuḥ sadā vidyārthināṁ matāḥ ॥5॥
5.40.6: sukhārthinaḥ kuto vidyā nāsti vidyārthinaḥ sukham,
sukhārthī vā tyajed vidyāṁ vidyārthī vā tyajet sukham ॥6॥
5.40.18: agnau prāstaṁ tu puruṣaṁ karmānveti svayaṅkr̥tam,
tasmāt tu puruṣo yatnād dharmaṁ sañcinuyācchanaiḥ ॥18॥
5.40.20: bhayaṁ na cāmutra na ceha te’sti ॥20॥
5.40.24: dhr̥tyā śiśnodaraṁ rakṣet pāṇipādaṁ ca cakṣuṣā,
cakṣuḥśrotre ca manasā mano vācaṁ ca karmaṇā ॥24॥
5.40.30: mamāpi ca matiḥ saumya bhavatyevaṁ yathā’’ttha mām ॥30॥
5.40.31: sā tu buddhiḥ kr̥tāpyevaṁ pāṇḍavān prati me sadā,
5.40.32: diṣṭameva dhruvaṁ manye pauruṣaṁ tu nirarthakam ॥32॥
5.40.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi prajāgaraparvaṇi viduravākye catvāriṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥40॥
5.41.1: anuktaṁ yadi te kiñcid vācā vidura vidyate,
tanme śuśrūṣato brūhi vicitrāṇi hi bhāṣase ॥1॥
5.41.2: dhr̥tarāṣṭra kumāro vai yaḥ purāṇaḥ sanātanaḥ,
5.41.3: sa te guhyan prakāśāṁśca sarvān hr̥dayasaṁśrayān,
5.41.4: kiṁ tvaṁ na veda tad bhūyo yanme brūyāt sanātanaḥ,
tvameva vidura brūhi prajñāśeṣo’sti cet tava ॥4॥
5.41.5: kumārasya tu yā buddhirveda tāṁ śāśvatīmaham ॥5॥
5.41.6: brāhmīṁ hi yonimāpannaḥ suguhyamapi yo vadet,
na tena garhyo devānāṁ tasmādetad bravīmi te ॥6॥
5.41.7: bravīhi vidura tvaṁ me purāṇaṁ taṁ sanātanam,
5.41.8: sa ca taccintitaṁ jñātvā darśayāmāsa bhārata ॥8॥
5.41.10: yo na śakyo mayā vaktuṁ tvamasmai vaktumarhasi ॥10॥
5.41.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi sanatsujātaparvaṇi vidurakr̥tasanatsujātaprārthane ekacatvāriṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥41॥
5.42.3: śr̥ṇu me bruvato rājan yathaitanmā viśaṅkithāḥ ॥3॥
5.42.13: kāmān vyudasya dhunute yat kiñcit puruṣo rajaḥ ॥13॥
5.42.14: muhyanta iva dhāvanti gacchantaḥ śvabhravat sukham ॥14॥
5.42.17: etad vidvān nopaiti kathaṁ nu karma ॥17॥
5.42.21: ya etad vā bhagavān sa nityo
5.42.28: yeṣāṁ dharme ca vispardhā teṣāṁ tajjñānasādhanam,
te brāhmaṇā ito muktāḥ svargaṁ yānti triviṣṭapam ॥28॥
5.42.33: yathā svaṁ vāntamaśnāti śavā vai nityamabhūtaye,
5.42.34: jñātīnāṁ tu vasan madhye taṁ vidurbrāhmaṇaṁ budhāḥ ॥34॥
5.42.37: kiṁ tena na kr̥taṁ pāpaṁ caureṇātmāpahāriṇā ॥37॥
5.42.38: śiṣṭo na śiṣṭavat sa syād brāhmaṇo brahmavit kaviḥ ॥38॥
5.42.39: anāḍhyā mānuṣe vitte āḍhyā daive tathā kratau,
5.42.40: sarvān sviṣṭakr̥to devān vidyād ya iha kaścana,
na samāno brāhmaṇasya tasmin prayatate svayam ॥40॥
5.42.44: na vai mānaṁ ca maunaṁ ca sahitau vasataḥ sadā,
ayaṁ hi loko mānasya asau maunasya tad viduḥ ॥44॥
5.42.45: śrīḥ sukhasyeha saṁvāsaḥ sā cāpi paripanthinī,
5.43.3: r̥co yajūṁṣi yo veda sāmavedaṁ ca veda yaḥ,
pāpāni kurvan pāpena lipyate kiṁ na lipyate ॥3॥
5.43.4: trāyante karmaṇaḥ pāpānna te mithyā bravīmyaham ॥4॥
5.43.6: na ced vedā vinā dharmaṁ trātuṁ śaktā vicakṣaṇa,
5.43.11: sanatsujāta tad brūhi yathā vidyāma tad vayam ॥11॥
5.43.14: kalmaṣaṁ tapaso brūhi śrutaṁ niṣkalmaṣaṁ tapaḥ,
5.43.20: yajñaśca dānaṁ ca dhr̥tiḥ śrutaṁ ca
5.43.23: anr̥taṁ cābhyasūyā ca kāmārthau ca tathā spr̥hā ॥23॥
5.43.24: krodhaḥ śokastathā tr̥ṣṇā lobhaḥ paiśunyameva ca,
5.43.27: tena duḥkhaṁ taratyeva bhinnaṁ tasmin jitaṁ kr̥te ॥27॥
5.43.28: śreyāṁstu ṣaḍvidhastyāgaḥ śriyaṁ prāpya na hr̥ṣyati,
5.43.29: kāmatyāgaśca rājendra sa tr̥tīya iti smr̥taḥ,
apyavācyaṁ vadantyetaṁ sa tr̥tīyo guṇaḥ smr̥taḥ ॥29॥
5.43.30: na ca dravyaistad bhavati nopayuktaiśca kāmataḥ ॥30॥
5.43.31: na ca karmasvasiddheṣu duḥkhaṁ tena ca na glapet,
5.43.32: apriye ca samutpanne vyathāṁ jātu na gacchati,
iṣṭān putrāṁśca dārāṁśca na yāceta kadācana ॥32॥
5.43.34: satyaṁ dhyānaṁ samādhānaṁ codyaṁ vairāgyameva ca,
asteyaṁ brahmacaryaṁ ca tathā saṅgrahameva ca ॥34॥
5.43.36: aṣṭau doṣāḥ pramādasya tān doṣān parivarjayet,
5.43.37: satyātmā bhava rājendra satye lokāḥ pratiṣṭhitāḥ,
5.43.38: etad dhātr̥kr̥taṁ vr̥ttaṁ satyameva satāṁ vratam ॥38॥
5.43.40: yanmāṁ pr̥cchasi rājendra saṅkṣepāt prabravīmi te,
5.43.42: teṣāṁ tu kataraḥ sa syād yamahaṁ veda vai dvijam ॥42॥
5.43.48: jñānaṁ vai nāma pratyakṣaṁ parokṣaṁ jāyate tapaḥ,
vidyād bahu paṭhantaṁ tu dvijaṁ vai bahupāṭhinam ॥48॥
5.43.49: tasmāt kṣatriya mā maṁsthā jalpitenaiva vai dvijam,
ya eva satyānnāpaiti sa jñeyo brāhmaṇastvayā ॥49॥
5.43.52: yo veda vedān na sa veda vedyaṁ
satye sthito yastu sa veda vedyam ॥52॥
5.43.53: yo veda vedaṁ sa ca veda vedyaṁ
yo veda vedyaṁ na sa veda satyam ॥53॥
5.43.54: yo veda vedān sa ca veda vedyaṁ
5.43.57: nāsya paryeṣaṇaṁ gacchet prācīnaṁ nota dakṣiṇam,
5.43.58: avicinvannimaṁ vede tapaḥ paśyati taṁ prabhum ॥58॥
5.43.60: svalakṣaṇaṁ tu yo veda sa muniḥ śreṣṭha ucyate ॥60॥
5.43.62: satye vai brāhmaṇastiṣṭhaṁstad vidvān sarvavid bhavet ॥62॥
5.43.63: vedānāṁ cānupūrvyeṇa etad buddhyā bravīmi te ॥63॥
5.43.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi sanatsujātaparvaṇi sanatsujātavākye tricatvāriṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥43॥
5.44.5: tat kathaṁ brahmacaryaṁ syādetad brahman bravīhi me ॥5॥
5.44.8: śarīrametau kurutaḥ pitā mātā ca bhārata,
ācāryaśāstā yā jātiḥ sā puṇyā sājarāmarā ॥8॥
5.44.12: karmaṇā manasā vācā dvitīyaḥ pāda ucyate ॥12॥
5.44.13: tatyutre ca tathā kurvan dvitīyaḥ pāda ucyate ॥13॥
5.44.22: evaṁ hyete samājñāya tādr̥gbhāvaṁ gatā ime ॥22॥
5.44.27: na cāpi vāyau na ca devatāsu
5.44.30: sā pratiṣṭhā tadamr̥taṁ lokāstad brahma tad yaśaḥ,
bhūtāni jajñire tasmāt pralayaṁ yānti tatra hi ॥30॥
5.44.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi sanatsujātaparvaṇi sanatsujātavākye catuścatvāriṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥44॥
5.45.1: śokaḥ krodhaśca lobhaśca kāmo mānaḥ parāsutā,
īrṣyā moho vidhitsā ca kr̥pāsūyā jugupsutā ॥1॥
5.45.5: dānaṁ śrutaṁ caiva dhr̥tiḥ kṣamā ca
5.45.8: sad vāsad vā parīvādo brāhmaṇasya na śasyate,
narakapratiṣṭhāste vai syurya evaṁ kurvate janāḥ ॥8॥
5.45.11: tasmāt prājño na mādyeta sadā hyetad vigarhitam ॥11॥
5.45.21: vedeṣu cānupūrvyeṇa etad vidvan bravīmi te ॥21॥
5.45.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi sanatsujātaparvaṇi sanatsujātavākye pañcacatvāriṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥45॥
5.46.1: tad vai devā upāsate tasmāt sūryo virājate,
5.46.2: śukrād brahma prabhavati brahma śukreṇa vardhate,
5.46.4: ubhau ca devau pr̥thivīṁ divaṁ ca
5.46.9: te tatra pakṣiṇo bhūtvā prapatanti yathā diśam,
5.46.12: sarvameva tato vidyāt tat tad vaktuṁ na śaknumaḥ,
5.46.13: apānaṁ girati prāṇaḥ prāṇaṁ girati candramāḥ,
5.46.14: taṁ cet santatamūrdhvāya na mr̥tyurnāmr̥taṁ bhavet,
5.46.18: evaṁrūpo mahātmā sa pāvakaṁ puruṣo giran,
yo vai taṁ puruṣaṁ veda tasyehārtho na riṣyate,
5.46.19: yaḥ sahasraṁ sahasrāṇāṁ pakṣān santatya sampatet,
5.46.25: anyatrānyatra yukteṣu kiṁ sa śocet tataḥ param ॥25॥
5.46.28: ahameva smr̥to mātā pitā putro’smyahaṁ punaḥ,
ātmāhamapi sarvasya yacca nāsti yadasti ca ॥28॥
5.46.29: mamaiva yūyāmātmasthā na me yūyaṁ na vo vayam ॥29॥
5.47.1: sārdhaṁ kathayato rājñaḥ sā vyatīyāya śarvarī ॥1॥
5.47.2: tasyāṁ rajanyāṁ vyuṣṭāyāṁ rājānaḥ sarva eva te,
5.47.6: bhīṣmo droṇaḥ kr̥paḥ śalyaḥ kr̥tavarmā jayadrathaḥ,
5.47.7: sarve ca sahitāḥ śūrāḥ pārthivā bharatarṣabha ॥7॥
5.47.10: viviśustāṁ sabhāṁ rājan surāḥ śakrasado yathā,
5.47.11: śuśubhe sā sabhā rājan siṁhairiva girerguhā,
te praviśya maheṣvāsāḥ sabhāṁ sarve mahaujasaḥ ॥11॥
5.47.13: ayaṁ sa ratha āyāti yo’yāsīt pāṇḍavān prati ॥13॥
5.47.14: upeyāya sa tu kṣipraṁ rathāt praskandya kuṇḍalī,
5.47.15: prāpto’smi pāṇḍavān gatvā taṁ vijānīta kauravāḥ,
5.47.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi yānasandhiparvaṇi sañjayapratyāgamane saptacatvāriṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥47॥
5.48.44: idaṁ ca brūyā mā vr̥ṇīṣveti loke
5.48.72: giriṁ ya icchet tu talena bhettuṁ
nna cāpi kiñcit sa girestu kuryāt ॥72॥
5.48.81: na taṁ devāḥ saha śakreṇa śekuḥ
5.48.85: hatvā ca bhaumaṁ narakaṁ muraṁ ca,
5.48.86: dr̥ṣṭvā bhīmaṁ karma kr̥taṁ raṇe tat,
dākāśe cāpsu ca te kramaḥ syāt ॥86॥
5.48.87: śastrāṇi gātre na ca te kramera-
5.48.93: stato dhruvaṁ nāsti kr̥taṁ ca sādhu ॥93॥
5.48.95: na ced bhavet sukr̥taṁ niṣphalaṁ vā,
5.48.96: rna yuddhe vai śeṣa ihāsti kaścit ॥96॥
5.48.97: yad vaḥ kāryaṁ tat kurudhvaṁ yathāsva-
5.48.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi yānasandhiparvaṇi arjunavākyanivedane aṣṭacatvāriṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥48॥
5.49.3: ādityāścaiva sādhyāśca ye ca saptarṣayo divi,
5.49.6: bhavantaṁ nopatiṣṭhete tau naḥ śaṁsa pitāmaha ॥6॥
5.49.7: yāvetau pr̥thivīṁ dyāṁ ca bhāsayantau tapasvinau,
5.49.11: tadā devāsure yuddhe bhaye jāte divaukasām,
5.49.13: tābhyāṁ ca sahitaḥ śakro vijigye daityadānavān ॥13॥
5.49.14: nara indrasya saṅgrāme hatvā śatrūn parantapaḥ,
5.49.20: eṣa nārāyaṇaḥ kr̥ṣṇaḥ phālgunaśca naraḥ smr̥taḥ,
5.49.21: tatra tatraiva jāyete yuddhakāle punaḥ punaḥ ॥21॥
5.49.24: duryodhana tadā tāta smartāsi vacanaṁ mama ॥24॥
5.49.26: na ced grahīṣyase vākyaṁ śrotāsi subahūn hatān,
tavaiva hi mataṁ sarve kuravaḥ paryupāsate ॥26॥
5.49.30: kiṁ cānyanmayi durvr̥ttaṁ yena māṁ parigarhase,
na hi me vr̥jinaṁ kiñcid dhārtarāṣṭrā viduḥ kvacit ॥30॥
5.49.31: ahaṁ hi pāṇḍavān sarvān haniṣyāmi raṇe sthitān ॥31॥
5.49.32: prāgviruddhaiḥ śamaṁ sadbhiḥ kathaṁ vā kriyate punaḥ,
rājño hi dhr̥tarāṣṭrasya sarvaṁ kāryaṁ priyaṁ mayā,
tathā duryodhanasyāpi sa hi rājye samāhitaḥ ॥32॥
5.49.33: karṇasya tu vacaḥ śrutvā bhīṣmaḥ śāntanavaḥ punaḥ,
5.49.40: kva tadā sūtaputro’bhūd ya idānīṁ vr̥ṣāyate ॥40॥
5.49.41: nanu tatrāpi bhīmena pārthena ca mahātmanā,
5.49.43: bhīṣmasya tu vacaḥ śrutvā bhāradvājo mahāmanāḥ,
5.49.45: purā yuddhāt sādhu manye pāṇḍavaiḥ saha saṅgatam,
5.49.46: sarvaṁ tadapi jānāmi kariṣyati ca pāṇḍavaḥ,
na hyasya triṣu lokeṣu sadr̥śo’sti dhanurdharaḥ ॥46॥
5.49.47: tataḥ sa sañjayaṁ rājā paryapr̥cchata pāṇḍavān ॥47॥
5.49.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi yānasandhiparvaṇi bhīṣmadroṇavākye ekonapañcāśattamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥49॥
5.50.1: śrutveha bahulāḥ senāḥ prītyarthaṁ naḥ samāgatāḥ ॥1॥
5.50.3: ke svidenaṁ vārayanti yuddhācchāmyeti vā punaḥ,
5.50.4: yudhiṣṭhirasya bhadraṁ te sa sarvānanuśāsti ca ॥4॥
5.50.17: na hetuvādād dharmātmā satyaṁ jahyāt kadācana ॥17॥
5.50.18: yaḥ pramāṇaṁ mahārāja dharme dharmabhr̥tāṁ varaḥ,
5.50.19: yasya bāhubale tulyaḥ pr̥thivyāṁ nāsti kaścana,
yo vai sarvān mahīpālān vaśe cakre dhanurdharaḥ,
5.50.20: yasya vīryeṇa sahasā catvāro bhuvi pāṇḍavāḥ ॥20॥
5.50.23: yaśca tān saṅgatān sarvān pāṇḍavān vāraṇāvate,
5.50.24: kr̥ṣṇāyāṁ caratā prītiṁ yena krodhavaśā hatāḥ,
5.50.26: ajayad yaḥ purā vīro yudhyamānaṁ purandaram ॥26॥
5.50.28: yaśca sarvān vaśe cakre lokapālān dhanurdharaḥ,
5.50.29: yaḥ pratīcīṁ diśaṁ cakre vaśe mlecchagaṇāyutām,
sa tatra nakulo yoddhā citrayodhī vyavasthitaḥ ॥29॥
5.50.32: aśvatthāmā dhr̥ṣṭaketū rukmī pradyumna eva ca ॥32॥
5.50.33: tena vaḥ sahadevena yuddhaṁ rājan mahātyayam,
5.50.34: tapaścacāra yā ghoraṁ kāśikanyā purā satī,
5.50.35: pāñcālasya sutā jajñe daivācca sa punaḥ pumān,
strīpuṁsoḥ puruṣavyāghra yaḥ sa veda guṇāguṇān ॥35॥
5.50.37: yaṁ yakṣaḥ puruṣaṁ cakre bhīṣmasya nidhanecchayā,
5.50.40: raṇe tena virāṭena bhavitā vaḥ samāgamaḥ ॥40॥
5.50.41: yaḥ sa kāśipatī rājā vārāṇasyāṁ mahārathaḥ,
5.50.50: ete cānye ca bahavaḥ prācyodīcyā mahīkṣitaḥ,
5.50.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi yānasandhiparvaṇi sañjayavākye pañcāśattamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥50॥
5.51.1: sarva ete mahotsāhā ye tvayā parikīrtitāḥ,
ekatastveva te sarve sametā bhīma ekataḥ ॥1॥
5.51.2: bhīmasenāddhi me bhūyo bhayaṁ sañjāyate mahat,
5.51.3: jāgarmi rātrayaḥ sarvā dīrghamuṣṇaṁ ca niḥśvasan,
5.51.4: sainye’smin pratipaśyāmi ya enaṁ viṣahed yudhi ॥4॥
5.51.10: sarveṣāṁ mama putrāṇāṁ sa ekaḥ krūravikramaḥ,
5.51.11: udvepate me hr̥dayaṁ ye me duryodhanādayaḥ,
5.51.12: tasya vīryeṇa saṅkliṣṭā nityameva sutā mama,
5.51.15: atilābhaṁ tu manye’haṁ yat tena ripughātinā ॥15॥
5.51.16: tadaiva na hatāḥ sarve putrā mama manasvinā,
yena bhīmabalā yakṣā rākṣasāśca purā hatāḥ ॥16॥
5.51.17: kathaṁ tasya raṇe vegaṁ mānuṣaḥ prasahiṣyati,
na sa jātu vaśe tasthau mama bālye’pi sañjaya ॥17॥
5.51.18: kiṁ punarmama duṣputraiḥ kliṣṭaḥ samprati pāṇḍavaḥ,
5.51.21: iti bālye śrutaḥ pūrvaṁ mayā vyāsamukhāt purā,
5.51.22: āyasena sa daṇḍena rathān nāgān narān hayān,
5.51.23: mayā tāta pratīpāni kurvan pūrvaṁ vimānitaḥ ॥23॥
5.51.24: śataghnīṁ śatanirhrādāṁ kathaṁ śakṣyanti me sutāḥ ॥24॥
5.51.26: krośato me na śr̥ṇvanti bālāḥ paṇḍitamāninaḥ,
viṣamaṁ na hi manyante prapātaṁ madhudarśinaḥ ॥26॥
5.51.28: prahitāṁ duḥkhasaṁsparśāṁ kathaṁ śakṣyanti me sutāḥ ॥28॥
5.51.30: uddiśya nāgān patataḥ kurvato bhairavān ravān,
5.51.31: agneḥ prajvalitasyeva api mucyeta me prajā ॥31॥
5.51.33: prabhinna iva mātaṅgaḥ prabhañjan puṣpitān drumān,
pravekṣyati raṇe senāṁ putrāṇāṁ me vr̥kodaraḥ ॥33॥
5.51.35: prabhaṅkṣyati raṇe senāṁ putrāṇāṁ mama sañjaya ॥35॥
5.51.39: yanna tasya vaśe jagmuḥ kevalaṁ daivameva tat ॥39॥
5.51.41: sa mokṣyati raṇe tejaḥ putreṣu mama sañjaya ॥41॥
5.51.47: paśyannapi jayaṁ teṣāṁ na niyacchāmi yat sutān ॥47॥
5.51.48: tyakṣyanti tumule prāṇān rakṣantaḥ pārthivaṁ yaśaḥ ॥48॥
5.51.49: pautrā bhīṣmasya śiṣyāśca droṇasya ca kr̥pasya ca ॥49॥
5.51.52: sa vai śocāmi sarvān vai ye yuyutsanti pāṇḍavaiḥ,
5.51.53: na tu manye vighātāya jñānaṁ duḥkhasya sañjaya,
5.51.56: saṁśaye tu mahatyasmin kiṁ nu me kṣamamuttaram,
5.51.59: kiṁnu kuryāṁ kathaṁ kuryāṁ kva nu gacchāmi sañjaya,
ete naśyanti kuravo mandāḥ kālavaśaṁ gatāḥ ॥59॥
5.51.60: avaśo’haṁ tadā tāta putrāṇāṁ nihate śate,
śroṣyāmi ninadaṁ strīṇāṁ kathaṁ māṁ maraṇaṁ spr̥śet ॥60॥
5.51.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi yānasandhiparvaṇi dhr̥tarāṣṭravākye ekapañcāśattamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥51॥
5.52.1: trailokyamapi tasya syād yoddhā yasya dhanañjayaḥ ॥1॥
5.52.2: tasyaiva ca na paśyāmi yudhi gāṇḍīvadhanvanaḥ,
aniśaṁ cintayāno’pi yaḥ pratīyād rathena tam ॥2॥
5.52.3: pratyetā na samaḥ kaścid yudhi gāṇḍīvadhanvanaḥ ॥3॥
5.52.5: mahān syāt saṁśayo loke na tvasti vijayo mama,
ghr̥ṇī karṇaḥ pramādī ca ācāryaḥ sthaviro guruḥ ॥5॥
5.52.7: sarve hyastravidaḥ śūrāḥ sarve prāptā mahad yaśaḥ,
5.52.8: na tu hantārjunasyāsti jetā cāsya na vidyate ॥8॥
5.52.9: manyustasya kathaṁ śāmyenmandān prati ya utthitaḥ,
anye’pyastrāṇi jānanti jīyante ca jayanti ca ॥9॥
5.52.11: jigāya ca surān sarvān nāsya vidmaḥ parājayam,
5.52.13: naivāsti no dhanustādr̥k na yoddhā na ca sārathiḥ ॥13॥
5.52.15: na tu śeṣaṁ śarāstāta kuryurastāḥ kirīṭinā,
5.52.18: vitrastā bahudhā senā bhāratī pratibhāti me,
5.52.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi yānasandhiparvaṇi dhr̥tarāṣṭravākye dvipañcāśattamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥52॥
5.53.3: sa sraṣṭā jagataḥ kr̥ṣṇaḥ pāṇḍavānāṁ jaye dhr̥taḥ ॥3॥
5.53.6: yamābhyāṁ bhīmasenācca bhayaṁ me tāta jāyate ॥6॥
5.53.7: na me sainyāstariṣyanti tataḥ krośāmi sañjaya ॥7॥
5.53.10: dhr̥tyā ca puruṣavyāghro naibhr̥tyena ca pāṇḍavaḥ,
5.53.14: yuddhe vināśaḥ kr̥tsnasya kulasya bhavitā dhruvam ॥14॥
5.53.15: eṣā me paramā buddhiryayā śāmyati me manaḥ,
yadi tvayuddhamiṣṭaṁ vo vayaṁ śāntyai yatāmahe ॥15॥
5.53.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi yānasandhiparvaṇi dhr̥tarāṣṭravākye tripañcāśattamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥53॥
5.54.2: idaṁ tu nābhijānāmi tava dhīrasya nityaśaḥ,
5.54.3: naiṣa kālo mahārāja tava śaśvat kr̥tāgasaḥ,
5.54.4: pitā śreṣṭhaḥ suhr̥d yaśca samyak praṇihitātmavān,
āstheyaṁ hi hitaṁ tena na drogdhā gururucyate ॥4॥
5.54.10: pāṇḍaveṣu vane rājan pravrajatsu punaḥ punaḥ ॥10॥
5.54.12: asyatāṁ phālgunaḥ śreṣṭho gāṇḍīvaṁ dhanuṣāṁ baram,
5.54.15: yasya bhīmārjunau yodhau sa rājā rājasattama,
5.54.18: pārthaṁ hyete gatāḥ sarve vīryajñāstasya dhīmataḥ ॥18॥
5.54.19: bhaktyā hyasya virudhyante tava putraiḥ sadaiva te,
5.54.21: dyūtakāle mayā coktaṁ vidureṇa ca dhīmatā ॥21॥
5.54.22: yadidaṁ te vilapitaṁ pāṇḍavān prati bhārata,
5.54.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi yānasandhiparvaṇi sañjayavākye catuṣpañcāśattamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥54॥
5.55.1: na bhetavyaṁ mahārāja na śocyā bhavatā vayam,
samarthāḥ sma parāñjetuṁ balinaḥ samare vibho ॥1॥
5.55.8: na te sthāsyanti samaye pāṇḍavā iti me matiḥ,
5.55.9: r̥te ca vidurāt sarve yūyaṁ vadhyā matā mama,
5.55.10: samucchedaṁ ca kr̥tsnaṁ naḥ kr̥tvā tāta janārdanaḥ,
5.55.11: tatra kiṁ prāptakālaṁ naḥ praṇipātaḥ palāyanam,
5.55.13: dhikkr̥tāḥ pārthivaiḥ sarvaiḥ svajanena ca sarvaśaḥ ॥13॥
5.55.14: praṇipāte na doṣo’sti sandhirnaḥ śāśvatīḥ samāḥ,
5.55.17: tato droṇo’bravīd bhīṣmaḥ kr̥po drauṇiśca bhārata,
5.55.18: abhidrugdhāḥ pare cenno na bhetavyaṁ parantapa,
5.55.22: parān vijetuṁ tasmāt te vyetu bhīrbharatarṣabha ॥22॥
5.55.26: madarthaṁ pārthivāḥ sarve tad viddhi kurusattama ॥26॥
5.55.28: eṣāṁ hyekaikaśo rājñāṁ samarthaḥ pāṇḍavān prati,
ātmānaṁ manyate sarvo vyetu te bhayamāgatam ॥28॥
5.55.29: jetuṁ samagrāṁ senāṁ me vāsavo’pi na śaknuyāt,
5.55.30: yudhiṣṭhiraḥ puraṁ hitvā pañca grāmān sa yācati,
bhīto hi māmakāt sainyāt prabhāvāccaiva me vibho ॥30॥
5.55.31: tanmithyā na hi me kr̥tsnaṁ prabhāvaṁ vetsi bhārata ॥31॥
5.55.32: matsamo hi gadāyuddhe pr̥thivyāṁ nāsti kaścana,
nāsīt kaścidatikrānto bhavitā na ca kaścana ॥32॥
5.55.33: tasmānna bhīmānnānyebhyo bhayaṁ me vidyate kvacit ॥33॥
5.55.35: gadāprahāraṁ bhīmo me na jātu viṣahed yudhi ॥35॥
5.55.36: ekaṁ prahāraṁ yaṁ dadyāṁ bhīmāya ruṣito nr̥pa,
sa evainaṁ nayed ghoraḥ kṣipraṁ vaivasvatakṣayam ॥36॥
5.55.37: iccheyaṁ ca gadāhastaṁ rājan draṣṭuṁ vr̥kodaram,
suciraṁ prārthito hyeṣa mama nityaṁ manorathaḥ ॥37॥
5.55.38: gadayā nihato hyājau mayā pārtho vr̥kodaraḥ,
5.55.41: tat te vr̥kodaramayaṁ bhayaṁ vyetu mahāhave,
vyapaneṣyāmyahaṁ hyenaṁ mā rājan vimanā bhava ॥41॥
5.55.42: tasmin mayā hate kṣipramarjunaṁ bahavo rathāḥ,
5.55.43: bhīṣmo droṇaḥ kr̥po drauṇiḥ karṇo bhūriśravāstathā,
5.55.44: ekaika eṣāṁ śaktastu hantuṁ bhārata pāṇḍavān,
5.55.47: na hantā vidyate cāpi rājan bhīṣmasya kaścana ॥47॥
5.55.50: ayonijāstrayo hyete pitā mātā ca mātulaḥ ॥50॥
5.55.51: aśvatthāmno mahārāja sa ca śūraḥ sthito mama,
5.55.53: bhīṣmadroṇakr̥pāṇāṁ ca tulyaḥ karṇo mato mama ॥53॥
5.55.54: kuṇḍale rucire cāstāṁ karṇasya sahaje śubhe ॥54॥
5.55.55: te śacyarthaṁ mahendreṇa yācitaḥ sa parantapaḥ,
5.55.56: vijayo me dhruvaṁ rājan phalaṁ pāṇāvivāhitam ॥56॥
5.55.57: abhivyaktaḥ pareṣāṁ ca kr̥tsno bhuvi parājayaḥ,
ahnā hyekena bhīṣmo’yaṁ prayutaṁ hanti bhārata ॥57॥
5.55.60: pārthivāḥ sa bhavāṁstebhyo hyakasmād vyathate katham,
bhīmasene ca nihate ko’nyo yudhyeta bhārata ॥60॥
5.55.61: pañca te bhrātaraḥ sarve dhr̥ṣṭadyumno’tha sātyakiḥ ॥61॥
5.55.62: pareṣāṁ sapta ye rājan yodhāḥ sāraṁ balaṁ matam,
5.55.65: akṣauhiṇyo hi me rājan daśaikā ca samāhr̥tāḥ,
nyūnāḥ pareṣāṁ saptaiva kasmānme syāt parājayaḥ ॥65॥
5.55.66: balaṁ triguṇato hīnaṁ yodhyaṁ prāha br̥haspatiḥ,
5.55.67: guṇahīnaṁ pareṣāṁ ca bahu paśyāmi bhārata,
5.55.68: etat sarvaṁ samājñāya balāgryaṁ mama bhārata,
nyūnatāṁ pāṇḍavānāṁ ca na mohaṁ gantumarhasi ॥68॥
5.55.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi yānasandhiparvaṇi duryodhanavākye pañcapañcāśattamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥55॥
5.56.1: akṣauhiṇīḥ sapta labdhvā rājabhiḥ saha sañjaya,
5.56.3: rathaṁ tu divyaṁ kaunteyaḥ sarvā vibhrājayan diśaḥ,
5.56.6: arjunasya rathe brūhi kathamaśvāḥ kathaṁ dhvajāḥ ॥6॥
5.56.7: rūpāṇi kalpayāmāsa tvaṣṭā dhātā sadā vibho ॥7॥
5.56.8: dhvaje hi tasmin rūpāṇi cakruste devamāyayā,
mahādhanāni divyāni mahānti ca laghūni ca ॥8॥
5.56.10: sa tiryagūrdhvaṁ ca rurodha vai dhvajaḥ,
5.56.11: na caikavarṇaṁ na ca vedmi kiṁ nu tat,
5.56.12: na ced bhāro bhavitā nota rodhaḥ ॥12॥
5.56.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi yānasandhiparvaṇi sañjayavākye ṣaṭpañcāśattamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥56॥
5.57.1: ye yotsyante pāṇḍavārthe putrasya mama vāhinīm ॥1॥
5.57.2: cekitānaṁ ca tatraiva yuyudhānaṁ ca sātyakim ॥2॥
5.57.11: yo veda mānuṣaṁ vyūhaṁ daivaṁ gāndharvamāsuram,
5.57.12: bhīṣmaḥ śāntanavo rājan bhāgaḥ klr̥ptaḥ śikhaṇḍinaḥ,
5.57.13: tau tu tatrābruvan kecid viṣamau no matāviti ॥13॥
5.57.15: arjunasya tu bhāgena karṇo vaikartano mataḥ,
5.57.18: trigartānāṁ caiva mukhyau yau tau saṁśaptakāviti ॥18॥
5.57.19: saubhadreṇa kr̥to bhāgo rājā caiva br̥hadbalaḥ ॥19॥
5.57.23: ulūkaṁ caiva kaitavyaṁ ye ca sārasvatā gaṇāḥ,
5.57.24: ye cānye pārthivā rājan pratyudyāsyanti saṅgare,
5.57.25: yat te kāryaṁ saputrasya kriyatāṁ tadakālikam ॥25॥
5.57.26: na santi sarve putrā me mūḍhā durdyūtadevinaḥ,
5.57.30: yeṣāṁ yudhiṣṭhiro netā goptā ca madhusūdanaḥ,
5.57.37: pitāmahaṁ ca droṇaṁ ca kr̥paṁ karṇaṁ ca durjayam,
5.57.38: aśaktaḥ samare jetuṁ kiṁ punastāta pāṇḍavāḥ ॥38॥
5.57.39: sarve ca pr̥thivīpālā madarthe tāta pāṇḍavān,
5.57.41: matpriyaṁ pārthivāḥ sarve ye cikīrṣanti bhārata,
5.57.43: unmatta iva me putro vilapatyeṣa sañjaya,
na hi śakto raṇe jetuṁ dharmarājaṁ yudhiṣṭhiram ॥43॥
5.57.44: jānāti hi yathā bhīṣmaḥ pāṇḍavānāṁ yaśasvinām,
5.57.45: kiṁ tu sañjaya me brūhi punasteṣāṁ viceṣṭitam ॥45॥
5.57.50: bhīṣmaṁ droṇaṁ kr̥paṁ karṇaṁ drauṇiṁ śalyaṁ suyodhanam,
5.57.51: tathā bruvantaṁ dharmātmā prāha rājā yudhiṣṭhiraḥ,
tava dhairyaṁ ca vīryaṁ ca pañcālāḥ pāṇḍavaiḥ saha ॥51॥
5.57.54: bhavatā yad vidhātavyaṁ tannaḥ śreyaḥ parantapa,
5.57.55: krīṇīyāt taṁ sahasreṇa iti nītimatāṁ matam ॥55॥
5.57.56: sa tvaṁ śūraśca vīraśca vikrāntaśca nararṣabha,
5.57.59: duḥśāsanaṁ vikarṇaṁ ca tathā duryodhanaṁ nr̥pam,
bhīṣmaṁ ca brūhi gatvā tvamāśu gaccha ca mā ciram ॥59॥
5.57.62: na sa jeyo manuṣyeṇa mā sma kr̥ḍhdhvaṁ mano yudhi ॥62॥
5.57.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi yānasandhiparvaṇi sañjayavākye saptapañcāśattamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥57॥
5.58.5: jāta eṣa tavābhāvastvaṁ tu mohānna budhyase ॥5॥
5.58.6: na ca bhīṣmo na ca droṇo nāśvatthāmā na sañjayaḥ ॥6॥
5.58.7: na somadatto na śalo na kr̥po yuddhamicchati,
5.58.8: te yuddhaṁ nābhinandanti tat tubhyaṁ tāta rocatām ॥8॥
5.58.9: na tvaṁ karoṣi kāmena karṇaḥ kārayitā tava,
5.58.10: nāhaṁ bhavati na droṇe nāśvatthāmni na sañjaye,
na bhīṣme na ca kāmboje na kr̥pe na ca bāhlike ॥10॥
5.58.11: anyeṣu vā tāvakeṣu bhāraṁ kr̥tvā samāhvayam ॥11॥
5.58.12: ahaṁ ca tāta karṇaśca raṇayajñaṁ vitatya vai,
5.58.13: ratho vedī sruvaḥ khaḍgo gadā sruk kavaco’jinam,
cāturhotraṁ ca dhuryā me śarā darbhā haviryaśaḥ ॥13॥
5.58.14: vijitya ca sameṣyāvo hatāmitrau śriyā vr̥tau ॥14॥
5.58.15: ahaṁ ca tāta karṇaśca bhrātā duḥśāsanaśca me,
ete vayaṁ haniṣyāmaḥ pāṇḍavān samare trayaḥ ॥15॥
5.58.16: ahaṁ hi pāṇḍavān hatvā praśāstā pr̥thivīmimām,
māṁ vā hatvā pāṇḍuputrā bhoktāraḥ pr̥thivīmimām ॥16॥
5.58.17: tyaktaṁ me jīvitaṁ rājyaṁ dhanaṁ sarvaṁ ca pārthiva,
5.58.19: sarvān vastāta śocāmi tyakto duryodhano mayā,
5.58.20: varān varān haniṣyanti sametā yudhi pāṇḍavāḥ ॥20॥
5.58.22: sampūrṇaṁ pūrayan bhūyo dhanaṁ pārthasya mādhavaḥ,
5.58.25: bhīto bhīmasya saṁsparśāt smartāsi vacanasya me ॥25॥
5.58.27: mahad vo bhayamāgāmi na cecchāmyatha pāṇḍavaiḥ,
5.58.28: balaṁ kurūṇāṁ bhīmena tadā smartāsi me vacaḥ ॥28॥
5.59.1: tanme brūhi mahāprājña śuśrūṣe vacanaṁ tava ॥1॥
5.59.2: śr̥ṇu rājan yathā dr̥ṣṭau mayā kr̥ṣṇadhanañjayau,
ūcatuścāpi yad vīrau tat te vakṣyāmi bhārata ॥2॥
5.59.4: yatra kr̥ṣṇau ca kr̥ṣṇā ca satyabhāmā ca bhāminī ॥4॥
5.59.7: arjunasya ca kr̥ṣṇāyāṁ satyāyāṁ ca mahātmanaḥ ॥7॥
5.59.8: kāñcanaṁ pādapīṭhaṁ tu pārtho me prādiśat tadā,
5.59.16: vācaṁ sa vadatāṁ śreṣṭho hlādinīṁ vacanakṣamām,
5.59.21: priyaṁ priyebhyaścarata rājā hi tvarate jaye ॥21॥
5.59.22: yad govindeti cukrośa kr̥ṣṇā māṁ dūravāsinam ॥22॥
5.59.24: yo na kālaparīto vāpyapi sākṣāt purandaraḥ ॥24॥
5.59.25: bāhubhyāmudvahed bhūmiṁ dahet kruddha imāḥ prajāḥ,
pātayet tridivād devān yo’rjunaṁ samare jayet ॥25॥
5.59.26: na taṁ paśyāmyahaṁ yuddhe pāṇḍavaṁ yo’bhyayād raṇe ॥26॥
5.59.27: ekasya ca bahūnāṁ ca paryāptaṁ tannidarśanam ॥27॥
5.59.29: balaṁ vīryaṁ ca tejaśca śīghratā laghuhastatā,
5.59.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi yānasandhiparvaṇi sañjayena śrīkr̥ṣṇavākyakathane ekonaṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥59॥
5.60.3d1: yadā tu mene bhūyiṣṭhaṁ tadvaco guṇadoṣataḥ,
punareva kurūṇāṁ ca pāṇḍavānāṁ ca buddhimān.
5.60.5d1: adharmye cāyaśasye vā kārye mahati dāruṇe.
5.60.6: priyāṇi caiṣāṁ kurvanti yathāśakti hitāni ca ॥6॥
5.60.7: icchanti bahulaṁ santaḥ pratikartuṁ mahat priyam ॥7॥
5.60.8: agniḥ sācivyakartā syāt khāṇḍave tatkr̥taṁ smaran,
5.60.11: te devaiḥ sahitāḥ pārthā na śakyāḥ prativīkṣitum,
5.60.13: rathaśca caturantāyāṁ yasya nāsti samaḥ kṣitau ॥13॥
5.60.15: yaṁ cātimānuṣaṁ vīrye kr̥tsno loko vyavasyati,
devānāmapi jetāraṁ yaṁ viduḥ pārthivā raṇe ॥15॥
5.60.16: śatāni pañca caiveṣūn yo gr̥hṇan naiva dr̥śyate,
5.60.17: yamāha bhīṣmo droṇaśca kr̥po drauṇistathaiva ca,
madrarājastathā śalyo madhyasthā ye ca mānavāḥ ॥17॥
5.60.22: asya cet kalahasyāntaḥ śamādanyo na vidyate ॥22॥
5.60.23: śamo me rocate nityaṁ pārthaistāta na vigrahaḥ,
kurubhyo hi sadā manye pāṇḍavān śaktimattarān ॥23॥
5.60.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi yānasandhiparvaṇi dhr̥tarāṣṭravivecane ṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥60॥
5.61.2: aśakyā devasacivāḥ pārthāḥ syuriti yad bhavān,
manyate tad bhayaṁ vyetu bhavato rājasattama ॥2॥
5.61.5: kāmāt krodhāt tathā lobhād dveṣācca bharatarṣabha ॥5॥
5.61.7: tasmānna bhavatā cintā kāryaiṣā syāt kathañcana,
5.61.8: atha cet kāmasaṁyogād dveṣo lobhaśca lakṣyate,
5.61.10: yad vā paramakaṁ tejo yena yuktā divaukasaḥ,
5.61.13: aśmavarṣaṁ ca vāyuṁ ca śamayāmīha nityaśaḥ,
5.61.16: bhayānakāni viṣaye vyālādīni na santi me,
5.61.17: dharmiṣṭhāśca prajāḥ sarvā ītayaśca na santi me ॥17॥
5.61.19: na sma trayodaśa samāḥ pārthā duḥkhamavāpnuyuḥ ॥19॥
5.61.20: naiva devā na gandharvā nāsurā na ca rākṣasāḥ,
śaktāstrātuṁ mayā dviṣṭaṁ satyametad bravīmi te ॥20॥
5.61.22: nānyathā bhūtapūrvaṁ ca satyavāgiti māṁ viduḥ ॥22॥
5.61.23: āśvāsanārthaṁ bhavataḥ proktaṁ na ślāghayā nr̥pa ॥23॥
5.61.24: na hyahaṁ ślāghano rājan bhūtapūrvaḥ kadācana,
5.61.25: sātyakiṁ vāsudevaṁ ca śrotāsi vijitān mayā ॥25॥
5.61.26: saritaḥ sāgaraṁ prāpya yathā naśyanti sarvaśaḥ,
5.61.27: parā buddhiḥ paraṁ tejo vīryaṁ ca paramaṁ mama,
parā vidyā pate yogo mama tebhyo viśiṣyate ॥27॥
5.61.28: astreṣu yat prajānanti sarvaṁ tanmayi vidyate ॥28॥
5.61.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi yānasandhiparvaṇi duryodhanavākye ekaṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥61॥
5.62.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi yānasandhiparvaṇi karṇabhīṣmavākye dviṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥62॥
5.63.2: vayaṁ ca te’pi tulyā vai vīryeṇa ca parākramaiḥ,
samena vayasā caiva prātibhena śrutena ca ॥2॥
5.63.3: astreṇa yodhayugyā ca śīghratve kauśale tathā,
5.63.4: nāhaṁ bhavati na droṇe na kr̥pe na ca bāhlike ॥4॥
5.63.5: ahaṁ vaikartanaḥ karṇo bhrātā duḥśāsanaśca me ॥5॥
5.63.6: pāṇḍavān samare pañca haniṣyāmaḥ śitaiḥ śaraiḥ,
5.63.8: tadā darpaṁ vimokṣyanti pāṇḍavāḥ sa ca keśavaḥ ॥8॥
5.63.12: yeṣāṁ ca pratiṣedhārthaṁ kṣatraṁ sr̥ṣṭaṁ svayambhuvā ॥12॥
5.63.13: tasya liṅgaṁ pravakṣyāmi yeṣāṁ samudayo damaḥ ॥13॥
5.63.15: etāni yasya rājendra sa dāntaḥ puruṣaḥ smr̥taḥ ॥15॥
5.63.16: māna īrṣyā ca śokaśca naitad dānto niṣevate,
5.63.18: prāpyeha loke sammānaṁ sugatiṁ pretya gacchati ॥18॥
5.63.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi yānasandhiparvaṇi viduravākye triṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥63॥
5.64.2: tasmin dvau śakunau baddhau yugapat sahacāriṇau,
5.64.7: yatra vai vivadiṣyete tatra me vaśameṣyataḥ ॥7॥
5.64.10: evaṁ ye jñātayo’rtheṣu mitho gacchanti vigraham,
5.64.12: ye sma kāle sumanasaḥ sarve vr̥ddhānupāsate,
5.64.15: idamanyat pravakṣyāmi yathā dr̥ṣṭaṁ girau mayā,
śrutvā tadapi kauravya yathā śreyastathā kuru ॥15॥
5.64.20: iti te kathayanti sma brāhmaṇā jambhasādhakāḥ ॥20॥
5.64.23: na ca paśyāmi tejo’sya vikramaṁ vā tathāvidham ॥23॥
5.64.25: virāṭanagare bhagnāḥ kiṁ tatra tava dr̥śyatām,
pratīkṣamāṇo yo vīraḥ kṣamate vīkṣitaṁ tava ॥25॥
5.64.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi yānasandhiparvaṇi viduravākye catuḥṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥64॥
5.65.1: duryodhana vijānīhi yat tvāṁ vakṣyāmi putraka,
5.65.4: bhīmasenaṁ ca kaunteyaṁ yasya nāsti samo bale,
5.65.5: yudhi gāṇḍīvadhanvānaṁ ko nu yudhyeta buddhimān ॥5॥
5.65.8: taṁ kr̥ṣṇaṁ puṇḍarīkākṣaṁ ko nu yuddhyeta buddhimān ॥8॥
5.65.10: aviṣahyaṁ pr̥thivyāpi tad balaṁ yatra keśavaḥ ॥10॥
5.65.12: droṇaṁ kr̥paṁ vikarṇaṁ ca mahārājaṁ ca bāhlikam ॥12॥
5.65.14: utsr̥jya gāḥ susantrastaṁ balaṁ te samaśīryata ॥14॥
5.65.15: ekasya ca bahūnāṁ ca paryāptaṁ tannidarśanam ॥15॥
5.65.16: arjunastat tathākārṣīt kiṁ punaḥ sarva eva te,
5.65.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi yānasandhiparvaṇi dhr̥tarāṣṭravākye pañcaṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥65॥
5.66.2: yadarjuna uvāca tvāṁ paraṁ kautūhalaṁ hi me ॥2॥
5.66.4: droṇaṁ kr̥paṁ ca karṇaṁ ca mahārājaṁ ca bāhlikam ॥4॥
5.66.5: drauṇiṁ ca somadattaṁ ca śakuniṁ cāpi saubalam,
5.66.6: vikarṇaṁ citrasenaṁ ca jayatsenaṁ ca pārthivam,
5.66.7: bhagadattaṁ ca rājānaṁ jalasandhaṁ ca pārthivam ॥7॥
5.66.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi yānasandhiparvaṇi sañjayavākye ṣaṭṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥66॥
5.67.3: ātmanaśca pareṣāṁ ca pāṇḍavānāṁ ca niścayam ॥3॥
5.67.5: sa me pr̥ṣṭaḥ sañjaya brūhi sarvaṁ
5.67.6: na tvāṁ brūyāṁ rahite jātu kiñci-
5.67.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi yānasandhiparvaṇi vyāsagāndhāryāgamane saptaṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥67॥
5.68.2: cakraṁ tad vāsudevasya māyayā vartate vibho ॥2॥
5.68.4: narakaṁ śambaraṁ caiva kaṁsaṁ caidyaṁ ca mādhavaḥ,
5.68.5: pr̥thivīṁ cāntarikṣaṁ ca dyāṁ caiva puruṣottamaḥ,
5.68.6: bhūyo bhūyo hi yad rājan pr̥cchase pāṇḍavān prati,
sārāsārabalaṁ jñātuṁ tat samāsena me śr̥ṇu ॥6॥
5.68.7: ekato vā jagat kr̥tsnamekato vā janārdanaḥ,
5.68.8: na tu kr̥tsnaṁ jagacchaktaṁ bhasma kartuṁ janārdanam ॥8॥
5.68.9: yataḥ satyaṁ yato dharmo yato hrīrārjavaṁ yataḥ,
tato bhavati govindo yataḥ kr̥ṣṇastato jayaḥ ॥9॥
5.68.10: pr̥thivīṁ cāntarikṣaṁ ca divaṁ ca puruṣottamaḥ,
5.68.11: sa kr̥tvā pāṇḍavān satraṁ lokaṁ sammohayanniva,
5.68.13: kālasya ca hi mr̥tyośca jaṅgamasthāvarasya ca,
5.68.15: ye tameva prapadyante na te muhyanti mānavāḥ ॥15॥
5.69.2: śr̥ṇu rājan na te vidyā mama vidyā na hīyate,
5.69.4: gāvalgaṇe’tra kā bhaktiryā te nityā janārdane,
5.69.5: māyāṁ na seve bhadraṁ te na vr̥thā dharmamācare,
śuddhabhāvaṁ gato bhaktyā śāstrād vedmi janārdanam ॥5॥
5.69.6: āpto naḥ sañjayastāta śaraṇaṁ gaccha keśavam ॥6॥
5.69.9: aiśvaryajīvite hitvā pitaraṁ māṁ ca bāliśa ॥9॥
5.69.10: vardhayan durhr̥dāṁ prītiṁ māṁ ca śokena vardhayan,
5.69.11: priyo’si rājan kr̥ṣṇasya dhr̥tarāṣṭra nibodha me,
yasya te sañjayo dūto yastvāṁ śreyasi yokṣyate ॥11॥
5.69.12: jānātyeṣa hr̥ṣīkeśaṁ purāṇaṁ yacca vai param,
5.69.13: sitā bahuvidhaiḥ pāśairye na tuṣṭāḥ svakairdhanaiḥ ॥13॥
5.69.15: eṣa ekāyanaḥ panthā yena yānti manīṣiṇaḥ,
taṁ dr̥ṣṭvā mr̥tyumatyeti mahāṁstatra na sajjati ॥15॥
5.69.19: buddhiśca te mā cyavatu niyacchaināṁ yatastataḥ ॥19॥
5.69.20: etajjñānaṁ ca panthāśca yena yānti manīṣiṇaḥ ॥20॥
5.69.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi yānasandhiparvaṇi sañjayavākye ekonasaptatitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥69॥
5.70.4: maunād dhyānācca yogācca viddhi bhārata mādhavam,
5.70.7: yataḥ sattvānna cyavate yacca sattvānna hīyate,
5.70.10: adho na kṣīyate jātu yasmāt tasmādadhokṣajaḥ,
5.70.12: sarvasya ca sadā jñānāt sarvametaṁ pracakṣate,
5.70.13: satyāt satyaṁ tu govindastasmāt satyo’pi nāmataḥ,
5.70.14: atattvaṁ kurute tattvaṁ tena mohayate prajāḥ ॥14॥
5.70.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi yānasandhiparvaṇi sañjayavākye saptatitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥70॥
5.71.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi yānasandhiparvaṇi dhr̥tarāṣṭravākye ekasaptatitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥71॥
5.72.1d1: arjunaṁ bhīmasenaṁ ca mādrīputrau ca bhārata,
5.72.1d3: yathā bhīṣmeṇa droṇena bāhlīkena ca dhīmatā.
5.72.1d4: anyaiśca kurubhiḥ sārdhaṁ na yudhyemahi saṁyuge,
eṣa naḥ prathamaḥ kalpa etannaḥ śreya uttamam.
5.72.1d6: tadā ca duḥsahāḥ sarve sadasyāste nararṣabhāḥ,
5.72.2: ayaṁ sa kālaḥ samprāpto mitrāṇāṁ mitravatsala,
na ca tvadanyaṁ paśyāmi yo na āpatsu tārayet ॥2॥
5.72.4: tathā te pāṇḍavā rakṣyāḥ pāhyasmān mahato bhayāt ॥4॥
5.72.5: ayamasmi mahābāho brūhi yat te vivakṣitam,
kariṣyāmi hi tat sarvaṁ yat tvaṁ vakṣyasi bhārata ॥5॥
5.72.6: etaddhi sakalaṁ kr̥ṣṇa sañjayo māṁ yadabravīt ॥6॥
5.72.7: yathoktaṁ dūta ācaṣṭe vadhyaḥ syādanyathā bruvan ॥7॥
5.72.9: yat tad dvādaśa varṣāṇi vaneṣu hyuṣitā vayam,
5.72.10: sthātā naḥ samaye tasmin dhr̥tarāṣṭra iti prabho,
nāhāsma samayaṁ kr̥ṣṇa taddhi no brāhmaṇā viduḥ ॥10॥
5.72.12: mithyā carati lubdhaḥ san caran hi priyamātmanaḥ ॥12॥
5.72.13: ito duḥkhataraṁ kiṁ nu yadahaṁ mātaraṁ tataḥ,
saṁvidhātuṁ na śaknomi mitrāṇāṁ vā janārdana ॥13॥
5.72.14: bhavatā caiva nāthena pañca grāmā vr̥tā mayā ॥14॥
5.72.16: pañca nastāta dīyantāṁ grāmā vā nagarāṇi vā,
vasema sahitā yeṣu mā ca no bharatā naśan ॥16॥
5.72.18: lobhaḥ prajñānamāhanti prajñā hanti hatā hriyam ॥18॥
5.72.19: hrīrhatā bādhate dharmaṁ dharmo hanti hataḥ śriyam,
5.72.23: dhanamāhuḥ paraṁ dharmaṁ dhane sarvaṁ pratiṣṭhitam,
jīvanti dhanino loke mr̥tā ye tvadhanā narāḥ ॥23॥
5.72.24: te dharmamarthaṁ kāmaṁ ca pramathnanti naraṁ ca tam ॥24॥
5.72.28: yadasya dharmyaṁ maraṇaṁ śāśvataṁ lokavartma tat,
5.72.29: na tathā bādhyate kr̥ṣṇa prakr̥tyā nirdhano janaḥ,
yathā bhadrāṁ śriyaṁ prāpya tayā hīnaḥ sukhaidhitaḥ ॥29॥
5.72.30: sendrān garhayate devān nātmānaṁ ca kathañcana ॥30॥
5.72.32: taṁ tadā manyurevaiti sa bhūyaḥ sampramuhyati,
5.72.34: na cet prabudhyate kr̥ṣṇa narakāyaiva gacchati,
5.72.36: hrīmān hi pāpaṁ pradveṣṭi tasya śrīrabhivardhate,
śrīmān sa yāvat bhavati tāvad bhavati pūruṣaḥ ॥36॥
5.72.37: nādharme kurute buddhiṁ na ca pāpe pravartate ॥37॥
5.72.38: ahrīko vā vimūḍho vā naiva strī na punaḥ pumān,
5.72.40: tadidaṁ mayi te dr̥ṣṭaṁ pratyakṣaṁ madhusūdana,
5.72.41: te vayaṁ na śriyaṁ hātumalaṁ nyāyena kenacit,
atra no yatamānānāṁ vadhaścedapi sādhu tat ॥41॥
5.72.42: tatra naḥ prathamaḥ kalpo yad vayaṁ te ca mādhava,
5.72.43: yad vayaṁ kauravān hatvā tāni rāṣṭrāṇyavāpnumaḥ ॥43॥
5.72.44: ye punaḥ syurasambaddhā anāryāḥ kr̥ṣṇa śatravaḥ,
5.72.45: teṣāṁ vadho’tipāpīyān kiṁ no yuddhe’sti śobhanam ॥45॥
5.72.46: sa naḥ svadharmo’dharmo vā vr̥ttiranyā vigarhitā ॥46॥
5.72.47: śūdraḥ karoti śuśrūṣāṁ vaiśyā vai paṇyajīvikāḥ,
5.72.48: kṣatriyaḥ kṣatriyaṁ hanti matsyo matsyena jīvati,
śvā śvānaṁ hanti dāśārha paśya dharmo yathāgataḥ ॥48॥
5.72.49: yuddhe kr̥ṣṇa kalirnityaṁ prāṇāḥ sīdanti saṁyuge,
5.72.50: nāpyakāle sukhaṁ prāpyaṁ duḥkhaṁ vāpi yadūttama ॥50॥
5.72.51: eko hyapi bahūn hanti ghnantyekaṁ bahavo’pyuta,
5.72.53: sarvathā vr̥jinaṁ yuddhaṁ ko ghnan na pratihanyate,
5.72.54: yasya syād vijayaḥ kr̥ṣṇa tasyāpyapacayo dhruvam ॥54॥
5.72.56: ye hyeva dhīrā hrīmanta āryāḥ karuṇavedinaḥ ॥56॥
5.72.57: ta eva yuddhe hanyante yavīyān mucyate janaḥ,
5.72.61: utsādayati yaḥ sarvaṁ yaśasā sa vimucyate ॥61॥
5.72.63: na cāpi vairaṁ vaireṇa keśava vyupaśāmyati ॥63॥
5.72.65: tasya tyāgena vā śāntirmaraṇenāpi vā bhavet ॥65॥
5.72.67: yā tu tyāgena śāntiḥ syāt tadr̥te vadha eva saḥ,
5.72.68: na ca tyaktuṁ tadicchāmo na cecchāmaḥ kulakṣayam,
atra yā praṇipātena śāntiḥ saiva garīyasī ॥68॥
5.72.72: tatra yo balavān kr̥ṣṇa jitvā so’tti tadāmiṣam,
5.72.74: pitā rājā ca vr̥ddhaśca sarvathā mānamarhati,
5.72.78: ko hi kr̥ṣṇāsti nastvādr̥k sarvaniścayavit suhr̥t ॥78॥
5.72.82: na mamaitanmataṁ kr̥ṣṇa yat tvaṁ yāyāḥ kurūn prati,
suyodhanaḥ sūktamapi na kariṣyati te vacaḥ ॥82॥
5.72.83: teṣāṁ madhyāvataraṇaṁ tava kr̥ṣṇa na rocaye ॥83॥
5.72.84: na hi naḥ prīṇayed dravyaṁ na devatvaṁ kutaḥ sukham,
na ca sarvāmaraiśvaryaṁ tava droheṇa mādhava ॥84॥
5.72.86: na cāpi mama paryāptāḥ sahitāḥ sarvapārthivāḥ,
5.72.87: atha cet te pravartante mayi kiñcidasāmpratam,
nirdaheyaṁ kurūn sarvāniti me dhīyate matiḥ ॥87॥
5.72.88: na jātu gamanaṁ pārtha bhavet tatra nirarthakam,
5.72.89: yat tubhyaṁ rocate kr̥ṣṇa svasti prāpnuhi kauravān,
5.72.90: yathā sarve sumanasaḥ saha syāma sucetasaḥ ॥90॥
5.72.91: bhrātā cāsi sakhā cāsi bībhatsormama ca priyaḥ,
5.72.92: asmān vettha parān vettha vetthārthān vettha bhāṣitum,
yad yadasmaddhitaṁ kr̥ṣṇa tat tad vācyaḥ suyodhanaḥ ॥92॥
5.72.93: tat tat keśava bhāṣethāḥ sāntvaṁ vā yadi vetarat ॥93॥
5.72.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi bhagavadyānaparvaṇi yudhiṣṭhirakr̥takr̥ṣṇapreraṇe dvisaptatitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥72॥
5.73.1: sañjayasya śrutaṁ vākyaṁ bhavataśca śrutaṁ mayā,
sarvaṁ jānāmyabhiprāyaṁ teṣāṁ ca bhavataśca yaḥ ॥1॥
5.73.2: yadayuddhena labhyeta tat te bahumataṁ bhavet ॥2॥
5.73.3: na caivaṁ naiṣṭhikaṁ karma kṣatriyasya viśāmpate,
5.73.4: jayo vadho vā saṅgrāme dhātrā’’diṣṭaḥ sanātanaḥ,
5.73.7: na paryāyo’sti yat sāmyaṁ tvayi kuryurviśāmpate,
5.73.10: etadeva nimittaṁ te pāṇḍavāstu yathā tvayi,
5.73.11: brāhmaṇānāṁ ca sādhūnāṁ rājñaśca nagarasya ca ॥11॥
5.73.13: na cāpatrapate tena nr̥śaṁsaḥ svena karmaṇā ॥13॥
5.73.15: ślāghamānaḥ prahr̥ṣṭaḥ san bhrātr̥bhiḥ saha bhāṣate ॥15॥
5.73.16: etāvat pāṇḍavānāṁ hi nāsti kiñcidiha svakam,
nāmadheyaṁ ca gotraṁ ca tadapyeṣāṁ na śiṣyate ॥16॥
5.73.21: ślāghate jñātimadhye sma tvayi pravrajite vanam ॥21॥
5.73.23: sarve duryodhanaṁ tatra nindanti sma sabhāsadaḥ ॥23॥
5.73.24: kulīnasya ca yā nindā vadho vāmitrakarśana,
mahāguṇo vadho rājan na tu nindā kujīvikā ॥24॥
5.73.28: sarvathā tvatkṣamaṁ caitad rocate ca mamānagha,
yat tvaṁ pitari bhīṣme ca praṇipātaṁ samācareḥ ॥28॥
5.73.29: ahaṁ tu sarvalokasya gatvā chetsyāmi saṁśayam,
5.73.30: tava saṅkīrtayiṣyāmi ye ca tasya vyatikramāḥ ॥30॥
5.73.34: śamaṁ vai yācamānastvaṁ nādharmaṁ tatra lapsyase,
5.73.36: yatiṣye praśamaṁ kartuṁ lakṣayiṣye ca ceṣṭitam ॥36॥
5.73.38: nimittāni hi sarvāṇi tathā prādurbhavanti me ॥38॥
5.73.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi bhagavadyānaparvaṇi kr̥ṣṇavākye trisaptatitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥73॥
5.74.1: yathā yathaiva śāntiḥ syāt kurūṇāṁ madhusūdana,
tathā tathaiva bhāṣethā mā sma yuddhena bhīṣayeḥ ॥1॥
5.74.5: mriyetāpi na bhajyeta naiva jahyāt svakaṁ matam,
5.74.18: apyayaṁ naḥ kurūṇāṁ syād yugānte kālasambhr̥taḥ,
5.74.21: apyudāsīnavr̥ttiḥ syād yathā naḥ kurubhiḥ saha,
vāsudeva tathā kāryaṁ na kurūnanayaḥ spr̥śet ॥21॥
5.74.22: vācyaḥ pitāmaho vr̥ddho ye ca kr̥ṣṇa sabhāsadaḥ,
5.74.23: arjuno naiva yuddhārthī bhūyasī hi dayārjune ॥23॥
5.74.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi bhagavadyānaparvaṇi bhīmavākye catuḥsaptatitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥74॥
5.75.5: na ca svapiṣi jāgarṣi nyubjaḥ śeṣe parantapa,
5.75.8: nighnan padbhiḥ kṣitiṁ bhīma niṣṭanan paridhāvasi ॥8॥
5.75.11: bhrukuṭiṁ ca punaḥ kurvannoṣṭhau ca vidaśanniva,
5.75.12: yathā ca paścānnirmukto dhruvaṁ paryeti raśmivān ॥12॥
5.75.14: iti sma madhye bhrātr̥̄ṇāṁ satyenālabhase gadām,
5.75.15: cetāṁsi vipratīpāni yat tvāṁ bhīrbhīma vindati ॥15॥
5.75.17: aho nāśaṁsase kiñcit puṁstvaṁ klība ivātmani,
5.75.19: anityaṁ kila martyasya pārtha cittaṁ calācalam,
5.75.22: sa dr̥ṣṭvā svāni karmāṇi kule janma ca bhārata,
uttiṣṭhasva viṣādaṁ mā kr̥thā vīra sthiro bhava ॥22॥
5.75.23: na caitadanurūpaṁ te yat te glānirarindama,
yadojasā na labhate kṣatriyo na tadaśnute ॥23॥
5.75.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi bhagavadyānaparvaṇi bhīmottejakaśrīkr̥ṣṇavākye pañcasaptatitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥75॥
5.76.3: vetsi dāśārha satyaṁ me dīrghakālaṁ sahoṣitaḥ,
uta vā māṁ na jānāsi plavan hrada ivāplave ॥3॥
5.76.4: kathaṁ hi bhīmasenaṁ māṁ jānan kaścana mādhava ॥4॥
5.76.6: ātmanaḥ pauruṣaṁ caiva balaṁ ca na samaṁ paraiḥ,
5.76.8: yadīme sahasā kruddhe sameyātāṁ śile iva ॥8॥
5.76.10: ya etat prāpya mucyeta na taṁ paśyāmi pūruṣam,
himavāṁśca samudraśca vajrī vā balabhit svayam ॥10॥
5.76.12: na hi tvaṁ nābhijānāsi mama vikramamacyuta ॥12॥
5.76.13: yathā mayā vinirjitya rājāno vaśagāḥ kr̥tāḥ,
atha cenmāṁ na jānāsi sūryasyevodyataḥ prabhām ॥13॥
5.76.14: vigāḍhe yudhi sambādhe vetsyase māṁ janārdana,
5.76.17: draṣṭā māṁ tvaṁ ca lokaśca vikarṣantaṁ varān varān,
na me sīdanti majjāno na mamodvepate manaḥ ॥17॥
5.76.18: sarvāṁstitikṣe saṅkleśān mā sma no bharatā naśan ॥18॥
5.76.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi bhagavadyānaparvaṇi bhīmasenavākye ṣaṭsaptatitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥76॥
5.77.2: vedāhaṁ tava māhātmyamuta te veda yad balam,
uta te veda karmāṇi na tvāṁ paribhavāmyaham ॥2॥
5.77.6: vināśe’pi sa evāsya sandigdhaṁ karma pauruṣam ॥6॥
5.77.9: śītamuṣṇaṁ tathā varṣaṁ kṣutpipāse ca bhārata ॥9॥
5.77.12: ya evaṁ kr̥tabuddhiḥ sa karmasveva pravartate,
nāsiddhau vyathate tasya na siddhau harṣamaśnute ॥12॥
5.77.16: śamaṁ cet te kariṣyanti tato’nantaṁ yaśo mama,
bhavatāṁ ca kr̥taḥ kāmasteṣāṁ ca śreya uttamam ॥16॥
5.77.18: asmin yuddhe bhīmasena tvayi bhāraḥ samāhitaḥ,
dhūrarjunena dhāryā syād voḍhavya itaro janaḥ ॥18॥
5.77.19: ahaṁ hi yantā bībhatsorbhavitā saṁyuge sati,
dhanañjayasyaiṣa kāmo na hi yuddhaṁ na kāmaye ॥19॥
5.77.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi bhagavadyānaparvaṇi kr̥ṣṇavākye saptasaptatitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥77॥
5.78.1: tava vākyaṁ tu me śrutvā pratibhāti parantapa ॥1॥
5.78.2: naiva praśamamatra tvaṁ manyase sukaraṁ prabho,
lobhād vā dhr̥tarāṣṭrasya dainyād vā samupasthitāt ॥2॥
5.78.4: tadidaṁ bhāṣitaṁ vākyaṁ tathā ca na tathaiva tat,
5.78.5: kurvanti teṣāṁ karmāṇi yeṣāṁ nāsti phalodayaḥ ॥5॥
5.78.6: sampādyamānaṁ samyak ca syāt karma saphalaṁ prabho,
sa tathā kr̥ṣṇa vartasva yathā śarma bhavet paraiḥ ॥6॥
5.78.7: pāṇḍavānāṁ kurūṇāṁ ca bhavān naḥ prathamaḥ suhr̥t,
5.78.9: evaṁ ca kāryatāmeti kāryaṁ tava janārdana,
5.78.10: bhaviṣyati ca tat sarvaṁ yathā tava cikīrṣitam ॥10॥
5.78.11: śarma taiḥ saha vā no’stu tava vā yaccikīrṣitam,
vicāryamāṇo yaḥ kāmastava kr̥ṣṇa sa no guruḥ,
na sa nārhati duṣṭātmā vadhaṁ sasutabāndhavaḥ ॥11॥
5.78.12: yena dharmasute dr̥ṣṭā na sā śrīrupamarṣitā,
5.78.13: kathaṁ hi puruṣo jātaḥ kṣatriyeṣu dhanurdharaḥ ॥13॥
5.78.15: kriyā kathaṁ ca mukhyā syānmr̥dunā cetareṇa vā ॥15॥
5.78.18: sa nāma samyag varteta pāṇḍaveṣviti mādhava,
5.78.19: tasmād yanmanyase yuktaṁ pāṇḍavānāṁ hitaṁ ca yat,
5.79.3: r̥te varṣānna kaunteya jātu nirvartayet phalam,
tatra vai pauruṣaṁ brūyurāsekaṁ yatra kāritam ॥3॥
5.79.5: daive ca mānuṣe caiva saṁyuktaṁ lokakāraṇam,
ahaṁ hi tat kariṣyāmi paraṁ puruṣakārataḥ ॥5॥
5.79.6: daivaṁ tu na mayā śakyaṁ karma kartuṁ kathañcana,
sa hi dharmaṁ ca lokaṁ ca tyaktvā carati durmatiḥ ॥6॥
5.79.7: na hi santapyate tena tathārūpeṇa karmaṇā,
5.79.8: sa hi tyāgena rājyasya na śamaṁ samupaiṣyati ॥8॥
5.79.9: yācyamānaśca rājyaṁ sa na pradāsyati durmatiḥ ॥9॥
5.79.10: na tu manye sa tad vācyo yad yudhiṣṭhiraśāsanam,
uktaṁ prayojanaṁ yat tu dharmarājena bhārata ॥10॥
5.79.11: tathā pāpastu tat sarvaṁ na kariṣyati kauravaḥ,
5.79.12: mama cāpi sa vadhyo hi jagataścāpi bhārata,
yena kaumārake yūyaṁ sarve viprakr̥tāḥ sadā ॥12॥
5.79.13: vipraluptaṁ ca vo rājyaṁ nr̥śaṁsena durātmanā,
na copaśāmyate pāpaḥ śriyaṁ dr̥ṣṭvā yudhiṣṭhire ॥13॥
5.79.14: na mayā tad gr̥hītaṁ ca pāpaṁ tasya cikīrṣitam ॥14॥
5.79.15: jānāsi hi mahābāho tvamapyasya paraṁ matam,
5.79.16: sañjānaṁstasya cātmānaṁ mama caiva paraṁ matam,
5.79.17: vidhānaṁ vihitaṁ pārtha kathaṁ śarma bhavet paraiḥ ॥17॥
5.79.18: yat tu vācā mayā śakyaṁ karmaṇā vāpi pāṇḍava,
kariṣye tadahaṁ pārtha na tvāśaṁse śamaṁ paraiḥ ॥18॥
5.79.19: kathaṁ goharaṇe hyukto naitaccharma tathā hitam,
5.79.20: lavaśaḥ kṣaṇaśaścāpi na ca tuṣṭaḥ suyodhanaḥ ॥20॥
5.79.21: sarvathā tu mayā kāryaṁ dharmarājasya śāsanam,
vibhāvyaṁ tasya bhūyaśca karma pāpaṁ durātmanaḥ ॥21॥
5.79.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi bhagavadyānaparvaṇi śrīkr̥ṣṇavākye ekonāśītitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥79॥
5.80.1: dharmajñena vadānyena śrutaṁ caiva hi tat tvayā ॥1॥
5.80.3: tathaiva phālgunenāpi yaduktaṁ tat tvayā śruvam,
5.80.5: tasmiṁstasmin nimitte hi mataṁ bhavati keśava,
5.80.8: na tathā praṇayo rājye yathā samprati vartate ॥8॥
5.80.10: āttaśastrān raṇe dr̥ṣṭvā na vyathediha kaḥ pumān ॥10॥
5.80.11: sa bhavān kurumadhye taṁ sāntvapūrvaṁ bhayottaram,
brūyād vākyaṁ yathā mando na vyatheta suyodhanaḥ ॥11॥
5.80.12: sahadevaṁ ca māṁ caiva tvāṁ ca rāmaṁ ca keśava ॥12॥
5.80.13: sātyakiṁ ca mahāvīryaṁ virāṭaṁ ca sahātmajam,
drupadaṁ ca sahāmātyaṁ dhr̥ṣṭadyumnaṁ ca mādhava ॥13॥
5.80.14: kāśirājaṁ ca vikrāntaṁ dhr̥ṣṭaketuṁ ca cedipam,
5.80.18: śrotā cārthasya vidurastvaṁ ca vaktā janārdana,
5.80.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi bhagavadyānaparvaṇi nakulavākye aśītitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥80॥
5.81.1: yadetat kathitaṁ rājñā dharma eṣa sanātanaḥ,
yathā ca yuddhameva syāt tathā kāryamarindama ॥1॥
5.81.2: tathāpi yuddhaṁ dāśārha yojayethāḥ sahaiva taiḥ ॥2॥
5.81.3: kathaṁ nu dr̥ṣṭvā pāñcālīṁ tathā kr̥ṣṇa sabhāgatām,
5.81.6: na jānāsi yathā dr̥ṣṭvā cīrājinadharān vane,
5.81.8: evaṁ vadati vākyaṁ tu yuyudhāne mahāmatau,
5.81.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi bhagavadyānaparvaṇi sahadevasātyakivākye ekāśītitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥81॥
5.82.2: sampūjya sahadevaṁ ca sātyakiṁ ca mahāratham ॥2॥
5.82.5: yathā ca sañjayo rājñā mantraṁ rahasi śrāvitaḥ ॥5॥
5.82.6: yathoktaḥ sañjayaścaiva tacca sarvaṁ śrutaṁ tvayā ॥6॥
5.82.7: pañca nastāta dīyantāṁ grāmā iti mahādyute,
5.82.9: na cāpi hyakarod vākyaṁ śrutvā kr̥ṣṇa suyodhanaḥ,
5.82.11: śakṣyanti hi mahābāho pāṇḍavāḥ sr̥ñjayaiḥ saha,
5.82.12: na hi sāmnā na dānena śakyo’rthasteṣu kaścana,
tasmāt teṣu na kartavyā kr̥pā te madhusūdana ॥12॥
5.82.13: sāmnā dānena vā kr̥ṣṇa ye na śāmyanti śatravaḥ,
5.82.14: tvayā caiva mahābāho pāṇḍavaiḥ saha sr̥ñjayaiḥ ॥14॥
5.82.15: etat samarthaṁ pārthānāṁ tava caiva yaśaskaram,
kriyamāṇaṁ bhavet kr̥ṣṇa kṣatrasya ca sukhāvaham ॥15॥
5.82.18: sa vadhyasyāvadhe dr̥ṣṭa iti dharmavido viduḥ ॥18॥
5.82.19: yathā tvāṁ na spr̥śedeṣa doṣaḥ kr̥ṣṇa tathā kuru,
5.82.20: kā tu sīmantinī mādr̥k pr̥thivyāmasti keśava ॥20॥
5.82.21: dhr̥ṣṭadyumnasya bhaginī tava kr̥ṣṇa priyā sakhī ॥21॥
5.82.23: sutā me pañcabhirvīraiḥ pañca jātā mahārathāḥ,
abhimanyuryathā kr̥ṣṇa tathā te tava dharmataḥ ॥23॥
5.82.24: sāhaṁ keśagrahaṁ prāptā parikliṣṭā sabhāṁ gatā,
5.82.26: pāhi māmiti govinda manasā cintito’si me ॥26॥
5.82.27: yatra māṁ bhagavān rājā śvaśuro vākyamabravīt,
varaṁ vr̥ṇīṣva pāñcāli varārhāsi matā mama ॥27॥
5.82.28: adāsāḥ pāṇḍavāḥ santu sarathāḥ sāyudhā iti,
5.82.30: snuṣā bhavāmi dharmeṇa sāhaṁ dāsīkr̥tā balāt ॥30॥
5.82.31: dhik pārthasya dhanuṣmattāṁ bhīmasenasya dhig balam,
5.82.32: yadi te’hamanugrāhyā yadi te’sti kr̥pā mayi,
dhārtarāṣṭreṣu vai kopaḥ sarvaḥ kr̥ṣṇa vidhīyatām ॥32॥
5.82.37: pitā me yotsyate vr̥ddhaḥ saha putrairmahārathaiḥ ॥37॥
5.82.38: pañca caiva mahāvīryāḥ putrā me madhusūdana,
5.82.39: yadyahaṁ tu na paśyāmi kā śāntirhr̥dayasya me ॥39॥
5.82.40: trayodaśa hi varṣāṇi pratīkṣantyā gatāni me,
5.82.46: ahaṁ ca tat kariṣyāmi bhīmārjunayamaiḥ saha,
5.82.47: dhārtarāṣṭrāḥ kālapakvā na cecchr̥ṇvanti me vacaḥ,
5.82.48: dyauḥ patecca sanakṣatrā na me moghaṁ vaco bhavet ॥48॥
5.82.49: satyaṁ te pratijānāmi kr̥ṣṇe bāṣpo nigr̥hyatām,
5.82.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi bhagavadyānaparvaṇi draupadīkr̥ṣṇasaṁvāde dvyaśītitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥82॥
5.83.3: śāntyarthaṁ bhrātaraṁ brūyā yat tad vācyamamitrahan ॥3॥
5.83.12: ratha āropyatāṁ śaṅkhaścakraṁ ca gadayā saha,
5.83.29: pūjitaḥ prayayau kr̥ṣṇaḥ kurūṇāṁ sadanaṁ prati ॥29॥
5.83.34: yo vai na kāmānna bhayānna lobhānnārthakāraṇāt,
5.83.40: asmatkr̥te ca satataṁ yayā duḥkhāni mādhava,
5.83.43: api jātu sa kālaḥ syāt kr̥ṣṇa duḥkhaviparyayaḥ,
5.83.45: na nūnaṁ mriyate duḥkhaiḥ sā cejjīvati keśava,
5.83.46: abhivādyātha sā kr̥ṣṇa tvayā madvacanād vibho,
5.83.47: bhīṣmaṁ droṇaṁ kr̥paṁ caiva mahārājaṁ ca bāhlikam,
drauṇiṁ ca somadattaṁ ca sarvāṁśca bharatān prati ॥47॥
5.83.51: yadasmākaṁ vibho vr̥ttaṁ purā vai mantraniścaye,
5.83.52: priyaṁ me syānmahābāho mucyeran mahato bhayāt ॥52॥
5.83.56: tasya taṁ ninadaṁ śrutvā samprāvepanta dhanvinaḥ,
5.83.57: ityuktvā keśavaṁ tatra tathā coktvā viniścayam,
5.83.62: brāhmaṇānāṁ trayo varṇāḥ kaccit tiṣṭhanti śāsane ॥62॥
5.83.63: tebhyaḥ prayujya tāṁ pūjāṁ provāca madhusūdanaḥ,
bhagavantaḥ kva saṁsiddhāḥ kā vīthī bhavatāmiha ॥63॥
5.83.64: kiṁ vā kāryaṁ bhagavatāmahaṁ kiṁ karavāṇi vaḥ,
5.83.64d2: adhaḥśirāḥ sarpamālī maharṣiḥ sa hi devalaḥ,
5.83.70: tvaṁ ca yādavaśārdūla sabhāyāṁ vai sameṣyatha,
tava vākyāni divyāni tathā teṣāṁ ca mādhava ॥70॥
5.83.71: śrotumicchāma govinda satyāni ca hitāni ca,
5.83.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi bhagavadyānaparvaṇi śrīkr̥ṣṇaprasthāne tryaśītitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥83॥
5.84.2: padātīnāṁ sahasraṁ ca sādināṁ ca parantapa,
bhojyaṁ ca vipulaṁ rājan preṣyāśca śataśo’pare ॥2॥
5.84.4: tāni me śr̥ṇu sarvāṇi daivānyautpātikāni ca ॥4॥
5.84.5: anvageva ca parjanyaḥ prāvarṣad vighane bhr̥śam ॥5॥
5.84.6: viparītā diśaḥ sarvā na prājñāyata kiñcana ॥6॥
5.84.8: na diśo nādiśo rājan prajñāyante sma reṇunā ॥8॥
5.84.11: yatra yatra ca vārṣṇeyo vartate pathi bhārata,
tatra tatra sukho vāyuḥ sarvaṁ cāsīt pradakṣiṇam ॥11॥
5.84.12: vavarṣa puṣpavarṣaṁ ca kamalāni ca bhūriśaḥ,
5.84.14: taṁ kiranti mahātmānaṁ vanyaiḥ puṣpaiḥ sugandhibhiḥ,
5.84.16: purāṇi ca vyatikrāman rāṣṭrāṇi vividhāni ca ॥16॥
5.84.21: avatīrya rathāt tūrṇaṁ kr̥tvā śaucaṁ yathāvidhi,
5.84.22: dāruko’pi hayān muktvā paricarya ca śāstrataḥ,
5.84.25: tasmin grāme pradhānāstu ya āsan brāhmaṇā nr̥pa,
5.84.28: tān prabhuḥ kr̥tamityuktvā satkr̥tya ca yathārhataḥ,
abhyetya caiṣāṁ veśmāni punarāyāt sahaiva taiḥ ॥28॥
5.84.29: bhuktvā ca saha taiḥ sarvairavasat tāṁ kṣapāṁ sukham ॥29॥
5.84.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi bhagavadyānaparvaṇi śrīkr̥ṣṇaprayāṇe caturaśītitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥84॥
5.85.2: droṇaṁ ca sañjayaṁ caiva viduraṁ ca mahāmatim,
5.85.3: striyo bālāśca vr̥ddhāśca kathayanti gr̥he gr̥he ॥3॥
5.85.5: sa no mānyaśca pūjyaśca sarvathā madhusūdanaḥ ॥5॥
5.85.6: tasmin hi yātrā lokasya bhūtānāmīśvaro hi saḥ,
tasmin dhr̥tiśca vīryaṁ ca prajñā caujaśca mādhave ॥6॥
5.85.7: sa mānyatāṁ naraśreṣṭhaḥ sa hi dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ,
5.85.10: yathā prītirmahābāho tvayi jāyeta tasya vai,
tathā kuruṣva gāndhāre kathaṁ vā bhīṣma manyase ॥10॥
5.85.15: mālyāni ca sugandhīni tāni rājā dadau tataḥ ॥15॥
5.85.18: tāḥ sabhāḥ keśavaḥ sarvā ratnāni vividhāni ca,
5.85.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi bhagavadyānaparvaṇi mārge sabhānirmāṇe pañcāśītitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥85॥
5.86.3: sphītasya vr̥ṣṇirāṣṭrasya bhartā goptā ca mādhavaḥ,
5.86.4: ādityā vasavo rudrā yathā buddhiṁ br̥haspateḥ ॥4॥
5.86.5: pratyakṣaṁ tava dharmajña tāṁ me kathayataḥ śr̥ṇu ॥5॥
5.86.11: divā rātrau ca bhātyeṣa sutejā vimalo maṇiḥ,
5.86.21: sarvamasmin gr̥he ratnaṁ mama duryodhanasya ca,
5.86.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi bhagavadyānaparvaṇi dhr̥tarāṣṭravākye ṣaḍaśītitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥86॥
5.87.2: yat tvamevaṅgate brūyāḥ paścime vayasi sthitaḥ,
śāstrād vā supratarkād vā susthiraḥ sthaviro hyasi ॥2॥
5.87.3: lekhā śaśini bhāḥ sūrye mahormiriva sāgare,
5.87.5: ārjavaṁ pratipadyasva mā bālyād bahu nīnaśaḥ,
5.87.7: na tu tvaṁ dharmamuddiśya tasya vā priyakāraṇāt,
5.87.8: jānāmi tvanmataṁ rājan gūḍhaṁ bāhyena karmaṇā ॥8॥
5.87.9: pañca pañcaiva lipsanti grāmakān pāṇḍavā nr̥pa,
na ca ditsasi tebhyastāṁstacchamaṁ na kariṣyasi ॥9॥
5.87.10: arthena tu mahābāhuṁ vārṣṇeyaṁ tvaṁ jihīrṣasi,
5.87.11: na ca vittena śakyo’sau nodyamena na garhayā,
anyo dhanañjayāt kartumetat tattvaṁ bravīmi te ॥11॥
5.87.16: pāṇḍavānāṁ ca rājendra tadasya vacanaṁ kuru ॥16॥
5.87.17: pitāsi rājan putrāste vr̥ddhastvaṁ śiśavaḥ pare,
vartasva pitr̥vat teṣu vartante te hi putravat ॥17॥
5.87.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi bhagavadyānaparvaṇi viduravākye saptāśītitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥87॥
5.88.1: yadāha viduraḥ kr̥ṣṇe sarvaṁ tat satyamacyute,
5.88.2: yat tat satkārasaṁyuktaṁ deyaṁ vasu janārdane,
anekarūpaṁ rājendra na tad deyaṁ kadācana ॥2॥
5.88.3: deśaḥ kālastathāyukto na hi nārhati keśavaḥ,
5.88.4: na tat kuryād budhaḥ kāryamiti me niścitā matiḥ ॥4॥
5.88.5: sa hi pūjyatamo loke kr̥ṣṇaḥ pr̥thulalocanaḥ,
5.88.6: na tu tasmai pradeyaṁ syāt tathā kāryagatiḥ prabho,
5.88.7: tasya tad vacanaṁ śrutvā bhīṣmaḥ kurupitāmahaḥ,
5.88.9: yat tu kāryaṁ mahābāho manasā kāryatāṁ gatam,
5.88.11: dharmyamarthyaṁ ca dharmātmā dhruvaṁ vaktā janārdanaḥ,
tasmin vācyāḥ priyā vāco bhavatā bāndhavaiḥ saha ॥11॥
5.88.12: na paryāyo’sti yad rājan śriyaṁ niṣkevalāmaham,
5.88.13: idaṁ tu sumahat kāryaṁ śr̥ṇu me yat samarthitam,
5.88.14: tasmin baddhe bhaviṣyanti vr̥ṣṇayaḥ pr̥thivī tathā,
pāṇḍavāśca vidheyā me sa ca prātarihaiṣyati ॥14॥
5.88.15: atropāyān yathā samyaṅ na buddhyeta janārdanaḥ,
na cāpāyo bhavet kaścit tad bhavān prabravītu me ॥15॥
5.88.16: tasya tad vacanaṁ śrutvā ghoraṁ kr̥ṣṇābhisaṁhitam,
5.88.17: maivaṁ vocaḥ prajāpāla naiṣa dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ ॥17॥
5.88.18: dūtaśca hi hr̥ṣīkeśaḥ sambandhī ca priyaśca naḥ,
5.88.21: tava putraḥ sahāmātyaḥ kṣaṇena na bhaviṣyati ॥21॥
5.88.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi bhagavadyānaparvaṇi duryodhanavākye aṣṭāśītitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥88॥
5.89.7: na ca kaścid gr̥he rājaṁstadā’’sīd bharatarṣabha,
na strī na vr̥ddho na śiśurvāsudevadidr̥kṣayā ॥7॥
5.89.17: atha droṇaṁ sabāhlīkaṁ saputraṁ ca yaśasvinam,
kr̥paṁ ca somadattaṁ ca samīyāya janārdanaḥ ॥17॥
5.89.19: atha gāṁ madhuparkaṁ cāpyudakaṁ ca janārdane,
5.89.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi bhagavadyānaparvaṇi dhr̥tarāṣṭragr̥hapraveśapūrvakaṁ śrīkr̥ṣṇasya viduragr̥hapraveśe ekonanavatitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥89॥
5.90.2: kaṇṭhe gr̥hītvā prākrośat smarantī tanayān pr̥thā ॥2॥
5.90.5: ye te bālyāt prabhr̥tyeva guruśuśrūṣaṇe ratāḥ,
5.90.7: ahārṣuśca vanaṁ yāntaḥ samūlaṁ hr̥dayaṁ mama,
5.90.8: bālā vihīnāḥ pitrā te mayā satatalālitāḥ ॥8॥
5.90.10: ye sma vāraṇaśabdena hayānāṁ hreṣitena ca ॥10॥
5.90.14: krūraṁ ca ninadaṁ śrutvā śvāpadānāṁ mahāvane ॥14॥
5.90.15: na smopayānti nidrāṁ te na tadarhā janārdana,
5.90.22: sāmarṣaḥ pāṇḍavo nityaṁ priyo bhrātuḥ priyaṅkaraḥ ॥22॥
5.90.23: śūraḥ krodhavaśānāṁ ca hiḍimbasya bakasya ca ॥23॥
5.90.25: krodhaṁ balamamarṣaṁ ca yo nidhāya parantapaḥ,
5.90.27: āste parighabāhuḥ sa madhyamaḥ pāṇḍavo balī ॥27॥
5.90.33: yaṁ gatvābhimukhaḥ saṅkhye na jīvan kaścidāvrajet,
5.90.34: sa te bhrātā sakhā caiva kathamadya dhanañjayaḥ ॥34॥
5.90.38: śuśrūṣuṁ mama vārṣṇeya mādrīputraṁ pracakṣva me ॥38॥
5.90.39: bhrātr̥̄ṇāṁ caiva sarveṣāṁ priyaḥ prāṇo bahiścaraḥ ॥39॥
5.90.40: kaccit sakuśalī kr̥ṣṇa vatso mama sukhaidhitaḥ ॥40॥
5.90.41: api jātu mahābāho paśyeyaṁ nakulaṁ punaḥ ॥41॥
5.90.42: na labhāmi dhr̥tiṁ vīra sādya jīvāmi paśya mām ॥42॥
5.90.43: sarvaiḥ putraiḥ priyatarā draupadī me janārdana,
5.90.48: na nūnaṁ karmabhiḥ puṇyairaśnute puruṣaḥ sukham,
5.90.49: na priyo mama kr̥ṣṇāyā bībhatsurna yudhiṣṭhiraḥ,
5.90.50: na me duḥkhataraṁ kiñcid bhūtapūrvaṁ tato’dhikam,
5.90.53: vr̥ttena hi bhavatyāryo na dhanena na vidyayā ॥53॥
5.90.55: sā śokārtā ca hr̥ṣṭā ca dr̥ṣṭvā govindamāgatam,
5.90.57: tanmāṁ dahati yat kr̥ṣṇā sabhāyāṁ kurusaṁnidhau,
dhārtarāṣṭraiḥ parikliṣṭā yathā na kuśalaṁ tathā ॥57॥
5.90.58: nirvāsanaṁ ca nagarāt pravrajyā ca parantapa,
5.90.59: na me kleśatamaṁ tat syāt putraiḥ saha parantapa ॥59॥
5.90.60: duḥkhādapi sukhaṁ naḥ syād yadi puṇyaphalakṣayaḥ ॥60॥
5.90.61: na me viśeṣo jātvāsīd dhārtarāṣṭreṣu pāṇḍavaiḥ,
tena satyena kr̥ṣṇa tvāṁ hatāmitraṁ śriyā vr̥tam,
asmād vimuktaṁ saṅgrāmāt paśyeyaṁ pāṇḍavaiḥ saha ॥61॥
5.90.62: naiva śakyāḥ parājetuṁ sarvaṁ hyeṣāṁ tathāvidham,
pitaraṁ tveva garheyaṁ nātmānaṁ na suyodhanam ॥62॥
5.90.64: adāt tu kuntibhojāya sakhā sakhye mahātmane,
sāhaṁ pitrā ca nikr̥tā śvaśuraiśca parantapa,
5.90.65: putraste pr̥thivīṁ jetā yaśaścāsya divaṁ spr̥śet ॥65॥
5.90.66: hatvā kurūn mahājanye rājyaṁ prāpya dhanañjayaḥ,
5.90.67: kr̥ṣṇāya mahate nityaṁ dharmo dhārayati prajāḥ ॥67॥
5.90.68: tvaṁ cāpi tat tathā kr̥ṣṇa sarvaṁ sampādayiṣyasi ॥68॥
5.90.69: na māṁ mādhava vaidhavyaṁ nārthanāśo na vairatā,
5.90.70: dhanañjayaṁ na paśyāmi kā śāntirhr̥dayasya me ॥70॥
5.90.71: dhanañjayaṁ ca govinda yamau taṁ ca vr̥kodaram ॥71॥
5.90.73: bhūyāṁste hīyate dharmo mā putraka vr̥thā kr̥thāḥ ॥73॥
5.90.74: parāśrayā vāsudeva yā jīvati dhigastu tām,
5.90.77: nr̥śaṁsena ca vo yuktāṁstyajeyaṁ śāśvatīḥ samāḥ,
5.90.80: arjunaṁ pāṇḍavaṁ vīraṁ draupadyāḥ padavīṁ cara ॥80॥
5.90.81: viditau hi tavātyantaṁ kruddhau tau tu yathāntakau,
bhīmārjunau nayetāṁ hi devānapi parāṁ gatim ॥81॥
5.90.82: tayoścaitadavajñānaṁ yat sā kr̥ṣṇā sabhāṁ gatā,
5.90.83: paśyatāṁ kurumukhyānāṁ tasya drakṣyati yat phalam ॥83॥
5.90.84: na hi vairaṁ samāsādya praśāmyati vr̥kodaraḥ,
sucirādapi bhīmasya na hi vairaṁ praśāmyati,
5.90.85: na duḥkhaṁ rājyaharaṇaṁ na ca dyūte parājayaḥ,
pravrājanaṁ tu putrāṇāṁ na me tad duḥkhakāraṇam ॥85॥
5.90.86: yat tu sā br̥hatī śyāmā ekavastrā sabhāṁ gatā,
aśr̥ṇot paruṣā vācaḥ kiṁ nu duḥkhataraṁ tataḥ ॥86॥
5.90.87: nābhyagacchat tadā nāthaṁ kr̥ṣṇā nāthavatī satī ॥87॥
5.90.91: kā tu sīmantinī tvādr̥k lokeṣvasti pitr̥ṣvasaḥ,
5.90.94: etāni pārthā nirjitya nityaṁ vīrasukhe ratāḥ ॥94॥
5.90.97: anteṣu remire dhīrā na te madhyeṣu remire,
5.90.101: yad yat teṣāṁ mahābāho pathyaṁ syānmadhusūdana,
yathā yathā tvaṁ manyethāḥ kuryāḥ kr̥ṣṇa tathā tathā ॥101॥
5.90.103: tvameva naḥ kule dharmastvaṁ satya tvaṁ tapo mahat ॥103॥
5.90.104: tvaṁ trātā tvaṁ mahad brahma tvayi sarvaṁ pratiṣṭhitam,
5.90.104d2: prabhāvo buddhivīryaṁ ca tādr̥śaṁ tava keśava,
5.90.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi bhagavadyānaparvaṇi kr̥ṣṇakuntīsaṁvāde navatitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥90॥
5.91.5: duḥśāsanaṁ ca karṇaṁ ca śakuniṁ cāpi saubalam ॥5॥
5.91.9: tasmin gāṁ madhuparkaṁ cāpyudakaṁ ca janārdane ॥9॥
5.91.10: nivedayāmāsa tadā gr̥hān rājyaṁ ca kauravaḥ,
5.91.11: tato duryodhano rājā vārṣṇeyaṁ jayatāṁ varam ॥11॥
5.91.15: tvaṁ hi govinda dharmārthau vettha tattvena sarvaśaḥ,
5.91.18: kr̥tārthā bhuñjate dūtāḥ pūjāṁ gr̥hṇanti caiva ha,
5.91.20: kr̥tārthaṁ vākr̥tārthaṁ ca tvāṁ vayaṁ madhusūdana,
yatāmahe pūjayituṁ dāśārha na ca śaknumaḥ ॥20॥
5.91.21: na ca tat kāraṇaṁ vidmo yasmin no madhusūdana,
5.91.22: vairaṁ no nāsti bhavatā govinda na ca vigrahaḥ,
5.91.24: na hetuvādāllobhād vā dharmaṁ jahyāṁ kathañcana ॥24॥
5.91.25: na ca samprīyase rājan na caivāpadgatā vayam ॥25॥
5.91.26: akasmād dveṣṭi vai rājan janmaprabhr̥ti pāṇḍavān,
5.91.27: dharme sthitāḥ pāṇḍaveyāḥ kastān kiṁ vaktumarhati ॥27॥
5.91.28: yastān dveṣṭi sa māṁ dveṣṭi yastānanu sa māmanu,
5.91.29: guṇavantaṁ ca yo dveṣṭi tamāhuḥ puruṣādhamam ॥29॥
5.91.31d1: dviṣadannaṁ na bhoktavyaṁ dviṣantaṁ naiva bhojayet,
pāṇḍavān dviṣase rājan mama prāṇā hi pāṇḍavāḥ.
5.91.37: sarve bhavanto gacchantu sarvā me’pacitiḥ kr̥tā ॥37॥
5.91.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi bhagavadyānaparvaṇi śrīkr̥ṣṇaduryodhanasaṁvāde ekanavatitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥91॥
5.92.7: bhīṣme droṇe kr̥pe karṇe droṇaputre jayadrathe,
bhūyasīṁ vartate vr̥ttiṁ na śame kurute manaḥ ॥7॥
5.92.10: ekaḥ karṇaḥ parāñjetuṁ samartha iti niścitam,
5.92.13: yatra sūktaṁ duruktaṁ ca samaṁ syānmadhusūdana,
na tatra pralapet prājño badhireṣviva gāyanaḥ ॥13॥
5.92.14: na tvaṁ vākyaṁ bruvan yuktaścāṇḍāleṣu dvijo yathā ॥14॥
5.92.15: so’yaṁ balastho mūḍhaśca na kariṣyati te vacaḥ,
5.92.16: tava madhyāvataraṇaṁ mama kr̥ṣṇa na rocate ॥16॥
5.92.17: pratīpaṁ vacanaṁ madhye tava kr̥ṣṇa na rocate ॥17॥
5.92.19: tvayyasya mahatī śaṅkā na kariṣyati te vacaḥ ॥19॥
5.92.28: prabhāvaṁ pauruṣaṁ buddhiṁ jānāmi tava śatruhan ॥28॥
5.92.29: yā me prītiḥ pāṇḍaveṣu bhūyaḥ sā tvayi mādhava,
5.92.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi bhagavadyānaparvaṇi śrīkr̥ṣṇavidurasaṁvāde dvinavatitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥92॥
5.93.3: satyaṁ prāptaṁ ca yuktaṁ vāpyevameva yathā’’ttha mām,
5.93.6: dharmakāryaṁ yatañchaktyā no cet prāpnoti mānavaḥ,
prāpto bhavati tat puṇyamatra me nāsti saṁśayaḥ ॥6॥
5.93.7: na prāpnoti phalaṁ tasyetyevaṁ dharmavido viduḥ ॥7॥
5.93.10: vyasane kliśyamānaṁ hi yo mitraṁ nābhipadyate,
5.93.12: tat samarthaṁ śubhaṁ vākyaṁ dharmārthasahitaṁ hitam,
5.93.13: hitaṁ hi dhārtarāṣṭrāṇāṁ pāṇḍavānāṁ tathaiva ca,
5.93.14: hite prayatamānaṁ māṁ śaṅked duryodhano yadi,
hr̥dayasya ca me prītirānr̥ṇyaṁ ca bhaviṣyati ॥14॥
5.93.15: jñātīnāṁ hi mitho bhede yanmitraṁ nābhipadyate,
5.93.21: na cāpi mama paryāptāḥ sahitāḥ sarvapārthivāḥ,
5.93.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi bhagavadyānaparvaṇi śrīkr̥ṣṇavākye trinavatitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥93॥
5.94.18: sātyakiḥ kr̥tavarmā ca vr̥ṣṇīnāṁ cāpare rathāḥ,
5.94.21: śaṅkhāśca dadhmire tatra vādyānyanyāni yāni ca ॥21॥
5.94.27: sa pūjyamānaḥ kurubhiḥ saṁśr̥ṇvan madhurāḥ kathāḥ,
5.94.33: pāṇau gr̥hītvā viduraṁ sātyakiṁ ca mahāyaśāḥ,
5.94.41: tatra tiṣṭhan sa dāśārho rājamadhye parantapaḥ,
5.94.51: cirasya dr̥ṣṭvā dāśārhaṁ rājānaḥ sarva eva te ॥51॥
5.94.54: na tatra kaścit kiñcid vā vyājahāra pumān kvacit ॥54॥
5.94.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi bhagavadyānaparvaṇi śrīkr̥ṣṇasabhāpraveśe caturnavatitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥94॥
5.95.2: jīmūta iva gharmānte sarvāṁ saṁśrāvayan sabhām,
5.95.3: kurūṇāṁ pāṇḍavānāṁ ca śamaḥ syāditi bhārata,
5.95.4: rājan nānyat pravaktavyaṁ tava naiḥśreyasaṁ vacaḥ,
5.95.5: idaṁ hyadya kulaṁ śreṣṭhaṁ sarvarājasu pārthiva,
5.95.8: tvaṁ hi dhārayitā śreṣṭhaḥ kurūṇāṁ kurusattama,
5.95.10: sveṣu bandhuṣu mukhyeṣu tad vettha puruṣarṣabha ॥10॥
5.95.12: śakyā ceyaṁ śamayituṁ tvaṁ cedicchasi bhārata,
na duṣkaro hyatra śamo mato me bharatarṣabha ॥12॥
5.95.13: tvayyadhīnaḥ śamo rājan mayi caiva viśāmpate,
5.95.14: ājñā tava hi rājendra kāryā putraiḥ sahānvayaiḥ,
5.95.15: tava caiva hitaṁ rājan pāṇḍavānāmatho hitam,
5.95.18: na hi tvāṁ pāṇḍavairjetuṁ rakṣyamāṇaṁ mahātmabhiḥ,
indro’pi devaiḥ sahitaḥ prasaheta kuto nr̥paḥ ॥18॥
5.95.19: yatra bhīṣmaśca droṇaśca kr̥paḥ karṇo viviṁśatiḥ,
5.95.21: ko nu tān viparītātmā yuddhyeta bharatarṣabha ॥21॥
5.95.24: suhr̥dbhiḥ sarvato guptaḥ sukhaṁ śakṣyasi jīvitum ॥24॥
5.95.25: etāneva purodhāya satkr̥tya ca yathā purā,
5.95.26: etairhi sahitaḥ sarvaiḥ pāṇḍavaiḥ svaiśca bhārata,
5.95.28: saṁyuge vai mahārāja dr̥śyate sumahān kṣayaḥ,
5.95.29: yad vindethāḥ sukhaṁ rājaṁstad brūhi bharatarṣabha ॥29॥
5.95.31: na paśyema kurūn sarvān pāṇḍavāṁścaiva saṁyuge,
5.95.33: trāhi rājannimaṁ lokaṁ na naśyeyurimāḥ prajāḥ,
5.95.35: saha bhuktvā ca pītvā ca pratiyāntu yathāgr̥ham ॥35॥
5.95.36: amarṣaṁ ca nirākr̥tya vairāṇi ca parantapa ॥36॥
5.95.38: bālā vihīnāḥ pitrā te tvayaiva parivardhitāḥ,
5.95.42: sthātā naḥ samaye tasmin piteti kr̥taniścayāḥ,
nāhāsma samayaṁ tāta tacca no brāhmaṇā viduḥ ॥42॥
5.95.43: tasmin naḥ samaye tiṣṭha sthitānāṁ bharatarṣabha,
5.95.46: vartāmahe tvayi ca tāṁ tvaṁ ca vartasva nastathā,
5.95.48: yatra dharmo hyadharmeṇa satyaṁ yatrānr̥tena ca ॥48॥
5.95.49: viddho dharmo hyadharmeṇa sabhāṁ yatra prapadyate ॥49॥
5.95.50: na cāsya śalyaṁ kr̥ntanti viddhāstatra sabhāsadaḥ,
5.95.51: te satyamāhurdharmyaṁ ca nyāyyaṁ ca bharatarṣabha ॥51॥
5.95.52: bruvantu te mahīpālāḥ sabhāyāṁ ye samāsate ॥52॥
5.95.55: tataḥ saputraḥ siddhārtho bhuṅkṣva bhogān parantapa,
ajātaśatruṁ jānīṣe sthitaṁ dharme satāṁ sadā ॥55॥
5.95.56: saputre tvayi vr̥ttiṁ ca vartate yāṁ narādhipa,
5.95.57: sa tatra vivasan sarvān vaśamānīya pārthivān ॥57॥
5.95.59: sa tāmavasthāṁ samprāpya kr̥ṣṇāṁ prekṣya sabhāgatām ॥59॥
5.95.60: ahaṁ tu tava teṣāṁ ca śreya icchāmi bhārata ॥60॥
5.95.61: dharmādarthāt sukhāccaiva mā rājan nīnaśaḥ prajāḥ,
5.95.63: tad vākyaṁ pārthivāḥ sarve hr̥dayaiḥ samapūjayan,
na tatra kaścid vaktuṁ hi vācaṁ prākrāmadagrataḥ ॥63॥
5.96.2: iti sarve manobhiste cintayanti sma pārthivāḥ ॥2॥
5.96.3: tathā teṣu ca sarveṣu tūṣṇīmbhūteṣu rājasu,
5.96.4: imāṁ me sopamāṁ vācaṁ śr̥ṇu satyāmaśaṅkitaḥ,
tāṁ śrutvā śreya ādatsva yadi sādhviti manyase ॥4॥
5.96.5: akhilāṁ bubhuje sarvāṁ pr̥thivīmiti naḥ śrutam ॥5॥
5.96.6: sa sma nityaṁ niśāpāye prātarutthāya vīryavān,
5.96.7: asti kaścid viśiṣṭo vā madvidho vā bhaved yudhi,
śūdro vaiśyaḥ kṣatriyo vā brāhmaṇo vāpi śastrabhr̥t ॥7॥
5.96.9: taṁ ca vaidyā akr̥paṇā brāhmaṇāḥ sarvato’bhayāḥ,
5.96.12: tayostvaṁ na samo rājan bhavitāsi kadācana ॥12॥
5.96.13: evamuktaḥ sa rājā tu punaḥ papraccha tān dvijān,
kva tau vīrau kvajanmānau kiṅkarmāṇau ca kau ca tau ॥13॥
5.96.14: āyātau mānuṣe loke tābhyāṁ yudhyasva pārthiva ॥14॥
5.96.16: sa rājā mahatīṁ senāṁ yojayitvā ṣaḍaṅginīm,
5.96.17: sa gatvā viṣamaṁ ghoraṁ parvataṁ gandhamādanam,
5.96.22: ātithyaṁ dīyatāmetat kāṅkṣitaṁ me ciraṁ prati,
5.96.23: na hyasminnāśrame yuddhaṁ kutaḥ śastraṁ kuto’nr̥juḥ,
5.96.26d1: saṁnahyasva ca varmāṇi yāni cānyāni santi te,
5.96.27: ahaṁ hi te vineṣyāmi yuddhaśraddhāmitaḥ param,
5.96.34: brahmaṇyo bhava dharmātmā mā ca smaivaṁ punaḥ kr̥thāḥ,
5.96.35: mā ca darpasamāviṣṭaḥ kṣepsīḥ kāṁścit kathañcana ॥35॥
5.96.36: alpīyāṁsaṁ viśiṣṭaṁ vā tat te rājan samāhitam,
5.96.37: dāntaḥ kṣānto mr̥duḥ saumyaḥ prajāḥ pālaya pārthiva,
mā sma bhūyaḥ kṣipeḥ kañcidaviditvā balābalam ॥37॥
5.96.38: anujñātaḥ svasti gaccha maivaṁ bhūyaḥ samācareḥ,
5.96.40: sumahaccāpi tat karma tannareṇa kr̥taṁ purā,
5.96.41: tasmād yāvad dhanuḥśreṣṭhe gāṇḍīve’straṁ na yujyate,
tāvat tvaṁ mānamutsr̥jya gaccha rājan dhanañjayam ॥41॥
5.96.43: etairviddhāḥ sarva eva maraṇaṁ yānti mānavāḥ,
5.96.45: svapanti ca plavante ca chardayanti ca mānavāḥ,
mūtrayante ca satataṁ rudanti ca hasanti ca ॥45॥
5.96.47: vīraṁ kapidhvajaṁ jiṣṇuṁ yasya nāsti samo yudhi ॥47॥
5.96.50: āryāṁ matiṁ samāsthāya śāmya bhārata pāṇḍavaiḥ ॥50॥
5.96.51: atha cenmanyase śreyo na me bhedo bhavediti,
praśāmya bharataśreṣṭha mā ca yuddhe manaḥ kr̥thāḥ ॥51॥
5.96.52: bhavatāṁ ca kuruśreṣṭha kulaṁ bahumataṁ bhuvi,
5.96.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi bhagavadyānaparvaṇi dambhodbhavopākhyāne ṣaṇṇavatitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥96॥
5.97.5: te ca kṣayānte jagato hitvā lokatrayaṁ sadā,
kṣayaṁ gacchanti vai sarve sr̥jyante ca punaḥ punaḥ ॥5॥
5.97.7: bhūyiṣṭhena tu rājānaḥ śriyaṁ bhuktvā’’yuṣaḥ kṣaye,
5.97.10: na balaṁ balināṁ madhye balaṁ bhavati kaurava,
balavanto hi te sarve pāṇḍavā devavikramāḥ ॥10॥
5.97.13: śriyā ca vapuṣā caiva striyo’nyāḥ sātiricyate ॥13॥
5.97.16: mātuḥ kulaṁ pitr̥kulaṁ yatra caiva pradīyate,
5.97.17: avagāhyaiva vicitau na ca me rocate varaḥ ॥17॥
5.97.18: na devān naiva ditijān na gandharvān na mānuṣān,
5.97.19: bhāryayānu sa sammantrya saha rātrau sudharmayā,
5.97.20: na me devamanuṣyeṣu guṇakeśyāḥ samo varaḥ,
5.97.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi bhagavadyānaparvaṇi mātalivarānveṣaṇe saptanavatitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥97॥
5.98.2: svena vā sūta kāryeṇa śāsanād vā śatakratoḥ ॥2॥
5.98.5: dr̥ṣṭvā tatra varaṁ kañcid rocayiṣyāva mātale ॥5॥
5.98.7: tatra devarṣisadr̥śīṁ pūjāṁ sa prāpa nāradaḥ,
5.98.11: eṣa vai śīlavr̥ttena śaucena ca viśiṣyate ॥11॥
5.98.13: adityāścaiva yaḥ putro jyeṣṭhaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ kr̥taḥ smr̥taḥ ॥13॥
5.98.14: yat prāpya suratāṁ prāptāḥ surāḥ surapateḥ sakhe ॥14॥
5.98.20: eṣa kr̥tye samutpanne tat tad dhārayate balam,
5.98.23: sarvataḥ salilaṁ śītaṁ jīmūta iva varṣati ॥23॥
5.98.24: tamasā mūrchitaṁ bhāti yena nārcchati darśanam ॥24॥
5.98.25: tava kāryāvarodhastu tasmād gacchāva mā ciram ॥25॥
5.98.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi bhagavadyānaparvaṇi mātalivarānveṣaṇe aṣṭanavatitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥98॥
5.99.1: etat tu nāgalokasya nābhisthāne sthitaṁ puram,
5.99.2: idamadbhiḥ samaṁ prāptā ye kecid bhuvi jaṅgamāḥ,
5.99.9: mr̥tā hi divase sūta punarjīvanti vai niśi ॥9॥
5.99.16: paśya yadyatra te kaścid rocate guṇato varaḥ,
5.99.17: ā prajānāṁ nisargād vai nodbhidyati na sarpati ॥17॥
5.99.18: nāsya jātiṁ nisargaṁ vā kathyamānaṁ śr̥ṇomi vai,
pitaraṁ mātaraṁ cāpi nāsya jānāti kaścana ॥18॥
5.99.20: na me’tra rocate kaścidanyato vraja māciram ॥20॥
5.99.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi bhagavadyānaparvaṇi mātalivarānveṣaṇe ekonaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥99॥
5.100.3: dānavā nivasanti sma śūrā dattavarāḥ purā ॥3॥
5.100.4: naite śakreṇa nānyena yamena varuṇena vā,
5.100.7: jānāsi ca yathā śakro naitān śaknoti bādhitum ॥7॥
5.100.8: bahuśo mātale tvaṁ ca tava putraśca gomukhaḥ,
5.100.9: paśya veśmāni raukmāṇi mātale rājatāni ca,
5.100.17: devarṣe naiva me kāryaṁ vipriyaṁ tridivaukasām ॥17॥
5.100.19: anyatra sādhu gacchāva draṣṭuṁ nārhāmi dānavān,
5.100.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi bhagavadyānaparvaṇi mātalivarānveṣaṇe śatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥100॥
5.101.5: sarve hyete śriyā yuktāḥ sarve śrīvatsalakṣaṇāḥ,
5.101.7: nāmāni caiṣāṁ vakṣyāmi yathā prādhānyataḥ śr̥ṇu,
5.101.8: hr̥di caiṣāṁ sadā viṣṇurviṣṇureva sadā gatiḥ ॥8॥
5.101.16: yadyatra na ruciḥ kācidehi gacchāva mātale,
taṁ nayiṣyāmi deśaṁ tvāṁ varaṁ yatropalapsyase ॥16॥
5.101.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi bhagavadyānaparvaṇi mātalivarānveṣaṇe ekādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥101॥
5.102.6: phenapā nāma te khyātāḥ phenāhārāśca mātale,
ugre tapasi vartante yeṣāṁ bibhyati devatāḥ ॥6॥
5.102.7: nivasanti diśāṁ pālyo dhārayantyo diśaḥ sma tāḥ ॥7॥
5.102.8: pūrvāṁ diśaṁ dhārayate surūpā nāma saurabhī,
5.102.9: paścimā vāruṇī dik ca dhāryate vai subhadrayā,
5.102.11: āsāṁ tu payasā miśraṁ payo nirmathya sāgare,
5.102.13: sudhāhāreṣu ca sudhāṁ svadhābhojiṣu ca svadhām,
5.102.14: paurāṇī śrūyate loke gīyate yā manīṣibhiḥ ॥14॥
5.102.15: na nāgaloke na svarge na vimāne triviṣṭape,
5.102.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi bhagavadyānaparvaṇi mātalivarānveṣaṇe dvyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥102॥
5.103.2: eṣa śeṣaḥ sthito nāgo yeneyaṁ dhāryate sadā,
5.103.14: karavīraḥ pīṭharakaḥ saṁvr̥tto vr̥tta eva ca,
5.103.17: ete cānye ca bahavaḥ kaśyapasyātmajāḥ smr̥tāḥ,
mātale paśya yadyatra kaścit te rocate varaḥ ॥17॥
5.103.19: sthito ya eṣa purataḥ kauravyasyāryakasya tu,
5.103.20: kaḥ pitā jananī cāsya katamasyaiṣa bhoginaḥ,
vaṁśasya kasyaiṣa mahān ketubhūta iva sthitaḥ ॥20॥
5.103.21: praṇidhānena dhairyeṇa rūpeṇa vayasā ca me,
5.103.22: nivedayāmāsa tadā māhātmyaṁ janma karma ca ॥22॥
5.103.23: āryakasya mataḥ pautro dauhitro vāmanasya ca ॥23॥
5.103.24: etasya hi pitā nāgaścikuro nāma mātale,
5.103.26: asmai nāgāya vai dātuṁ priyāṁ duhitaraṁ mune ॥26॥
5.103.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi bhagavadyānaparvaṇi mātalivarānveṣaṇe tryadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥103॥
5.104.2: śakrasyāyaṁ sakhā caiva mantrī sārathireva ca,
5.104.6: sumukho bhavataḥ pautro rocate duhituḥ patiḥ ॥6॥
5.104.7: yadi te rocate samyag bhujagottama mā ciram,
5.104.12: sa tu dīnaḥ prahr̥ṣṭaśca prāha nāradamāryakaḥ ॥12॥
5.104.13: vriyamāṇe tathā pautre putre ca nidhanaṁ gate,
5.104.14: na me naitad bahumataṁ maharṣe vacanaṁ tava,
sakhā śakrasya saṁyuktaḥ kasyāyaṁ nepsito bhavet ॥14॥
5.104.17: dhruvaṁ tathā tad bhavitā jānīmastasya niścayam,
tena harṣaḥ praṇaṣṭo me suparṇavacanena vai ॥17॥
5.104.19: so’yaṁ mayā ca sahito nāradena ca pannagaḥ,
5.104.22: tataste sumukhaṁ gr̥hya sarva eva mahaujasaḥ,
5.104.29: labdhvā varaṁ tu sumukhaḥ sumukhaḥ sambabhūva ha,
kr̥tadāro yathākāmaṁ jagāma ca gr̥hān prati ॥29॥
5.104.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi bhagavadyānaparvaṇi mātalivarānveṣaṇe caturadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥104॥
5.105.4: āhāro vihito dhātrā kimarthaṁ vāryate tvayā ॥4॥
5.105.5: anena ca mayā deva bhartavyaḥ prasavo mahān ॥5॥
5.105.7: so’haṁ prāṇān vimokṣyāmi tathā parijano mama,
ye ca bhr̥tyā mama gr̥he prītimān bhava vāsava ॥7॥
5.105.9: tvayi tiṣṭhati deveśa na viṣṇuḥ kāraṇaṁ mama,
trailokyarāja rājyaṁ hi tvayi vāsava śāśvatam ॥9॥
5.105.10: mamāpi dakṣasya sutā jananī kaśyapaḥ pitā,
5.105.14: ko’nyo bhāra saho hyasti ko’nyo’sti balavattaraḥ,
mayā yo’haṁ viśiṣṭaḥ san vahāmīmaṁ sabāndhavam ॥14॥
5.105.15: avajñāya tu yat te’haṁ bhojanād vyaparopitaḥ,
tena me gauravaṁ naṣṭaṁ tvattaścāsmācca vāsava ॥15॥
5.105.17: vimr̥śa tvaṁ śanaistāta ko nvatra balavāniti ॥17॥
5.105.21: imaṁ tāvanmamaikaṁ tvaṁ bāhuṁ savyetaraṁ vaha,
5.105.22: tataḥ sa bhagavāṁstasya skandhe bāhuṁ samāsajat,
5.105.23: yāvān hi bhāraḥ kr̥tsnāyāḥ pr̥thivyāḥ parvataiḥ saha,
5.105.24: tato hi jīvitaṁ tasya na vyanīnaśadacyutaḥ ॥24॥
5.105.26: sa viṣṇuṁ śirasā pakṣī praṇamya vinatāsutaḥ,
5.105.29: na hi jñātaṁ balaṁ deva mayā te paramaṁ vibho,
tena manye hyahaṁ vīryamātmano na samaṁ paraiḥ ॥29॥
5.105.30: tataścakre sa bhagavān prasādaṁ vai garutmataḥ,
maivaṁ bhūya iti snehāt tadā cainamuvāca ha ॥30॥
5.105.33: tathā tvamapi gāndhāre yāvat pāṇḍusutān raṇe,
5.105.34: dhanañjayaścendrasuto na hanyātāṁ tu kaṁ raṇe ॥34॥
5.105.35: ete devāstvayā kena hetunā vīkṣituṁ kṣamāḥ ॥35॥
5.105.36: tadalaṁ te virodhena śamaṁ gaccha nr̥pātmaja,
5.105.40: yathaiveśvarasr̥ṣṭo’smi yad bhāvi yā ca me gatiḥ,
tathā maharṣe vartāmi kiṁ pralāpaḥ kariṣyati ॥40॥
5.105.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi bhagavadyānaparvaṇi mātalivarānveṣaṇe pañcādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥105॥
5.106.3: sauhr̥dād vā suhr̥t snigdho bhagavān vā pitāmahaḥ ॥3॥
5.106.4: uktaṁ bhagavatā vākyamuktaṁ bhīṣmeṇa yat kṣamam,
5.106.5: durlabho vai suhr̥cchrotā durlabhaśca hitaḥ suhr̥t,
tiṣṭhate hi suhr̥d yatra na bandhustatra tiṣṭhate ॥5॥
5.106.6: na kartavyaśca nirbandho nirbandho hi sudāruṇaḥ ॥6॥
5.106.10: paramānnasya yatnena na ca taṁ pratyapālayat ॥10॥
5.106.12: bhuktaṁ me tiṣṭha tāvat tvamityuktvā bhagavān yayau,
5.106.13: bhaktaṁ pragr̥hya mūrdhnā vai bāhubhyāṁ saṁśitavrataḥ,
5.106.16: sa dr̥ṣṭvā śirasā bhaktaṁ dhriyamāṇaṁ maharṣiṇā,
5.106.17: bhuktvā prīto’smi viprarṣe tamuktvā sa munirgataḥ ॥17॥
5.106.19: śuśrūṣayā ca bhaktyā ca prītimānityuvāca ha ॥19॥
5.106.20: anujñāto mayā vatsa yatheṣṭaṁ gaccha gālava,
5.106.22: dakṣiṇānāṁ hi dātā vai apavargeṇa yujyate ॥22॥
5.106.27: aṣṭau śatāni me dehi gaccha gālava mā ciram ॥27॥
5.106.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi bhagavadyānaparvaṇi gālavacarite ṣaḍadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥106॥
5.107.1: nāste na śete nāhāraṁ kurute gālavastadā ॥1॥
5.107.3: kutaḥ puṣṭāni mitrāṇi kuto’rthāḥ sañcayaḥ kutaḥ,
5.107.4: kuto me bhojane śraddhā sukhaśraddhā kutaśca me,
śraddhā me jīvitasyāpi chinnā kiṁ jīvitena me ॥4॥
5.107.5: ahaṁ pāre samudrasya pr̥thivyā vā paramparāt,
gatvā’’tmānaṁ vimuñcāmi kiṁ phalaṁ jīvitena me ॥5॥
5.107.7: suhr̥dāṁ hi dhanaṁ bhuktvā kr̥tvā praṇayamīpsitam,
5.107.9: nānr̥tasyādhipatyaṁ ca kuta eva gatiḥ śubhā ॥9॥
5.107.10: kutaḥ kr̥taghnasya yaśaḥ kutaḥ sthānaṁ kutaḥ sukham,
aśraddheyaḥ kr̥taghno hi kr̥taghne nāsti niṣkr̥tiḥ ॥10॥
5.107.11: na jīvatyadhanaḥ pāpaḥ kutaḥ pāpasya tantraṇam,
5.107.12: guroryaḥ kr̥takāryaḥ saṁstat karomi na bhāṣitam ॥12॥
5.107.13: arthitā na mayā kācit kr̥tapūrvā divaukasām,
mānayanti ca māṁ sarve tridaśā yajñasaṁstare ॥13॥
5.107.14: viṣṇuṁ gacchāmyahaṁ kr̥ṣṇaṁ gatiṁ gatimatāṁ varam ॥14॥
5.107.15: bhogā yasmāt pratiṣṭhante vyāpya sarvān surāsurān,
5.107.17: suhr̥d bhavān mama mataḥ suhr̥dāṁ ca mataḥ suhr̥t,
5.107.18: pūrvamuktastvadarthaṁ ca kr̥taḥ kāmaśca tena me ॥18॥
5.107.19: sa bhavānetu gacchāva nayiṣye tvāṁ yathāsukham,
deśaṁ pāraṁ pr̥thivyā vā gaccha gālava mā ciram ॥19॥
5.107.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi bhagavadyānaparvaṇi gālavacarite saptādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥107॥
5.108.1: brūhi kāmaṁ tu kāṁ yāmi draṣṭuṁ prathamato diśam ॥1॥
5.108.2: pūrvāṁ vā dakṣiṇāṁ vāhamathavā paścimāṁ diśam,
uttarāṁ vā dvijaśreṣṭha kuto gacchāmi gālava ॥2॥
5.108.3: savitā yatra sandhyāyāṁ sādhyānāṁ vartate tapaḥ ॥3॥
5.108.4: yasyāṁ pūrvaṁ matiryātā yayā vyāptamidaṁ jagat,
cakṣuṣī yatra dharmasya yatra caiṣa pratiṣṭhitaḥ ॥4॥
5.108.5: kr̥taṁ yato hutaṁ havyaṁ sarpate sarvatodiśam,
5.108.6: atra pūrvaṁ prasūtā vai dākṣāyaṇyaḥ prajāḥ striyaḥ,
5.108.9: ata eva ca sarveṣāṁ pūrvāmāśāṁ pracakṣate,
5.108.11: atra labdhavaraḥ somaḥ suraiḥ kratuṣu pīyate ॥11॥
5.108.13: sūtiścaiva pratiṣṭhā ca nidhanaṁ ca prakāśate ॥13॥
5.108.14: pibanti munayo yatra havirdhūmaṁ sma dhūmapāḥ ॥14॥
5.108.15: prokṣitā yatra bahavo varāhādyā mr̥gā vane,
5.108.16: udayaṁstān hi sarvān vai krodhāddhanti vibhāvasuḥ ॥16॥
5.108.17: etad dvāraṁ trilokasya svargasya ca sukhasya ca,
eṣa pūrvo diśāṁ bhāgo viśāvo’tra yadīcchasi ॥17॥
5.108.18: priyaṁ kāryaṁ hi me tasya yasyāsmi vacane sthitaḥ,
brūhi gālava yāsyāmi śr̥ṇu cāpyaparāṁ diśam ॥18॥
5.108.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi bhagavadyānaparvaṇi gālavacarite aṣṭādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥108॥
5.109.1: iyaṁ vivasvatā pūrvaṁ śrautena vidhinā kila,
gurave dakṣiṇā dattā dakṣiṇetyucyate ca dik ॥1॥
5.109.3: atra viśve sadā devāḥ pitr̥bhiḥ sārdhamāsate,
5.109.6: atra dharmaśca satyaṁ ca karma cātra nigadyate,
5.109.7: eṣā dik sā dvijaśreṣṭha yāṁ sarvaḥ pratipadyate,
vr̥tā tvanavabodhena sukhaṁ tena na gamyate ॥7॥
5.109.10: atra sāmāni gāthābhiḥ śrutvā gītāni raivataḥ,
5.109.11: maryādā sthāpitā brahman yāṁ sūryo nātivartate ॥11॥
5.109.18: atra siddhāḥ śivā nāma brāhmaṇā vedapāragāḥ ॥18॥
5.109.21: eṣa tasyāpi te mārgaḥ paricāryasya gālava,
brūhi me yadi gantavyaṁ pratīcīṁ śr̥ṇu cāparām ॥21॥
5.109.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi bhagavadyānaparvaṇi gālavacarite navādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥109॥
5.110.1: iyaṁ dig dayitā rājño varuṇasya tu gopateḥ,
5.110.2: atra paścādahaḥ sūryo visarjayati gāḥ svayam,
5.110.4: atra pītvā samastān vai varuṇasya rasāṁstu ṣaṭ,
5.110.5: atra paścāt kr̥tā daityā vāyunā saṁyatāstadā,
5.110.6: asto nāma yataḥ sandhyā paścimā pratisarpati ॥6॥
5.110.7: ato rātriśca nidrā ca nirgatā divasakṣaye,
5.110.9: atra mūlaṁ himavato mandaraṁ yāti śāśvatam,
5.110.13: ākāśe tiṣṭha tiṣṭheti tasthau sūryasya śāsanāt ॥13॥
5.110.14: atra vāyustathā vahnirāpaḥ khaṁ cāpi gālava,
āhnikaṁ caiva naiśaṁ ca duḥkhaṁ sparśaṁ vimuñcati ॥14॥
5.110.20: eṣa te paścimo mārgo digdvāreṇa prakīrtitaḥ,
brūhi gālava gacchāvo buddhiḥ kā dvijasattama ॥20॥
5.110.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi bhagavadyānaparvaṇi gālavacarite daśādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥110॥
5.111.2: mārgaḥ paścimapūrvābhyāṁ digbhyāṁ vai madhyamaḥ smr̥taḥ ॥2॥
5.111.6: na sa dr̥śyo munigaṇaistathā devaiḥ savāsavaiḥ,
5.111.10: atra kāmaśca roṣaśca śailaścomā ca sambabhuḥ,
5.111.14: atra te r̥ṣayaḥ sapta devī cārundhatī tathā ॥14॥
5.111.15: atra tiṣṭhati vai svātiratrāsyā udayaḥ smr̥taḥ,
atra yajñaṁ samāsādya dhruvaṁ sthātā pitāmahaḥ ॥15॥
5.111.18: yathā yathā praviśati tasmāt parataraṁ naraḥ ॥18॥
5.111.20: r̥te nārāyaṇaṁ devaṁ naraṁ vā jiṣṇumavyayam,
5.111.21: atra viṣṇupadaṁ nāma kramatā viṣṇunā kr̥tam ॥21॥
5.111.24: brāhmaṇeṣu ca yat kr̥tsnaṁ svantaṁ kr̥tvā dhanaṁ mahat ॥24॥
5.111.25: vavre dhanaṁ maharṣiḥ sa jaimūtaṁ tad dhanaṁ tataḥ,
5.111.26: kasya kāryaṁ kimiti vai parikrośanti gālava,
5.111.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi bhagavadyānaparvaṇi gālavacarite ekādaśādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥111॥
5.112.1: naya māṁ tārkṣya pūrveṇa yatra dharmasya cakṣuṣī ॥1॥
5.112.2: pūrvametāṁ diśaṁ gaccha yā pūrvaṁ parikīrtitā,
5.112.3: atra satyaṁ ca dharmaśca tvayā samyak prakīrtitaḥ,
5.112.10: mahārṇavasya ca ravaiḥ śrotre me badhire kr̥te,
na śr̥ṇomi na paśyāmi nātmano vedmi kāraṇam ॥10॥
5.112.11: śanaiḥ sa tu bhavān yātu brahmavadhyāmanusmaran,
na dr̥śyate ravistāta na diśo na ca khaṁ khaga ॥11॥
5.112.12: tama eva tu paśyāmi śarīraṁ te na lakṣaye,
5.112.13: śarīraṁ tu na paśyāmi tava caivātmanaśca ha,
5.112.14: sa me nirvāpya sahasā cakṣuṣī śāmya te punaḥ,
5.112.15: na me prayojanaṁ kiñcid gamane pannagāśana,
saṁnivarta mahābhāga na vegaṁ viṣahāmi te ॥15॥
5.112.18: naiva me’sti dhanaṁ kiñcinna dhanenānvitaḥ suhr̥t,
5.112.19: evaṁ bahu ca dīnaṁ ca bruvāṇaṁ gālavaṁ tadā,
5.112.20: na cāpi kr̥trimaḥ kālaḥ kālo hi parameśvaraḥ ॥20॥
5.112.22: atra viśramya bhuktvā ca nivartiṣyāva gālava ॥22॥
5.112.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi bhagavadyānaparvaṇi gālavacarite dvādaśādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥112॥
5.113.6: vāso’yamiha kālaṁ tu kiyantaṁ nau bhaviṣyati ॥6॥
5.113.7: kiṁ nu te manasā dhyātamaśubhaṁ dharmadūṣaṇam,
na hyayaṁ bhavataḥ svalpo vyabhicāro bhaviṣyati ॥7॥
5.113.8: suparṇo’thābravīd vipraṁ pradhyātaṁ vai mayā dvija,
imāṁ siddhāmito netuṁ tatra yatra prajāpatiḥ ॥8॥
5.113.9: yatra devo mahādevo yatra viṣṇuḥ sanātanaḥ,
