5.113.11: sukr̥taṁ duṣkr̥taṁ vā tvaṁ māhātmyāt kṣantumarhasi ॥11॥
5.113.12: na bhetavyaṁ suparṇo’si suparṇa tyaja sambhramam ॥12॥
5.113.13: ninditāsmi tvayā vatsa na ca nindāṁ kṣamāmyaham,
lokebhyaḥ sapadi bhraśyed yo māṁ nindeta pāpakr̥t ॥13॥
5.113.16: na ca te garhaṇīyāhaṁ garhitavyāḥ striyaḥ kvacit ॥16॥
5.113.19: viśvāmitro’tha taṁ dr̥ṣṭvā gālavaṁ cādhvani sthitaḥ,
5.113.20: tasya kālo’pavargasya yathā vā manyate bhavān ॥20॥
5.113.21: yathā saṁsidhyate vipra sa mārgastu niśāmyatām ॥21॥
5.113.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi bhagavadyānaparvaṇi gālavacarite trayodaśādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥113॥
5.114.1: athāha gālavaṁ dīnaṁ suparṇaḥ patatāṁ varaḥ,
nirmitaṁ vahninā bhūmau vāyunā śodhitaṁ tathā,
5.114.2: tadetat triṣu lokeṣu dhanaṁ tiṣṭhati śāśvatam ॥2॥
5.114.3: nityaṁ proṣṭhapadābhyāṁ ca śukre dhanapatau tathā,
5.114.5: sa tvaṁ yācātra rājānaṁ kañcid rājarṣivaṁśajam,
apīḍya rājā paurān hi yo nau kuryāt kr̥tārthinau ॥5॥
5.114.6: asti somānvavāye me jātaḥ kaścinnr̥paḥ sakhā,
abhigacchāvahe taṁ vai tasyāsti vibhavo bhuvi ॥6॥
5.114.7: sa dāsyati mayā cokto bhavatā cārthitaḥ svayam ॥7॥
5.114.9: tathā tau kathayantau ca cintayantau ca yat kṣamam,
5.114.11: ayaṁ me nāhuṣa sakhā gālavastapaso nidhiḥ,
5.114.12: tamāha bhagavan kiṁ te dadāni gurudakṣiṇām ॥12॥
5.114.14: aṣṭau śatāni me dehi hayānāṁ candravarcasām ॥14॥
5.114.16: aśaktaḥ pratikartuṁ tad bhavantaṁ śaraṇaṁ gataḥ ॥16॥
5.114.20: pātraṁ pratigrahasyāyaṁ dātuṁ pātraṁ tathā bhavān,
5.114.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi bhagavadyānaparvaṇi gālavacarite caturdaśādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥114॥
5.115.1: vimr̥śyāvahito rājā niścitya ca punaḥ punaḥ ॥1॥
5.115.3: dr̥ṣṭvā priyasakhaṁ tārkṣyaṁ gālavaṁ ca dvijarṣabham,
nidarśanaṁ ca tapaso bhikṣāṁ ślāghyāṁ ca kīrtitām ॥3॥
5.115.5: adya me saphalaṁ janma tāritaṁ cādya me kulam,
adyāyaṁ tārito deśo mama tārkṣya tvayānagha ॥5॥
5.115.6: vaktumicchāmi tu sakhe yathā jānāsi māṁ purā,
na tathā vittavānasmi kṣīṇaṁ vittaṁ ca me sakhe ॥6॥
5.115.7: na ca śakto’smi te kartuṁ moghamāgamanaṁ khaga,
5.115.8: tat tu dāsyāmi yat kāryamidaṁ sampādayiṣyati,
abhigamya hatāśo hi nivr̥tto dahate kulam ॥8॥
5.115.10: hatāśo hyakr̥tārthaḥ san hataḥ sambhāvito naraḥ,
5.115.12: kāṅkṣitā rūpato bālā sutā me pratigr̥hyatām ॥12॥
5.115.13: asyāḥ śulkaṁ pradāsyanti nr̥pā rājyamapi dhruvam,
kiṁ punaḥ śyāmakarṇānāṁ hayānāṁ dve catuḥśate ॥13॥
5.115.14: sa bhavān pratigr̥hṇātu mamaitāṁ mādhavīṁ sutām,
ahaṁ dauhitravān syāṁ vai vara eṣa mama prabho ॥14॥
5.115.15: pratigr̥hya ca tāṁ kanyāṁ gālavaḥ saha pakṣiṇā,
5.115.17: gate patagarāje tu gālavaḥ saha kanyayā,
cintayānaḥ kṣamaṁ dāne rājñāṁ vai śulkato’gamat ॥17॥
5.115.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi bhagavadyānaparvaṇi gālavacarite pañcadaśādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥115॥
5.116.2: gambhīrā triṣu gambhīreṣviyaṁ raktā ca pañcasu ॥2॥
5.116.2d1: śroṇyau lalāṭamūrū ca ghrāṇaṁ ceti ṣaḍunnatam,
5.116.2d2: svaraḥ sattvaṁ ca nābhiśca trigambhīraṁ pracakṣate,
pāṇipādatale rakte netrāntau ca nakhāni ca.
5.116.4: brūhi śulkaṁ dvijaśreṣṭha samīkṣya vibhavaṁ mama ॥4॥
5.116.8: dve me śate saṁnihite hayānāṁ yadvidhāstava,
5.116.9: asyāmetaṁ bhavān kāmaṁ sampādayatu me varam ॥9॥
5.116.10: etacchrutvā tu sā kanyā gālavaṁ vākyamabravīt,
mama datto varaḥ kaścit kenacid brahmavādinā ॥10॥
5.116.11: sa tvaṁ dadasva māṁ rāje pratigr̥hya hayottamān ॥11॥
5.116.12: nr̥pebhyo hi caturbhyaste pūrṇānyaṣṭau śatāni me,
bhaviṣyanti tathā putrā mama catvāra eva ca ॥12॥
5.116.13: eṣā tāvanmama prajñā yathā vā manyase dvija ॥13॥
5.116.16: pratigr̥hya sa tāṁ kanyāṁ gālavaṁ pratinandya ca,
5.116.20: haryaśvaḥ satyavacane sthitaḥ sthitvā ca pauruṣe,
5.116.22: tvayyeva tāvat tiṣṭhantu hayā ityuktavān dvijaḥ,
5.116.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi bhagavadyānaparvaṇi gālavacarite ṣoḍaśādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥116॥
5.117.2: tatra gacchāvahe bhadre śanairāgaccha mā śucaḥ,
dhārmikaḥ saṁyame yuktaḥ satye caiva janeśvaraḥ ॥2॥
5.117.7: vidhipūrvāṁ ca tāṁ rājā kanyāṁ pratigr̥hītavān ॥7॥
5.117.8: reme sa tasyāṁ rājarṣiḥ prabhāvatyāṁ yathā raviḥ,
svāhāyāṁ ca yathā vahniryathā śacyāṁ ca vāsavaḥ ॥8॥
5.117.9: yathā candraśca rohiṇyāṁ yathā dhūmorṇayā yamaḥ,
varuṇaśca yathā gauryāṁ yathā carddhyāṁ dhaneśvaraḥ ॥9॥
5.117.10: yathā nārāyaṇo lakṣmyāṁ jāhnavyāṁ ca yathodadhiḥ,
yathā rudraśca rudrāṇyāṁ yathā vedyāṁ pitāmahaḥ ॥10॥
5.117.14: r̥cīkaḥ satyavatyāṁ ca sarasvatyāṁ yathā manuḥ ॥14॥
5.117.17: vaidehyāṁ ca yathā rāmo rukmiṇyāṁ ca janārdanaḥ ॥17॥
5.117.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi bhagavadyānaparvaṇi gālavacarite saptadaśādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥117॥
5.118.1: tathaiva tāṁ śriyaṁ tyaktvā kanyā bhūtvā yaśasvinī,
5.118.3: iyaṁ kanyā sutau dvau te janayiṣyati pārthivau ॥3॥
5.118.4: asyāṁ bhavānavāptārtho bhavitā pretya ceha ca,
5.118.6: gurvartho’yaṁ samārambho na hayaiḥ kr̥tyamasti me,
5.118.8: na putraphalabhoktā hi rājarṣe pātyate divaḥ,
na yāti narakaṁ ghoraṁ yathā gacchantyanātmajāḥ ॥8॥
5.118.10: śrutavānasmi te vākyaṁ yathā vadasi gālava,
vidhistu balavān brahman pravaṇaṁ hi mano mama ॥10॥
5.118.12: putraṁ dvija gataṁ mārgaṁ gamiṣyāmi parairaham ॥12॥
5.118.14: kāmato hi dhanaṁ rājā pārakyaṁ yaḥ prayacchati,
na sa dharmeṇa dharmātman yujyate yaśasā na ca ॥14॥
5.118.17: reme sa tāṁ samāsādya kr̥tapuṇya iva śriyam ॥17॥
5.118.18: kandareṣu ca śailānāṁ nadīnāṁ nirjhareṣu ca,
5.118.21: upasthāya sa taṁ vipro gālavaḥ pratigr̥hya ca,
5.118.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi bhagavadyānaparvaṇi gālavacarite aṣṭādaśādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥118॥
5.119.1: diṣṭyā kr̥tārthaṁ paśyāmi bhavantamiha vai dvija ॥1॥
5.119.3: prayatnaste na kartavyo naiṣa sampatsyate tava ॥3॥
5.119.4: purā hi kānyakubje vai gādheḥ satyavatīṁ sutām,
5.119.7: iṣṭvā te puṇḍarīkeṇa dattā rājñā dvijātiṣu,
tebhyo dve dve śate krītvā prāpte taiḥ pārthivaistadā ॥7॥
5.119.9: evaṁ na śakyamaprāpyaṁ prāptuṁ gālava karhicit,
5.119.13: asyāṁ rājarṣibhiḥ putrā jātā vai dhārmikāstrayaḥ,
5.119.14: bhavato hyanr̥ṇo bhūtvā tapaḥ kuryāṁ yathāsukham ॥14॥
5.119.15: viśvāmitrastu taṁ dr̥ṣṭvā gālavaṁ saha pakṣiṇā,
5.119.16: kimiyaṁ pūrvameveha na dattā mama gālava,
5.119.19: jātamātraṁ sutaṁ taṁ ca viśvāmitro mahāmuniḥ,
5.119.20: niryātya kanyāṁ śiṣyāya kauśiko’pi vanaṁ yayau ॥20॥
5.119.24: piturniryātya tāṁ kanyāṁ prayayau vanameva ha ॥24॥
5.119.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi bhagavadyānaparvaṇi gālavacarite ekonaviṁśatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥119॥
5.120.1: sa tu rājā punastasyāḥ kartukāmaḥ svayaṁvaram,
5.120.6: avatīrya rathāt kanyā namaskr̥tya ca bandhuṣu,
5.120.9: sravantīnāṁ ca puṇyānāṁ surasāni śucīni ca,
5.120.13: tābhyāṁ pratiṣṭhito loke paraloke ca nāhuṣaḥ ॥13॥
5.120.18: ko nvayaṁ kasya vā rājñaḥ kathaṁ vā svargamāgataḥ ॥18॥
5.120.19: karmaṇā kena siddho’yaṁ kva vānena tapaścitam,
kathaṁ vā jñāyate svarge kena vā jñāyate’pyuta ॥19॥
5.120.22: sarve te hyāvr̥tajñānā nābhyajānanta taṁ nr̥pam,
5.120.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi bhagavadyānaparvaṇi gālavacarite yayātimohe viṁśatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥120॥
5.121.8: na ca prajñāyase gaccha patasveti tamabravīt,
5.121.12: bhūmau svarge ca sambaddhāṁ nadīṁ dhūmamayīmiva,
5.121.15: ko bhavān kasya vā bandhurdeśasya nagarasya vā ॥15॥
5.121.16: yakṣo vāpyathavā devo gandharvo rākṣaso’pi vā,
na hi mānuṣarūpo’si ko vārthaḥ kāṅkṣyate tvayā ॥16॥
5.121.19: na ca me pravaṇā buddhiḥ parapuṇyavināśane ॥19॥
5.121.21: kimāgamanakr̥tyaṁ te kiṁ kurmaḥ śāsanaṁ tava,
ājñāpyā hi vayaṁ sarve tava putrāstapodhane ॥21॥
5.121.22: teṣāṁ tad bhāṣitaṁ śrutvā mādhavī parayā mudā,
pitaraṁ samupāgacchad yayātiṁ sā vavanda ca ॥22॥
5.121.23: dauhitrāstava rājendra mama putrā na te parāḥ ॥23॥
5.121.24: ahaṁ te duhitā rājan mādhavī mr̥gacāriṇī ॥24॥
5.121.26: tataste pārthivāḥ sarve śirasā jananīṁ tadā ॥26॥
5.121.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi bhagavadyānaparvaṇi gālavacarite yayātisvargabhraṁśe ekaviṁśatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥121॥
5.122.4: tadapyatha ca dāsyāmi tena saṁyujyatāṁ bhavān ॥4॥
5.122.5: yat phalaṁ dānaśīlasya kṣamāśīlasya yat phalam,
yacca me phalamādhāne tena saṁyujyatāṁ bhavān ॥5॥
5.122.8: yathā bāleṣu nārīṣu vaihāryeṣu tathaiva ca ॥8॥
5.122.9: anr̥taṁ noktapūrvaṁ me tena satyena khaṁ vraja ॥9॥
5.122.10: yathā prāṇāṁśca rājyaṁ ca rājan kāmasukhāni ca,
tyajeyaṁ na punaḥ satyaṁ tena satyena khaṁ vraja ॥10॥
5.122.11: yathā satyena me dharmo yathā satyena pāvakaḥ,
prītaḥ śatakratuścaiva tena satyena khaṁ vraja ॥11॥
5.122.14: na me ratnāni na dhanaṁ na tathānye paricchadāḥ,
5.122.15: yathā yathā hi jalpanti dauhitrāstaṁ narādhipam,
tathā tathā vasumatīṁ tyaktvā rājā divaṁ yayau ॥15॥
5.122.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi bhagavadyānaparvaṇi gālavacarite yayātisvargārohaṇe dvāviṁśatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥122॥
5.123.10: sthānaṁ ca pratipanno’si karmaṇā svena nirjitam,
5.123.11: bhagavan saṁśayo me’sti kaścit taṁ chettumarhasi,
5.123.13: bhagavan vettha lokāṁśca śāśvatān mama nirmitān,
kathaṁ nu mama tat sarvaṁ vipraṇaṣṭaṁ mahādyute ॥13॥
5.123.16: nāyaṁ mānena rājarṣe na balena na hiṁsayā,
na śāṭhyena na māyābhirloko bhavati śāśvataḥ ॥16॥
5.123.17: na hi mānapradagdhānāṁ kaścidasti śamaḥ kvacit ॥17॥
5.123.20: na kartavyo hi nirbandho nirbandho hi kṣayodayaḥ ॥20॥
5.123.21: tasmāt tvamapi gāndhāre mānaṁ krodhaṁ ca varjaya,
5.123.21d1: sa bhavān suhr̥dāṁ pathyaṁ vaco gr̥hṇātu mānr̥tam,
5.123.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi bhagavadyānaparvaṇi gālavacarite trayoviṁśatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥123॥
5.124.2: svargyaṁ lokyaṁ ca māmāttha dharmyaṁ nyāyyaṁ ca keśava ॥2॥
5.124.3: na tvahaṁ svavaśastāta kriyamāṇaṁ na me priyam,
aṅgaṁ duryodhanaṁ kr̥ṣṇa mandaṁ śāstrātigaṁ mama ॥3॥
5.124.3d1: na maṁsyante durātmānaḥ putrā mama janārdana,
5.124.7: suhr̥tkāryaṁ tu sumahat kr̥taṁ te syājjanārdana,
5.124.11: ta etadīdr̥śaṁ kuryuryathā tvaṁ tāta manyase,
5.124.16: taddhitaṁ ca priyaṁ caiva dhr̥tarāṣṭrasya dhīmataḥ ॥16॥
5.124.18: jñātīnāṁ caiva bhūyiṣṭhaṁ mitrāṇāṁ ca parantapa ॥18॥
5.124.19: śame śarma bhavet tāta sarvasya jagatastathā,
tiṣṭha tāta pituḥ śāstre mātuśca bharatarṣabha ॥19॥
5.124.20: etacchreyo hi manyante pitā yacchāsti bhārata,
5.124.21: rocate te pitustāta pāṇḍavaiḥ saha saṅgamaḥ,
sāmātyasya kuruśreṣṭha tat tubhyaṁ tāta rocatām ॥21॥
5.124.22: śrutvā yaḥ suhr̥dāṁ śāstraṁ martyo na pratipadyate,
5.124.28: yo’satsevī vr̥thācāro na śrotā suhr̥dāṁ satām,
parān vr̥ṇīte svān dveṣṭi taṁ gaustyajati bhārata ॥28॥
5.124.31: na ca te jātu kupyanti dharmātmāno hi pāṇḍavāḥ ॥31॥
5.124.36: indriyaiḥ prākr̥to lobhād dharmaṁ viprajahāti yaḥ,
5.124.37: na hi dharmādapaityarthaḥ kāmo vāpi kadācana ॥37॥
5.124.40: ātmānaṁ takṣati hyeṣa vanaṁ paraśunā yathā,
5.124.41: na tasya hi matiṁ chindyād yasya necchet parābhavam,
5.124.42: apyanyaṁ prākr̥taṁ kiñcit kimu tān pāṇḍavarṣabhān,
5.124.43: chidyate hyātataṁ sarvaṁ pramāṇaṁ paśya bhārata,
śreyaste durjanāt tāta pāṇḍavaiḥ saha saṅgatam ॥43॥
5.124.46: na caite tava paryāptā jñāne dharmārthayostathā ॥46॥
5.124.48: idaṁ saṁnihitaṁ tāta samagraṁ pārthivaṁ balam ॥48॥
5.124.49: ayaṁ bhīṣmastathā droṇaḥ karṇaścāyaṁ tathā kr̥paḥ,
5.124.51: dr̥śyatāṁ vā pumān kaścit samagre pārthive bale,
5.124.52: yasmiñjite jitaṁ tat syāt pumānekaḥ sa dr̥śyatām ॥52॥
5.124.54: ekasya ca bahūnāṁ ca paryāptaṁ tannidarśanam ॥54॥
5.124.55: yuddhe yena mahādevaḥ sākṣāt santoṣitaḥ śivaḥ,
5.124.56: mad dvitīyaṁ punaḥ pārthaṁ kaḥ prārthayitumarhati,
5.124.57: bāhubhyāmudvahed bhūmiṁ dahet kruddha imāḥ prajāḥ,
pātayet tridivād devān yo’rjunaṁ samare jayet ॥57॥
5.124.59: astu śeṣaṁ kauravāṇāṁ mā parābhūdidaṁ kulam,
5.124.62: pāṇḍavaiḥ saṁśamaṁ kr̥tvā kr̥tvā ca suhr̥dāṁ vacaḥ,
5.124.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi bhagavadyānaparvaṇi bhagavadvākye caturviṁśatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥124॥
5.125.3: śreyo na jātu na sukhaṁ na kalyāṇamavāpsyasi ॥3॥
5.125.8: mā kulaghnaḥ kupuruṣo durmatiḥ kāpathaṁ gamaḥ,
mātaraṁ pitaraṁ caiva mā majjīḥ śokasāgare ॥8॥
5.125.13: ye tvāṁ protsāhayantyete naite kr̥tyāya karhicit,
5.125.14: mā jīghanaḥ prajāḥ sarvāḥ putrān bhrātr̥̄ṁstathaiva ca,
5.125.15: yadi nādāsyase tāta paścāt tapsyasi bhārata ॥15॥
5.125.17: etat te sarvamākhyātaṁ yathecchasi tathā kuru,
na hi tvāmutsahe vaktuṁ bhūyo bharatasattama ॥17॥
5.125.19: imau tu vr̥ddhau śocāmi gāndhārīṁ pitaraṁ ca te ॥19॥
5.125.27: śamaṁ ced yācamānaṁ tvaṁ pratyākhyāsyasi keśavam,
5.125.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi bhagavadyānaparvaṇi bhīṣmādivākye pañcaviṁśatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥125॥
5.126.2: yāvad dhaumyo na medhāgnau juhotīha dviṣadbalam ॥2॥
5.126.3: yāvanna prekṣate kruddhaḥ senāṁ tava yudhiṣṭhiraḥ,
5.126.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi bhagavadyānaparvaṇi bhīṣmadroṇavākye ṣaḍviṁśatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥126॥
5.127.3: bhavān garhayate nityaṁ kiṁ samīkṣya balābalam ॥3॥
5.127.4: bhavān kṣattā ca rājā vāpyācāryo vā pitāmahaḥ,
5.127.5: atha sarve bhavanto māṁ vidviṣanti sarājakāḥ ॥5॥
5.127.7: jitāḥ śakuninā rājyaṁ tatra kiṁ mama duṣkr̥tam ॥7॥
5.127.9: aparādho na cāsmākaṁ yat te dyūte parājitāḥ,
ajeyā jayatāṁ śreṣṭha pārthāḥ pravrājitā vanam ॥9॥
5.127.11: kimasmābhiḥ kr̥taṁ teṣāṁ kasmin vā punarāgasi,
5.127.12: na cāpi vayamugreṇa karmaṇā vacanena vā,
5.127.13: na ca taṁ kr̥ṣṇa paśyāmi kṣatradharmamanuṣṭhitam,
utsaheta yudhā jetuṁ yo naḥ śatrunibarhaṇa ॥13॥
5.127.14: devairapi yudhā jetuṁ śakyāḥ kimuta pāṇḍavaiḥ ॥14॥
5.127.15: astreṇa nidhanaṁ kāle prāpsyāmaḥ svargyameva tat ॥15॥
5.127.17: te vayaṁ vīraśayanaṁ prāpsyāmo yadi saṁyuge,
5.127.18: kaśca jātu kule jātaḥ kṣatradharmeṇa vartayan,
5.127.21: eṣa dharmaḥ kṣatriyāṇāṁ matametacca me sadā ॥21॥
5.127.22: na sa labhyaḥ punarjātu mayi jīvati keśava ॥22॥
5.127.23: apradeyaṁ purā dattaṁ rājyaṁ paravato mama ॥23॥
5.127.24: ajñānād vā bhayād vāpi mayi bāle janārdana,
5.127.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi bhagavadyānaparvaṇi duryodhanavākye saptaviṁśatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥127॥
5.128.2: sthiro bhava sahāmātyo vimardo bhavitā mahān ॥2॥
5.128.3: yaccaivaṁ manyase mūḍha na me kaścid vyatikramaḥ,
5.128.4: tvayā durmantritaṁ dyūtaṁ saubalena ca bhārata ॥4॥
5.128.6: asatāṁ tatra jāyante bhedāśca vyasanāni ca ॥6॥
5.128.7: tadidaṁ vyasanaṁ ghoraṁ tvayā dyūtamukhaṁ kr̥tam,
5.128.8: ānīya ca sabhāṁ vyaktaṁ yathoktā draupadī tvayā ॥8॥
5.128.12: karṇaduḥśāsanābhyāṁ ca tvayā ca bahuśaḥ kr̥tam ॥12॥
5.128.13: saha mātrā pradagdhuṁ tān bālakān vāraṇāvate,
āsthitaḥ paramaṁ yatnaṁ na samr̥ddhaṁ ca tat tava ॥13॥
5.128.15: sarvopāyairvināśāya na samr̥ddhaṁ ca tat tava ॥15॥
5.128.19: śāmyeti muhurukto’si na ca śāmyasi pārthiva ॥19॥
5.128.20: na ca rocayase rājan kimanyad buddhilāghavāt ॥20॥
5.128.21: na śarma prāpsyase rājannutkramya suhr̥dāṁ vacaḥ,
5.128.23: na cet sandhāsyase rājan svena kāmena pāṇḍavaiḥ,
baddhvā kila tvāṁ dāsyanti kuntīputrāya kauravāḥ ॥23॥
5.128.24: vaikartanaṁ tvāṁ ca māṁ ca trīnetān manujarṣabha,
pāṇḍavebhyaḥ pradāsyanti bhīṣmo droṇaḥ pitā ca te ॥24॥
5.128.26: viduraṁ dhr̥tarāṣṭraṁ ca mahārājaṁ ca bāhlikam,
kr̥paṁ ca somadattaṁ ca bhīṣmaṁ droṇaṁ janārdanam ॥26॥
5.128.32: sarve hyanusr̥tā mohāt pārthivāḥ saha mantribhiḥ ॥32॥
5.128.36: pratyakṣametad bhavatāṁ yad vakṣyāmi hitaṁ vacaḥ,
5.128.47: varuṇaḥ sāgare yatto nityaṁ rakṣati dānavān ॥47॥
5.128.48: tathā duryodhanaṁ karṇaṁ śakuniṁ cāpi saubalam,
5.128.49: tyajet kulārthe puruṣaṁ grāmasyārthe kulaṁ tyajet,
5.128.50: rājan duryodhanaṁ baddhvā tataḥ saṁśāmya pāṇḍavaiḥ,
5.128.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi bhagavadyānaparvaṇi kr̥ṣṇavākye aṣṭāviṁśatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥128॥
5.129.1: kr̥ṣṇasya tu vacaḥ śrutvā dhr̥tarāṣṭro janeśvaraḥ,
5.129.5: api no vyasanaṁ ghoraṁ duryodhanakr̥taṁ mahat,
5.129.11: tvaṁ hyevātra bhr̥śaṁ garhyo dhr̥tarāṣṭra sutapriyaḥ ॥11॥
5.129.14: bhinnaṁ hi svajanena tvāṁ prahasiṣyanti śatravaḥ ॥14॥
5.129.15: yā hi śakyā mahārāja sāmnā bhedena vā punaḥ,
5.129.16: mātuśca vacanāt kṣattā sabhāṁ prāveśayat punaḥ ॥16॥
5.129.20: bhīṣmo droṇaḥ kr̥paḥ kṣattā suhr̥dāṁ kuru tad vacaḥ ॥20॥
5.129.21: bhīṣmasya tu pituścaiva mama cāpacitiḥ kr̥tā,
bhaved droṇamukhānāṁ ca suhr̥dāṁ śāmyatā tvayā ॥21॥
5.129.22: na hi rājyaṁ mahāprājña svena kāmena śakyate,
5.129.24: tau tu śatrū vinirjitya rājā vijayate mahīm ॥24॥
5.129.32: yābhyāṁ hi devāḥ svaryātuḥ svargasya pidadhurmukham,
5.129.33: kāmaṁ krodhaṁ ca lobhaṁ ca dambhaṁ darpaṁ ca bhūmipaḥ,
5.129.34: īpsannarthaṁ ca dharmaṁ ca dviṣatāṁ ca parābhavam ॥34॥
5.129.35: kāmābhibhūtaḥ krodhād vā yo mithyā pratipadyate,
sveṣu cānyeṣu vā tasya na sahāyā bhavantyuta ॥35॥
5.129.36: pāṇḍavaiḥ pr̥thivīṁ tāta bhokṣyase sahitaḥ sukhī ॥36॥
5.129.40: na yuddhe tāta kalyāṇaṁ na dharmārthau kutaḥ sukham,
na cāpi vijayo nityaṁ mā yuddhe ceta ādhithāḥ ॥40॥
5.129.41: bhīṣmeṇa hi mahāprājña pitrā te bāhlikena ca,
5.129.44: suhr̥dāṁ vacane tiṣṭhan yaśaḥ prāpsyasi bhārata ॥44॥
5.129.46: nigr̥hya suhr̥dāṁ manyuṁ śādhi rājyaṁ yathocitam,
5.129.49: bhīṣme droṇe kr̥pe karṇe bhīmasene dhanañjaye,
dhr̥ṣṭadyumne ca saṅkruddhe na syuḥ sarvāḥ prajā dhruvam ॥49॥
5.129.50: eṣā hi pr̥thivī kr̥tsnā mā gamat tvatkr̥te vadham ॥50॥
5.129.52: samaṁ hi rājyaṁ prītiśca sthānaṁ hi viditātmanām,
5.129.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi bhagavadyānaparvaṇi gāndhārīvākye ekonatriṁśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥129॥
5.130.7: ayaṁ hyeṣāṁ mahābāhuḥ sarveṣāṁ śarma varma ca,
5.130.12: sa praviśya sabhāṁ vīraḥ siṁho giriguhāmiva ॥12॥
5.130.17: paṭenāgniṁ prajvalitaṁ yathā bālā yathā jaḍāḥ,
5.130.21: āsādya na bhaviṣyanti pataṅgā iva pāvakam,
5.130.22: na tvayaṁ ninditaṁ karma kuryāt pāpaṁ kathañcana ॥22॥
5.130.23d7: ete hi yadi govindamicchanti saha rājabhiḥ,
5.130.26: na tvahaṁ ninditaṁ karma kuryāṁ pāpaṁ kathañcana,
pāṇḍavārthe hi lubhyantaḥ svārthān hāsyanti te sutāḥ ॥26॥
5.130.28: nigr̥hya rājan pārthebhyo dadyāṁ kiṁ duṣkr̥taṁ bhavet,
idaṁ tu na pravarteyaṁ ninditaṁ karma bhārata ॥28॥
5.130.29: eṣa duryodhano rājan yathecchati tathāstu tat ॥29॥
5.130.32: tato duryodhanaṁ kṣattā punaḥ prāveśayat sabhām,
5.130.34: pāpaiḥ sahāyaiḥ saṁhatya pāpaṁ karma cikīrṣasi ॥34॥
5.130.37: yo na śakyo balāt kartuṁ devairapi savāsavaiḥ,
taṁ tvaṁ prārthayase manda bālaścandramasaṁ yathā ॥37॥
5.130.38: na soḍhuṁ samare śakyastaṁ na buddhyasi keśavam ॥38॥
5.130.39: durdharā pr̥thivī mūrdhnā durgrāhyaḥ keśavo balāt ॥39॥
5.130.42: grahītuṁ nāśakaccainaṁ taṁ tvaṁ prārthayase balāt ॥42॥
5.130.43: grahītuṁ nāśakat tatra taṁ tvaṁ prārthayase balāt ॥43॥
5.130.45: grahītuṁ nāśakaṁścainaṁ taṁ tvaṁ prārthayase balāt ॥45॥
5.130.46: anena hi hatā bālye pūtanā śakunī tathā,
5.130.51: ayaṁ kartā na kriyate kāraṇaṁ cāpi pauruṣe,
5.130.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi bhagavadyānaparvaṇi viduravākye triṁśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥130॥
5.131.5: tasya brahmā lalāṭastho rudro vakṣasi cābhavat ॥5॥
5.131.14: r̥te droṇaṁ ca bhīṣmaṁ ca viduraṁ ca mahāmatim ॥14॥
5.131.15: prādāt teṣāṁ sa bhagavān divyaṁ cakṣurjanārdanaḥ ॥15॥
5.131.22: cacāla ca mahī kr̥tsnā sāgaraścāpi cukṣubhe,
5.131.23: tataḥ sa puruṣavyāghraḥ sañjahāra vapuḥ svakam,
5.131.27: niścakrāma tataḥ śauriḥ sadhūma iva pāvakaḥ ॥27॥
5.131.32: pratyakṣaṁ te na te kiñcit parokṣaṁ śatrukarśana ॥32॥
5.131.34: na me pāpo’styabhiprāyaḥ pāṇḍavān prati keśava,
5.131.36: droṇaṁ pitāmahaṁ bhīṣmaṁ kṣattāraṁ bāhlikaṁ kr̥pam ॥36॥
5.131.40: bhīṣmo droṇaḥ kr̥paḥ kṣattā dhr̥tarāṣṭro’tha bāhlikaḥ,
5.131.41: kurūṇāṁ paśyatāṁ draṣṭuṁ svasāraṁ sa pituryayau ॥41॥
5.131.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi bhagavadyānaparvaṇi viśvarūpadarśane ekatriṁśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥131॥
5.132.1: ācakhyau tat samāsena yad vr̥ttaṁ kurusaṁsadi ॥1॥
5.132.2: r̥ṣibhiścaiva ca mayā na cāsau tad gr̥hītavān ॥2॥
5.132.3: āpr̥cche bhavatīṁ śīghraṁ prayāsye pāṇḍavān prati ॥3॥
5.132.4: tad brūhi tvaṁ mahāprājñe śuśrūṣe vacanaṁ tava ॥4॥
5.132.5: bhūyāṁste hīyate dharmo mā putraka vr̥thā kr̥thāḥ ॥5॥
5.132.7: aṅgāvekṣasva dharmaṁ tvaṁ yathā sr̥ṣṭaḥ svayambhuvā,
5.132.8: śr̥ṇu cātropamāmekāṁ yā vr̥ddhebhyaḥ śrutā mayā ॥8॥
5.132.9: purā vaiśravaṇaḥ prīto na cāsau tāṁ gr̥hītavān ॥9॥
5.132.12: yaṁ hi dharmaṁ carantīha prajā rājñā surakṣitāḥ,
caturthaṁ tasya dharmasya rājā vindeta bhārata ॥12॥
5.132.13: rājā carati ced dharmaṁ devatvāyaiva kalpate,
5.132.15: daṇḍanītyāṁ yadā rājā samyak kārtsnyena vartate,
tadā kr̥tayugaṁ nāma kālaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ pravartate ॥15॥
5.132.16: kālo vā kāraṇaṁ rājño rājā vā kālakāraṇam,
iti te saṁśayo mā bhūd rājā kālasya kāraṇam ॥16॥
5.132.17: yugasya ca caturthasya rājā bhavati kāraṇam ॥17॥
5.132.20: tato vasati duṣkarmā narake śāśvatīḥ samāḥ,
rājadoṣeṇa hi jagat spr̥śyate jagataḥ sa ca ॥20॥
5.132.21: naitad rājarṣivr̥ttaṁ hi yatra tvaṁ sthātumicchasi ॥21॥
5.132.23: na hyetāmāśiṣaṁ pāṇḍurna cāhaṁ na pitāmahaḥ,
prayuktavantaḥ pūrvaṁ te yayā carasi medhayā ॥23॥
5.132.24: yajño dānaṁ tapaḥ śauryaṁ prajñā santānameva ca,
5.132.27: te tu vaidyāḥ kule jātā avr̥ttyā tāta pīḍitāḥ ॥27॥
5.132.32: sāmnā bhedena dānena daṇḍenātha nayena vā ॥32॥
5.132.33: ito duḥkhataraṁ kiṁ nu yadahaṁ hīnabāndhavā,
5.132.34: mā gamaḥ kṣīṇapuṇyastvaṁ sānujaḥ pāpikāṁ gatim ॥34॥
5.132.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi bhagavadyānaparvaṇi kuntīvākye dvātriṁśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥132॥
5.133.5: na mayā tvaṁ na pitrā ca jātaḥ kvābhyāgato hyasi ॥5॥
5.133.7: manaḥ kr̥tvā sukalyāṇaṁ mā bhaistvaṁ pratisaṁhara ॥7॥
5.133.8: uttiṣṭha he kāpuruṣa mā śeṣvaivaṁ parājitaḥ,
5.133.10: api vā saṁśayaṁ prāpya jīvite’pi parākrameḥ ॥10॥
5.133.12: uttiṣṭha he kāpuruṣa mā svāpsīḥ śatrunirjitaḥ ॥12॥
5.133.13: mā madhye mā jaghanye tvaṁ mādho bhūstiṣṭha garjitaḥ ॥13॥
5.133.15: muhūrtaṁ jvalitaṁ śreyo na ca dhūmāyitaṁ ciram,
mā ha sma kasyacid gehe jani rājñaḥ kharo mr̥duḥ ॥15॥
5.133.17: alabdhvā yadi vā labdhvā nānuśocati paṇḍitaḥ,
5.133.18: udbhāvayasva vīryaṁ vā tāṁ vā gaccha dhruvāṁ gatim,
dharmaṁ putrāgrataḥ kr̥tvā kiṁnimittaṁ hi jīvasi ॥18॥
5.133.19: iṣṭāpūrtaṁ hi te klība kīrtiśca sakalā hatā,
vicchinnaṁ bhogamūlaṁ te kiṁnimittaṁ hi jīvasi ॥19॥
5.133.21: kuru sattvaṁ ca mānaṁ ca viddhi pauruṣamātmanaḥ ॥21॥
5.133.22: udbhāvaya kulaṁ magnaṁ tvatkr̥te svayameva hi,
yasya vr̥ttaṁ na jalpanti mānavā mahadadbhutam ॥22॥
5.133.23: rāśivardhanamātraṁ sa naiva strī na punaḥ pumān,
dāne tapasi satye ca yasya noccaritaṁ yaśaḥ ॥23॥
5.133.24: śrutena tapasā vāpi śriyā vā vikrameṇa vā ॥24॥
5.133.25: janān yo’bhibhavatyanyān karmaṇā hi sa vai pumān,
5.133.33: kṣamāvān niramarṣaśca naiva strī na punaḥ pumān,
santoṣo vai śriyaṁ hanti tathānukrośa eva ca ॥33॥
5.133.35: āyasaṁ hr̥dayaṁ kr̥tvā mr̥gayasva punaḥ svakam,
paraṁ viṣahate yasmāt tasmāt puruṣa ucyate ॥35॥
5.133.37: ya ātmanaḥ priyasukhe hitvā mr̥gayate śriyam ॥37॥
5.133.39: kiṁ nu te māmapaśyantyāḥ pr̥thivyā api sarvayā,
5.133.40: ye tvādr̥tātmanāṁ lokāḥ suhr̥dastān vrajantu naḥ ॥40॥
5.133.42: anu tvāṁ tāta jīvantu brāhmaṇāḥ suhr̥dastathā,
5.133.44: tridaśā iva śakrasya sādhu tasyeha jīvitam ॥44॥
5.133.45: sa loke labhate kīrtiṁ paratra ca śubhāṁ gatim ॥45॥
5.133.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi bhagavadyānaparvaṇi vidulāputrānuśāsane trayastriṁśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥133॥
5.134.2: yo hi tejo yathāśakti na darśayati vikramāt,
kṣatriyo jīvitākāṅkṣī stena ityeva taṁ viduḥ ॥2॥
5.134.4: santi vai sindhurājasya santuṣṭā na tathā janāḥ,
5.134.6: taiḥ kr̥tvā saha saṅghātaṁ giridurgālayaṁ cara,
5.134.7: sañjayo nāmataśca tvaṁ na ca paśyāmi tat tvayi,
anvarthanāmā bhava me putra mā vyarthanāmakaḥ ॥7॥
5.134.8: ayaṁ prāpya mahat kr̥cchraṁ punarvr̥ddhiṁ gamiṣyati ॥8॥
5.134.9: tasmāt tāta bravīmi tvāṁ vakṣyāmi ca punaḥ punaḥ ॥9॥
5.134.11: evaṁ vidvān yuddhamanā bhava mā pratyupāhara ॥11॥
5.134.13: dāridryamiti yat proktaṁ paryāyamaraṇaṁ hi tat ॥13॥
5.134.16: yadā māṁ caiva bhāryāṁ ca draṣṭāsi bhr̥śadurbalām,
na tadā jīvitenārtho bhavitā tava sañjaya ॥16॥
5.134.17: avr̥ttyāsmān prajahato dr̥ṣṭvā kiṁ jīvitena te ॥17॥
5.134.18: yadi kr̥tyaṁ na paśyāmi tavādyāhaṁ yathā purā,
ślāghanīyaṁ yaśasyaṁ ca kā śāntirhr̥dayasya me ॥18॥
5.134.19: neti ced brāhmaṇaṁ brūyāṁ dīryeta hr̥dayaṁ mama,
na hyahaṁ na ca me bhartā neti brāhmaṇamuktavān ॥19॥
5.134.21: apāre bhava naḥ pāramaplave bhava naḥ plavaḥ,
5.134.22: sarve te śatravaḥ śakyā na cejjīvitumicchasi,
5.134.24: māhendraṁ ca gr̥haṁ lebhe lokānāṁ ceśvaro’bhavat ॥24॥
5.134.25: nāma viśrāvya vai saṅkhye śatrūnāhūya daṁśitān,
senāgraṁ cāpi vidrāvya hatvā vā puruṣaṁ varam ॥25॥
5.134.26: yadaiva labhate vīraḥ suyuddhena mahad yaśaḥ,
5.134.27: tyaktvā’’tmānaṁ raṇe dakṣaṁ śūraṁ kāpuruṣā janāḥ,
5.134.28: na labdhasya hi śatrorvai śeṣaṁ kurvanti sādhavaḥ ॥28॥
5.134.31: api tvāṁ nānupaśyeyaṁ dīnād dīnamiva sthitam ॥31॥
5.134.35: nāsmin jātu kule jāto gacched yo’nyasya pr̥ṣṭhataḥ ॥35॥
5.134.36: ahaṁ hi kṣatrahr̥dayaṁ veda yat pariśāśvatam ॥36॥
5.134.38: bhayād vr̥ttisamīkṣo vā na namediha kasyacit ॥38॥
5.134.40: mātaṅgo matta iva ca parīyāt sumahāmanāḥ,
5.134.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi bhagavadyānaparvaṇi vidulāputrānuśāsane catustriṁśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥134॥
5.135.1: kr̥ṣṇāyasasyeva ca te saṁhatya hr̥dayaṁ kr̥tam,
5.135.3: kiṁ nu te māmapaśyantyāḥ pr̥thivyā api sarvayā ॥3॥
5.135.7: taṁ tvāmayaśasā smr̥ṣṭaṁ na brūyāṁ yadi sañjaya ॥7॥
5.135.9: avidyā vai mahatyasti yāmimāṁ saṁśritāḥ prajāḥ,
tava syād yadi sadvr̥ttaṁ tena me tvaṁ priyo bhaveḥ ॥9॥
5.135.12: ramate yastu putreṇa moghaṁ tasya prajāphalam,
akurvanto hi karmāṇi kurvanto ninditāni ca ॥12॥
5.135.13: yuddhāya kṣatriyaḥ sr̥ṣṭaḥ sañjayeha jayāya ca ॥13॥
5.135.14: na śakrabhavane puṇye divi tad vidyate sukham,
5.135.16: ātmānaṁ vā parityajya śatruṁ vā vinipātya ca,
5.135.17: yasya svalpaṁ priyaṁ loke dhruvaṁ tasyālpamapriyam ॥17॥
5.135.19: neyaṁ matistvayā vācyā mātaḥ putre viśeṣataḥ,
5.135.20: codyaṁ māṁ codayasyetad bhr̥śaṁ vai codayāmi te ॥20॥
5.135.21: atha tvāṁ pūjayiṣyāmi hatvā vai sarvasaindhavān,
5.135.23: rājyād bhāvo nivr̥tto me tridivādiva duṣkr̥teḥ,
5.135.25: abhūtvā hi bhavantyarthā bhūtvā naśyanti cāpare,
5.135.26: anityamiti jānanto na bhavanti bhavanti ca ॥26॥
5.135.27: atha ye naiva kurvanti naiva jātu bhavanti te,
5.135.28: atha dvaiguṇyamīhāyāṁ phalaṁ bhavati vā na vā,
5.135.34: spardhinaścaiva ye kecit tān yukta upadhāraya,
etena tvaṁ prakāreṇa mahato bhetsyase gaṇān ॥34॥
5.135.36: te tvāṁ priyaṁ kariṣyanti puro dhāsyanti ca dhruvam,
5.135.37: taṁ viditvā parākrāntaṁ vaśe na kurute yadi,
5.135.38: dhanavantaṁ hi mitrāṇi bhajante cāśrayanti ca ॥38॥
5.135.39: apyasmin nāśvasante ca jugupsante ca tādr̥śam ॥39॥
5.135.40: sa na sambhāvyamevaitad yad rājyaṁ prāpnuyāditi ॥40॥
5.135.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi bhagavadyānaparvaṇi vidulāputrānuśāsane pañcatriṁśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥135॥
5.136.1: naiva rājñā daraḥ kāryo jātu kasyāñcidāpadi,
atha cedapi dīrṇaḥ syānnaiva varteta dīrṇavat ॥1॥
5.136.2: rāṣṭraṁ balamamātyāśca pr̥thak kurvanti te matīḥ ॥2॥
5.136.3: anye tu prajihīrṣanti ye purastād vimānitāḥ ॥3॥
5.136.5: api te pūjitāḥ pūrvamapi te suhr̥do matāḥ ॥5॥
5.136.6: mā dīdarastvaṁ suhr̥do mā tvāṁ dīrṇaṁ prahāsiṣuḥ ॥6॥
5.136.7: prabhāvaṁ pauruṣaṁ buddhiṁ jijñāsantyā mayā tava,
5.136.11: tādr̥śā hi sahāyā vai puruṣasya bubhūṣataḥ,
5.136.13: udake bhūriyaṁ dhāryā martavyaṁ pravaṇe mayā,
5.136.16: sadaśva iva sa kṣiptaḥ praṇunno vākyasāyakaiḥ,
5.136.18: mahīṁ vijayate kṣipraṁ śrutvā śatrūṁśca mardati ॥18॥
5.136.19: abhīkṣṇaṁ garbhiṇī śrutvā dhruvaṁ vīraṁ prajāyate ॥19॥
5.136.20: brāhmyā śriyā dīpyamānaṁ sādhuvāde ca sammatam ॥20॥
5.136.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi bhagavadyānaparvaṇi vidulāputrānuśāsanasamāptau ṣaṭtriṁśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥136॥
5.137.1: arjunaṁ keśava brūyāstvayi jāte sma sūtake,
5.137.3: eṣa jeṣyati saṅgrāme kurūn sarvān samāgatān,
5.137.4: putraste pr̥thivīṁ jetā yaśaścāsya divaṁ spr̥śet,
5.137.8: tvaṁ cāpi tat tathā kr̥ṣṇa sarvaṁ sampādayiṣyasi,
5.137.9: namo dharmāya mahate dharmo dhārayati prajāḥ,
5.137.10: na hi vairaṁ samāsādya sīdanti puruṣarṣabhāḥ ॥10॥
5.137.11: viditā te sadā buddhirbhīmasya na sa śāmyati,
5.137.12: brūyā mādhava kalyāṇīṁ kr̥ṣṇa kr̥ṣṇāṁ yaśasvinīm ॥12॥
5.137.16: pāñcālī paruṣāṇyuktā ko nu tat kṣantumarhati ॥16॥
5.137.17: na rājyaharaṇaṁ duḥkhaṁ dyūte cāpi parājayaḥ,
pravrājanaṁ sutānāṁ vā na me tad duḥkhakāraṇam ॥17॥
5.137.18: yatra sā br̥hatī śyāmā sabhāyāṁ rudatī tadā,
5.137.19: nādhyagacchat tadā nāthaṁ kr̥ṣṇā nāthavatī satī ॥19॥
5.137.20: taṁ vai brūhi mahābāho sarvaśastrabhr̥tāṁ varam,
5.137.21: bhīmārjunau nayetāṁ hi devānapi parāṁ gatim ॥21॥
5.137.23: pāṇḍavān kuśalaṁ pr̥ccheḥ saputrān kr̥ṣṇayā saha ॥23॥
5.137.24: māṁ ca kuśalinīṁ brūyāsteṣu bhūyo janārdana,
ariṣṭaṁ gaccha panthānaṁ putrān me pratipālaya ॥24॥
5.137.25: abhivādyātha tāṁ kr̥ṣṇaḥ kr̥tvā cāpi pradakṣiṇam,
5.137.26: āropyātha rathe karṇaṁ prāyāt sātyakinā saha ॥26॥
5.137.27: tataḥ prayāte dāśārhe kuravaḥ saṅgatā mithaḥ,
5.137.29: mantrayāmāsa ca tadā karṇena suciraṁ saha ॥29॥
5.137.32: te vyatītya mahādhvānaṁ kṣipraṁ śyenā ivāśugāḥ,
5.137.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi bhagavadyānaparvaṇi kuntīvākye saptatriṁśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥137॥
5.138.2: śrutaṁ te puruṣavyāghra kuntyāḥ kr̥ṣṇasya saṁnidhau,
5.138.3: na hi te jātu śāmyerannr̥te rājyena kaurava ॥3॥
5.138.4: sabhāyāṁ draupadī caiva taiśca tanmarṣitaṁ tava ॥4॥
5.138.5: kr̥tāstraṁ hyarjunaṁ prāpya bhīmaṁ ca kr̥taniścayam,
gāṇḍīvaṁ ceṣudhī caiva rathaṁ ca dhvajameva ca ॥5॥
5.138.6: sahāyaṁ vāsudevaṁ ca na kṣaṁsyati yudhiṣṭhiraḥ ॥6॥
5.138.7: pratyakṣaṁ te mahābāho yathā pārthena dhīmatā,
virāṭanagare pūrvaṁ sarve sma yudhi nirjitāḥ ॥7॥
5.138.11: jyeṣṭho bhrātā dharmaśīlo vatsalaḥ ślakṣṇavāk kaviḥ,
5.138.12: praśāntabhr̥kuṭiḥ śrīmān kr̥tā śāntiḥ kulasya naḥ ॥12॥
5.138.17: tau ca tvāṁ guruvat premṇā pūjayā pratyudīyatām ॥17॥
5.138.18: saṅgaccha bhrātr̥bhiḥ sārdhaṁ mānaṁ santyajya pārthiva ॥18॥
5.138.19: praśādhi pr̥thivīṁ kr̥tsnāṁ tatastvaṁ bhrātr̥bhiḥ saha,
samāliṅgya ca harṣeṇa nr̥pā yāntu parasparam ॥19॥
5.138.20: alaṁ yuddhena rājendra suhr̥dāṁ śr̥ṇu vāraṇam,
dhruvaṁ vināśo yuddhe hi kṣatriyāṇāṁ pradr̥śyate ॥20॥
5.138.25: tvayyāyatto mahābāho śamo vyāyāma eva ca ॥25॥
5.138.27: bhīmasya ca mahānādaṁ nadataḥ śuṣmiṇo raṇe,
śrutvā smartāsi me vākyaṁ gāṇḍīvasya ca niḥsvanam,
5.138.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi bhagavadyānaparvaṇi bhīṣmadroṇavākye aṣṭātriṁśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥138॥
5.139.1: saṁhatya ca bhruvormadhyaṁ na kiñcid vyājahāra ha ॥1॥
5.139.4: aśvatthāmni yathā putre bhūyo mama dhanañjaye,
5.139.5: taṁ ca putrāt priyatamaṁ pratiyotsye dhanañjayam,
5.139.6: yasya loke samo nāsti kaścidanyo dhanurdharaḥ,
5.139.7: na satsu labhate pūjāṁ yajñe mūrkha ivāgataḥ ॥7॥
5.139.10: tvamuktaḥ kuruvr̥ddhena mayā ca vidureṇa ca,
5.139.11: asti me balamityeva sahasā tvaṁ titīrṣasi,
5.139.12: srajaṁ tyaktāmiva prāpya lobhād yaudhiṣṭhirīṁ śriyam ॥12॥
5.139.14: nideśe yasya rājānaḥ sarve tiṣṭhanti kiṅkarāḥ,
5.139.17: tvaṁ tu hitvā sukhaṁ rājyaṁ mitrāṇi ca dhanāni ca,
5.139.19: mantrī janārdano yasya bhrātā yasya dhanañjayaḥ,
5.139.21: punaruktaṁ ca vakṣyāmi yat kāryaṁ bhūtimicchatā,
5.139.22: alaṁ yuddhena tairvīraiḥ śāmya tvaṁ kuruvr̥ddhaye,
5.139.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi bhagavadyānaparvaṇi bhīṣmadroṇavākye ekonacatvāriṁśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥139॥
5.140.3: mr̥du vā yadi vā tīkṣṇaṁ tanmamācakṣva sañjaya ॥3॥
5.140.4: ānupūrvyeṇa vākyāni tīkṣṇāni ca mr̥dūni ca,
priyāṇi dharmayuktāni satyāni ca hitāni ca ॥4॥
5.140.8: voḍhāraṁ pitaraṁ tasya prāhuḥ śāstravido janāḥ ॥8॥
5.140.9: so’si karṇa tathā jātaḥ pāṇḍoḥ putro’si dharmataḥ,
5.140.10: pitr̥pakṣe ca te pārthā mātr̥pakṣe ca vr̥ṣṇayaḥ,
5.140.11: mayā sārdhamito yātamadya tvāṁ tāta pāṇḍavāḥ,
5.140.12: pādau tava grahīṣyanti bhrātaraḥ pañca pāṇḍavāḥ,
5.140.16: agniṁ juhotu vai dhaumyaḥ saṁśitātmā dvijottamaḥ,
5.140.20: chatraṁ ca te mahāśvetaṁ bhīmaseno mahābalaḥ ॥20॥
5.140.25: bhuṅkṣva rājyaṁ mahābāho bhrātr̥bhiḥ saha pāṇḍavaiḥ,
5.140.26: purogamāśca te santu draviḍāḥ saha kuntalaiḥ,
5.140.27: stuvantu tvāṁ ca bahubhiḥ stutibhiḥ sūtamāgadhāḥ,
5.140.28: praśādhi rājyaṁ kaunteya kuntīṁ ca pratinandaya ॥28॥
5.140.29: saubhrātraṁ caiva te’dyāstu bhrātr̥bhiḥ saha pāṇḍavaiḥ ॥29॥
5.140.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi bhagavadyānaparvaṇi śrīkr̥ṣṇavākye catvāriṁśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥140॥
5.141.2: niścayād dharmaśāstrāṇāṁ yathā tvaṁ kr̥ṣṇa manyase ॥2॥
5.141.4: so’smi kr̥ṣṇa tathā jātaḥ pāṇḍoḥ putro’smi dharmataḥ,
kuntyā tvahamapākīrṇo yathā na kuśalaṁ tathā ॥4॥
5.141.6: sā me mūtraṁ purīṣaṁ ca pratijagrāha mādhava ॥6॥
5.141.9: sa hi me jātakarmādi kārayāmāsa mādhava,
5.141.10: nāma vai vasuṣeṇeti kārayāmāsa vai dvijaiḥ,
5.141.11: tāsu putrāśca pautrāśca mama jātā janārdana,
tāsu me hr̥dayaṁ kr̥ṣṇa sañjātaṁ kāmabandhanam ॥11॥
5.141.12: na pr̥thivyā sakalayā na suvarṇasya rāśibhiḥ,
harṣād bhayād vā govinda mithyā kartuṁ tadutsahe ॥12॥
5.141.15: māṁ ca kr̥ṣṇa samāsādya kr̥taḥ śastrasamudyamaḥ,
5.141.17: vadhād bandhād bhayād vāpi lobhād vāpi janārdana,
5.141.18: yadi hyadya na gaccheyaṁ dvairathaṁ savyasācinā,
5.141.21: yadi jānāti māṁ rājā dharmātmā saṁyatendriyaḥ,
kuntyāḥ prathamajaṁ putraṁ na sa rājyaṁ grahīṣyati ॥21॥
5.141.22: prāpya cāpi mahad rājyaṁ tadahaṁ madhusūdana,
5.141.23: sa eva rājā dharmātmā śāśvato’stu yudhiṣṭhiraḥ,
netā yasya hr̥ṣīkeśo yoddhā yasya dhanañjayaḥ ॥23॥
5.141.24: pr̥thivī tasya rāṣṭraṁ ca yasya bhīmo mahārathaḥ,
5.141.27: śaṅkhaḥ putro virāṭasya nidhistvaṁ ca janārdana ॥27॥
5.141.29: asya yajñasya vettā tvaṁ bhaviṣyasi janārdana ॥29॥
5.141.30: ādhvaryavaṁ ca te kr̥ṣṇa kratāvasmin bhaviṣyati,
hotā caivātra bībhatsuḥ saṁnaddhaḥ sa kapidhvajaḥ ॥30॥
5.141.31: gāṇḍīvaṁ sruk tathā cājyaṁ vīryaṁ puṁsāṁ bhaviṣyati,
aindraṁ pāśupataṁ brāhmaṁ sthūṇākarṇaṁ ca mādhava,
5.141.32: gītaṁ stotraṁ sa saubhadraḥ samyak tatra bhaviṣyati ॥32॥
5.141.34: sa caiva tatra dharmātmā śaśvad rājā yudhiṣṭhiraḥ,
5.141.36: śāmitraṁ tau mahāvīryau samyak tatra bhaviṣyataḥ ॥36॥
5.141.39: havistu rudhiraṁ kr̥ṣṇa tasmin yajñe bhaviṣyati ॥39॥
5.141.44: vaitānike karmamukhe jāto yaḥ kr̥ṣṇa pāvakāt ॥44॥
5.141.46: yadā drakṣyasi māṁ kr̥ṣṇa nihataṁ savyasācinā,
5.141.47: ānardaṁ nardataḥ samyak tadā sutyaṁ bhaviṣyati ॥47॥
5.141.48: yadā droṇaṁ ca bhīṣmaṁ ca pāñcālyau pātayiṣyataḥ,
5.141.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi bhagavadyānaparvaṇi karṇopanivāde ekacatvāriṁśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥141॥
5.142.2: api tvāṁ na labhet karṇa rājyalambhopapādanam,
mayā dattāṁ hi pr̥thivīṁ na praśāsitumicchasi ॥2॥
5.142.7: na tadā bhavitā tretā na kr̥taṁ dvāparaṁ na ca ॥7॥
5.142.9: na tadā bhavitā tretā na kr̥taṁ dvāparaṁ na ca ॥9॥
5.142.11: na tadā bhavitā tretā na kr̥taṁ dvāparaṁ na ca ॥11॥
5.142.12: yadā drakṣyasi saṅgrāme droṇaṁ śāntanavaṁ kr̥pam,
suyodhanaṁ ca rājānaṁ saindhavaṁ ca jayadratham ॥12॥
5.142.13: na tadā bhavitā tretā na kr̥taṁ dvāparaṁ na ca ॥13॥
5.142.15: na tadā bhavitā tretā na kr̥taṁ dvāparaṁ na ca ॥15॥
5.142.16: brūyāḥ karṇa ito gatvā droṇaṁ śāntanavaṁ kr̥pam,
5.142.19: tathā rājño vadeḥ sarvān ye yuddhāyābhyupāgatāḥ,
yad vo manīṣitaṁ tad vai sarvaṁ sampādayāmyaham ॥19॥
5.142.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi bhagavadyānaparvaṇi karṇopanivāde bhagavadvākye dvicatvāriṁśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥142॥
5.143.1: keśavasya tu tad vākyaṁ karṇaḥ śrutvā hitaṁ śubham,
5.143.6: svapnā hi bahavo ghorā dr̥śyante madhusūdana,
5.143.10: viśeṣeṇa hi vārṣṇeya citrāṁ pīḍayate grahaḥ ॥10॥
5.143.14: alpe bhukte purīṣaṁ ca prabhūtamiha dr̥śyate,
vājināṁ vāraṇānāṁ ca manuṣyāṇāṁ ca keśava ॥14॥
5.143.19: gr̥dhrāḥ kaṅkā bakāḥ śyenā yātudhānāstathā vr̥kāḥ,
5.143.24: śivā ca vāśate ghoraṁ tat parābhavalakṣaṇam ॥24॥
5.143.28: pūrvā dig lohitākārā śastravarṇā ca dakṣiṇā,
5.143.32: tava cāpi mayā kr̥ṣṇa svapnānte rudhirāvilā,
5.143.34: tvayā dattāmimāṁ vyaktaṁ bhokṣyate sa vasundharām ॥34॥
5.143.36: kṣapayiṣyati naḥ sarvān sa suvyaktaṁ mahāraṇe,
viditaṁ me hr̥ṣīkeśa yato dharmastato jayaḥ ॥36॥
5.143.37: tvayā sārdhaṁ hr̥ṣīkeśa śriyā paramayā jvalan ॥37॥
5.143.38: yūyaṁ sarve vadhiṣyadhvaṁ tatra me nāsti saṁśayaḥ,
5.143.43: mayā sārdhaṁ mahābāho dhārtarāṣṭreṇa vā vibho ॥43॥
5.143.44: agastyaśāstāṁ ca diśaṁ prayātāḥ sma janārdana,
5.143.45: ahaṁ cānye ca rājāno yacca tat kṣatramaṇḍalam,
gāṇḍīvāgniṁ pravekṣyāma iti me nāsti saṁśayaḥ ॥45॥
5.143.46: yathā hi me vacaḥ karṇa nopaiti hr̥dayaṁ tava ॥46॥
5.143.49: athavā saṅgamaḥ kr̥ṣṇa svarge no bhavitā dhruvam,
5.143.50: ityuktvā mādhavaṁ karṇaḥ pariṣvajya ca pīḍitam,
5.143.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi bhagavadyānaparvaṇi karṇopanivāde kr̥ṣṇakarṇasaṁvāde tricatvāriṁśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥143॥
5.144.2: krośato na ca gr̥hṇīte vacanaṁ me suyodhanaḥ ॥2॥
5.144.4: kāṅkṣate jñāti sauhārdād balavān durbalo yathā ॥4॥
5.144.5: rājā tu dhr̥tarāṣṭro’yaṁ vayovr̥ddho na śāmyati,
5.144.6: saubalasya ca durbuddhyā mitho bhedaḥ prapatsyate ॥6॥
5.144.8: kriyamāṇe balād dharme kurubhiḥ ko na sañjvaret,
5.144.9: cintayan na labhe nidrāmahaḥsu ca niśāsu ca ॥9॥
5.144.10: sā niḥśvasantī duḥkhārtā manasā vimamarśa ha ॥10॥
5.144.11: vartsyate suhr̥dāṁ caiva yuddhe’smin vai parābhavaḥ ॥11॥
5.144.12: bhārataiḥ saha yotsyanti kiṁ nu duḥkhamataḥ param ॥12॥
5.144.13: paśye doṣaṁ dhruvaṁ yuddhe tathāyuddhe parābhavam,
adhanasya mr̥taṁ śreyo na hi jñātikṣayo jayaḥ ॥13॥
5.144.14: iti me cintayantyā vai hr̥di duḥkhaṁ pravartate,
5.144.16: pāṇḍaveṣu kathaṁ hārdaṁ kuryānna ca pitāmahaḥ,
5.144.17: mohānuvartī satataṁ pāpo dveṣṭi ca pāṇḍavān,
5.144.18: karṇaḥ sadā pāṇḍavānāṁ tanme dahati samprati,
āśaṁse tvadya karṇasya mano’haṁ pāṇḍavān prati ॥18॥
5.144.19: toṣito bhagavān yatra durvāsā me varaṁ dadau ॥19॥
5.144.21: balābalaṁ ca mantrāṇāṁ brāhmaṇasya ca vāgbalam ॥21॥
5.144.23: kathaṁ nu sukr̥taṁ me syānnāparādhavatī katham ॥23॥
5.144.24: bhaveyamiti sañcintya brāhmaṇaṁ taṁ namasya ca,
kautūhalāt tu taṁ labdhvā bāliśyādācaraṁ tadā,
5.144.25: kasmānna kuryād vacanaṁ pathyaṁ bhrātr̥hitaṁ tathā ॥25॥
5.144.31: utsmayan praṇataḥ prāha kuntīṁ vaikartano vr̥ṣaḥ ॥31॥
5.144.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi bhagavadyānaparvaṇi kuntīkarṇasamāgame catuścatvāriṁśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥144॥
5.145.1: prāptā kimarthaṁ bhavatī brūhi kiṁ karavāṇi te ॥1॥
5.145.2: kaunteyastvaṁ na rādheyo na tavādhirathaḥ pitā,
nāsi sūtakule jātaḥ karṇa tad viddhi me vacaḥ ॥2॥
5.145.3: kānīnastvaṁ mayā jātaḥ pūrvajaḥ kukṣiṇā dhr̥taḥ,
5.145.4: ajījanat tvāṁ mayyeṣa karṇa śastrabhr̥tāṁ varam ॥4॥
5.145.6: dhārtarāṣṭrān na tad yuktaṁ tvayi putra viśeṣataḥ ॥6॥
5.145.10: asādhyaṁ kiṁ tu loke syād yuvayoḥ saṁhitātmanoḥ ॥10॥
5.145.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi bhagavadyānaparvaṇi kuntīkarṇasamāgame pañcacatvāriṁśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥145॥
5.146.2: satyamāha pr̥thā vākyaṁ karṇa mātr̥vacaḥ kuru,
5.146.3: evamuktasya mātrā ca svayaṁ pitrā ca bhānunā,
5.146.4: na caitacchraddadhe vākyaṁ kṣatriye bhāṣitaṁ tvayā,
5.146.6: ahaṁ cet kṣatriyo jāto na prāptaḥ kṣatrasatkriyām,
tvatkr̥te kiṁ nu pāpīyaḥ śatruḥ kuryānmamāhitam ॥6॥
5.146.8: na vai mama hitaṁ pūrvaṁ mātr̥vacceṣṭitaṁ tvayā,
5.146.9: kr̥ṣṇena sahitāt ko vai na vyatheta dhanañjayāt,
ko’dya bhītaṁ na māṁ vidyāt pārthānāṁ samitiṁ gatam ॥9॥
5.146.10: pāṇḍavān yadi gacchāmi kiṁ māṁ kṣatraṁ vadiṣyati ॥10॥
5.146.11: ahaṁ vai dhārtarāṣṭrāṇāṁ kuryāṁ tadaphalaṁ katham ॥11॥
5.146.12: namaskurvanti ca sadā vasavo vāsavaṁ yathā ॥12॥
5.146.13: manyante te kathaṁ teṣāmahaṁ chindyāṁ manoratham ॥13॥
5.146.14: apāre pārakāmā ye tyajeyaṁ tānahaṁ katham ॥14॥
5.146.16: kr̥tārthāḥ subhr̥tā ye hi kr̥tyakāle hyupasthite,
5.146.17: naivāyaṁ na paro loko vidyate pāpakarmaṇām ॥17॥
5.146.18: balaṁ ca śaktiṁ cāsthāya na vai tvayyanr̥taṁ vade ॥18॥
5.146.20: na ca te’yaṁ samārambho mayi mogho bhaviṣyati,
vadhyān viṣahyān saṅgrāme na haniṣyāmi te sutān ॥20॥
5.146.21: yudhiṣṭhiraṁ ca bhīmaṁ ca yamau caivārjunādr̥te,
5.146.22: arjunaṁ hi nihatyājau samprāptaṁ syāt phalaṁ mayā,
5.146.23: na te jātu na śiṣyanti putrāḥ pañca yaśasvini,
nirarjunāḥ sakarṇā vā sārjunā vā hate mayi ॥23॥
5.146.24: iti karṇavacaḥ śrutvā kuntī duḥkhāt pravepatī,
5.146.25: evaṁ vai bhāvyametena kṣayaṁ yāsyanti kauravāḥ,
yathā tvaṁ bhāṣase karṇa daivaṁ tu balavattaram ॥25॥
5.146.27: tāṁ karṇo’tha tathetyuktvā tatastau jagmatuḥ pr̥thak ॥27॥
5.146.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi bhagavadyānaparvaṇi kuntīkarṇasamāgame ṣaṭcatvāriṁśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥146॥
5.147.2: sambhāṣya suciraṁ kālaṁ mantrayitvā punaḥ punaḥ,
5.147.3: pāṇḍavā bhrātaraḥ pañca bhānāvastaṁ gate sati ॥3॥
5.147.6: tathyaṁ pathyaṁ hitaṁ cokto na ca gr̥hṇāti durmatiḥ ॥6॥
5.147.8: pitā vā dhr̥tarāṣṭrastaṁ gāndhārī vā kimabravīt ॥8॥
5.147.10: kiṁ ca sarve nr̥patayaḥ sabhāyāṁ ye samāsate,
uktavanto yathātattvaṁ tad brūhi tvaṁ janārdana ॥10॥
5.147.11: uktavān hi bhavān sarvaṁ vacanaṁ kurumukhyayoḥ,
5.147.12: apriyaṁ hr̥daye mahyaṁ tanna tiṣṭhati keśava ॥12॥
5.147.13: yathā ca nābhipadyeta kālastāta tathā kuru,
bhavān hi no gatiḥ kr̥ṣṇa bhavān nātho bhavān guruḥ ॥13॥
5.147.14: śr̥ṇu rājan yathā vākyamukto rājā suyodhanaḥ,
madhye kurūṇāṁ rājendra sabhāyāṁ tannibodha me ॥14॥
5.147.16: duryodhana nibodhedaṁ kulārthe yad bravīmi te,
5.147.18: tasya buddhiḥ samutpannā dvitīyaḥ syāt kathaṁ sutaḥ,
5.147.19: na cocchedaṁ kulaṁ yāyād vistīryecca kathaṁ yaśaḥ,
5.147.20: pratijñāṁ duṣkarāṁ kr̥tvā piturarthe kulasya ca,
5.147.25: yadā tvarājake rāṣṭre na vavarṣa sureśvaraḥ,
5.147.26: upakṣīṇāḥ prajāḥ sarvā rājā bhava bhavāya naḥ,
ītīḥ praṇuda bhadraṁ te śāntanoḥ kulavardhana ॥26॥
5.147.28: vyādhīn praṇuda vīra tvaṁ prajā dharmeṇa pālaya,
5.147.29: prajānāṁ krośatīnāṁ vai naivākṣubhyata me manaḥ,
5.147.30: tataḥ paurā mahārāja mātā kālī ca me śubhā,
5.147.31: sa tvamasmaddhitārthaṁ vai rājā bhava mahāmate ॥31॥
5.147.33: ūrdhvaretā hyarājā ca kulasyārthe punaḥ punaḥ,
viśeṣatastvadarthaṁ ca dhuri mā māṁ niyojaya ॥33॥
5.147.35: pratijñāṁ vitathāṁ kuryāmiti rājan punaḥ punaḥ,
5.147.37: saha mātrā mahārāja prasādya tamr̥ṣiṁ tadā ॥37॥
5.147.39: andhaḥ karaṇahīnatvānna vai rājā pitā tava,
5.147.40: sa rājā tasya te putrāḥ piturdāyādyahāriṇaḥ,
mā tāta kalahaṁ kārṣī rājyasyārdhaṁ pradīyatām ॥40॥
5.147.41: mayi jīvati rājyaṁ kaḥ sampraśāset pumāniha,
māvamaṁsthā vaco mahyaṁ śamamicchāmi vaḥ sadā ॥41॥
5.147.42: na viśeṣo’sti me putra tvayi teṣu ca pārthiva,
5.147.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi bhagavadyānaparvaṇi bhagavadvākye saptacatvāriṁśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥147॥
5.148.1: madhye nr̥pāṇāṁ bhadraṁ te vacanaṁ vacanakṣamaḥ ॥1॥
5.148.5: vanaṁ jagāma kauravyo bhāryābhyāṁ sahito nr̥paḥ ॥5॥
5.148.6: nīcaiḥ sthitvā tu vidura upāste sma vinītavat,
5.148.12: kathaṁ tasya kule jātaḥ kulabhedaṁ vyavasyasi,
sambhūya bhrātr̥bhiḥ sārdhaṁ bhuṅkṣva bhogān janādhipa ॥12॥
5.148.14: yato bhīṣmastato droṇo yad bhīṣmastvāha tat kuru ॥14॥
5.148.15: samamācāryakaṁ tāta tava teṣāṁ ca me sadā ॥15॥
5.148.16: aśvatthāmā yathā mahyaṁ tathā śvetahayo mama,
bahunā kiṁ pralāpena yato dharmastato jayaḥ ॥16॥
5.148.22: yathā te na praṇaśyeyurmahārāja tathā kuru,
māṁ caiva dhr̥tarāṣṭraṁ ca pūrvameva mahāmate ॥22॥
5.148.23: prajāpatiḥ prajāḥ sr̥ṣṭvā yathā saṁharate tathā ॥23॥
5.148.25: vanaṁ gaccha mayā sārdhaṁ dhr̥tarāṣṭreṇa caiva ha,
5.148.27: pradhyāyamānaḥ sa tadā niḥśvasaṁśca punaḥ punaḥ ॥27॥
5.148.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi bhagavadyānaparvaṇi śrīkr̥ṣṇavākye aṣṭacatvāriṁśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥148॥
5.149.2: duryodhana nibodhedaṁ yat tvāṁ vakṣyāmi putraka,
tathā tat kuru bhadraṁ te yadyasti pitr̥gauravam ॥2॥
5.149.7: avamene sa tu kṣatraṁ darpapūrṇaḥ sumandadhīḥ ॥7॥
5.149.17: dhārmikaḥ satyavādī ca pituḥ śuśrūṣaṇe rataḥ ॥17॥
5.149.19: vartamānaḥ pituḥ śāstre brāhmaṇānāṁ tathaiva ca ॥19॥
5.149.20: saubhrātraṁ ca paraṁ teṣāṁ sahitānāṁ mahātmanām ॥20॥
5.149.26: nivāritaṁ nr̥paṁ dr̥ṣṭvā devāpiḥ saṁśrito vanam ॥26॥
5.149.30: pāṇḍustu rājyaṁ samprāptaḥ kanīyānapi san nr̥paḥ,
5.149.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi bhagavadyānaparvaṇi dhr̥tarāṣṭravākyakathane ekonapañcāśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥149॥
5.150.1: evamukte tu bhīṣmeṇa droṇena vidureṇa ca,
5.150.3: prayādhvaṁ vai kurukṣetraṁ puṣyo’dyeti punaḥ punaḥ ॥3॥
5.150.6: yadatra yuktaṁ prāptaṁ ca tad vidhatsva viśāmpate,
uktaṁ bhīṣmeṇa yad vākyaṁ droṇena vidureṇa ca ॥6॥
5.150.7: etat te kathitaṁ rājan yad vr̥ttaṁ kurusaṁsadi ॥7॥
5.150.9: punarbhedaśca me yukto yadā sāma na gr̥hyate,
5.150.11: adbhutāni ca ghorāṇi dāruṇāni ca bhārata,
5.150.12: rādheyaṁ bhīṣayitvā ca saubalaṁ ca punaḥ punaḥ ॥12॥
5.150.13: dyūtato dhārtarāṣṭrāṇāṁ nindāṁ kr̥tvā tathā punaḥ,
5.150.15: te śūrā dhr̥tarāṣṭrasya bhīṣmasya vidurasya ca,
5.150.16: prayacchantu ca te rājyamanīśāste bhavantu ca,
yathā’’ha rājā gāṅgeyo viduraśca hitaṁ tava ॥16॥
5.150.17: sarvaṁ bhavatu te rājyaṁ pañca grāmān visarjaya,
5.150.18: daṇḍaṁ caturthaṁ paśyāmi teṣu pāpeṣu nānyathā ॥18॥
5.150.19: etat te kathitaṁ rājan yad vr̥ttaṁ kurusaṁsadi ॥19॥
5.150.20: na te rājyaṁ prayacchanti vinā yuddhena pāṇḍava,
5.150.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi bhagavadyānaparvaṇi śrīkr̥ṣṇavākye pañcāśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥150॥
5.151.4: tāsāṁ ye patayaḥ sapta vikhyātāstān nibodhata,
5.151.8: yaḥ saheta raṇe bhīṣmaṁ śarārciḥ pāvakopamam,
svamataṁ puruṣavyāghra ko naḥ senāpatiḥ kṣamaḥ ॥8॥
5.151.13: yo nityaṁ spardhate droṇaṁ bhīṣmaṁ caiva mahābalam ॥13॥
5.151.17: sa hi divyāstravid rājā sakhā cāṅgiraso nr̥paḥ ॥17॥
5.151.27: puruṣaṁ taṁ na paśyāmi yaḥ saheta mahāvratam,
5.151.31: na taṁ yuddhe prapaśyāmi yo bhindyāt tu śikhaṇḍinam,
śastreṇa samare rājan saṁnaddhaṁ syandane sthitam ॥31॥
5.151.33: sarvaṁ jānāti dharmātmā matameṣāṁ ca keśavaḥ ॥33॥
5.151.34: kr̥tāstro’pyakr̥tāstro vā vr̥ddho vā yadi vā yuvā ॥34॥
5.151.35: eṣa no vijaye mūlameṣa tāta viparyaye,
atra prāṇāśca rājyaṁ ca bhāvābhāvau sukhāsukhe ॥35॥
5.151.36: eṣa dhātā vidhātā ca siddhiratra pratiṣṭhitā,
yamāha kr̥ṣṇo dāśārhaḥ so’stu no vāhinīpatiḥ ॥36॥
5.151.39: tasya tad vacanaṁ śrutvā dharmarājasya dhīmataḥ,
5.151.41: sarva eva samarthā hi tava śatruṁ prabādhitum,
5.151.43: kr̥to yatno mahāṁstatra śamaḥ syāditi bhārata,
dharmasya gatamānr̥ṇyaṁ na sma vācyā vivakṣatām ॥43॥
5.151.45: yujyatāṁ vāhinī sādhu vadhasādhyā hi me matāḥ,
na dhārtarāṣṭrāḥ śakṣyanti sthātuṁ dr̥ṣṭvā dhanañjayam ॥45॥
5.151.46: bhīmasenaṁ ca saṅkruddhaṁ yamau cāpi yamopamau,
5.151.57: teṣāṁ madhye yayau rājā kuntīputro yudhiṣṭhiraḥ ॥57॥
5.151.58: kośaṁ yantrāyudhaṁ caiva ye ca vaidyāścikitsakāḥ ॥58॥
5.151.59: phalgu yacca balaṁ kiñcid yaccāpi kr̥śadurbalam,
tat saṅgr̥hya yayau rājā ye cāpi paricārakāḥ ॥59॥
5.151.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi sainyaniryāṇaparvaṇi kurukṣetrapraveśe ekapañcāśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥151॥
5.152.11: śibirāṇi mahārhāṇi rājñāṁ tatra pr̥thak pr̥thak,
5.152.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi sainyaniryāṇaparvaṇi śibirādinirmāṇe dvipañcāśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥152॥
5.153.3: śrutvā duryodhano rājā kiṁ kāryaṁ pratyapadyata ॥3॥
5.153.7: kurūṇāṁ pāṇḍavānāṁ ca yad yadāsīd viceṣṭitam ॥7॥
5.153.11: nikr̥taśca mayā pūrvaṁ saha sarvaiḥ sahodaraiḥ ॥11॥
5.153.16: samāśca teṣāṁ panthānaḥ kriyantāṁ nagarād bahiḥ ॥16॥
5.153.17: prayāṇaṁ ghuṣyatāmadya śvobhūta iti mā ciram,
te tatheti pratijñāya śvobhūte cakrire tathā ॥17॥
5.153.21: te rathān rathinaḥ śreṣṭhā hayāṁśca hayakovidāḥ,
5.153.22: atha varmāṇi citrāṇi kāñcanāni bahūni ca,
vividhāni ca śastrāṇi cakruḥ sarvāṇi sarvaśaḥ ॥22॥
5.153.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi sainyaniryāṇaparvaṇi duryodhanasainyasajjakaraṇe tripañcāśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥153॥
5.154.2: asminnabhyāgate kāle kiṁ ca naḥ kṣamamacyuta,
kathaṁ ca vartamānā vai svadharmānna cyavemahi ॥2॥
5.154.4: vidurasyāpi tad vākyaṁ śrutaṁ bhīṣmasya cobhayoḥ,
kuntyāśca vipulaprajña prajñā kārtsnyena te śrutā ॥4॥
5.154.8: na ca bhīṣmasya durmedhāḥ śr̥ṇoti vidurasya vā,
5.154.9: naiṣa kāmayate dharmaṁ naiṣa kāmayate yaśaḥ,
jitaṁ sa manyate sarvaṁ durātmā karṇamāśritaḥ ॥9॥
5.154.10: na ca taṁ labdhavān kāmaṁ durātmā pāpaniścayaḥ ॥10॥
5.154.11: na ca bhīṣmo na ca droṇo yuktaṁ tatrāhaturvacaḥ,
5.154.13: kiṁ ca tena mayoktena yānyabhāṣata kauravaḥ,
saṅkṣepeṇa durātmāsau na yuktaṁ tvayi vartate ॥13॥
5.154.14: pārthiveṣu na sarveṣu ya ime tava sainikāḥ,
yat pāpaṁ yannakalyāṇaṁ sarvaṁ tasmin pratiṣṭhitam ॥14॥
5.154.20: yadarthaṁ vanavāsaśca prāptaṁ duḥkhaṁ ca yanmayā,
5.154.21: tasmin yatnaḥ kr̥to’smābhiḥ sa no hīnaḥ prayatnataḥ,
5.154.22: kathaṁ hyavadhyaiḥ saṅgrāmaḥ kāryaḥ saha bhaviṣyati,
kathaṁ hatvā gurūn vr̥ddhān vijayo no bhaviṣyati ॥22॥
5.154.25: na ca tau vakṣyato’dharmamiti me naiṣṭhikī matiḥ,
5.154.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi sainyaniryāṇaparvaṇi yudhiṣṭhirārjunasaṁvāde catuṣpañcāśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥154॥
5.155.1: vyuṣṭāyāṁ vai rajanyāṁ hi rājā duryodhanastataḥ,
vyabhajat tānyanīkāni daśa caikaṁ ca bhārata ॥1॥
5.155.2: narahastirathāśvānāṁ sāraṁ madhyaṁ ca phalgu ca,
5.155.14: tau cāpi rathināṁ śreṣṭhau rathī ca hayavit tathā ॥14॥
5.155.18: tad babhūva balaṁ rājan kauravyasya mahātmanaḥ ॥18॥
5.155.22: rathasyāsan daśa gajā gajasya daśa vājinaḥ,
5.155.24: senā pañcaśataṁ nāgā rathāstāvanta eva ca,
daśa senā ca pr̥tanā pr̥tanā daśavāhinī ॥24॥
5.155.25: senā ca vāhinī caiva pr̥tanā dhvajinī camūḥ,
5.155.26: akṣauhiṇyo daśaikā ca saṅkhyātāḥ sapta caiva ha ॥26॥
5.155.30: tatra duryodhano rājā śūrān buddhimato narān,
5.155.32: kr̥paṁ droṇaṁ ca śalyaṁ ca saindhavaṁ ca jayadratham,
5.155.33: droṇaputraṁ ca karṇaṁ ca bhūriśravasameva ca,
śakuniṁ saubalaṁ caiva bāhlīkaṁ ca mahābalam ॥33॥
5.155.34: divase divase teṣāṁ prativelaṁ ca bhārata,
cakre sa vividhāḥ pūjāḥ pratyakṣaṁ ca punaḥ punaḥ ॥34॥
5.155.35: tathā viniyatāḥ sarve ye ca teṣāṁ padānugāḥ,
5.155.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi sainyaniryāṇaparvaṇi duryodhanasainyavibhāge pañcapañcāśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥155॥
5.156.3: na hi jātu dvayorbuddhiḥ samā bhavati karhicit,
śauryaṁ ca balanetr̥̄ṇāṁ spardhate ca parasparam ॥3॥
5.156.6: tato yuddheṣvabhajyanta trayo varṇāḥ punaḥ punaḥ,
5.156.10: senāpatiṁ prakurvanti te jayanti raṇe ripūn ॥10॥
5.156.11: bhavānuśanasā tulyo hitaiṣī ca sadā mama,
asaṁhāryaḥ sthito dharme sa naḥ senāpatirbhava ॥11॥
5.156.13: parvatānāṁ yathā meruḥ suparṇaḥ pakṣiṇāṁ yathā,
5.156.14: bhavatā hi vaṁya guptāḥ śakreṇeva divaukasaḥ,
5.156.16: yathaiva hi bhavanto me tathaiva mama pāṇḍavāḥ ॥16॥
5.156.17: api caiva mayā śreyo vācyaṁ teṣāṁ narādhipa,
saṁyoddhavyaṁ tavārthāya yathā me samayaḥ kr̥taḥ ॥17॥
5.156.18: na tu paśyāmi yoddhāramātmanaḥ sadr̥śaṁ bhuvi,
5.156.19: na tu māṁ vivr̥to yuddhe jātu yudhyeta pāṇḍavaḥ ॥19॥
5.156.21: na tvevotsādanīyā me pāṇḍoḥ putrā janādhipa,
5.156.22: na cet te māṁ haniṣyanti pūrvameva samāgame ॥22॥
5.156.24: karṇo vā yudhyatāṁ pūrvamahaṁ vā pr̥thivīpate,
spardhate hi sadātyarthaṁ sūtaputro mayā raṇe ॥24॥
5.156.25: nāhaṁ jīvati gāṅgeye rājan yotsye kathañcana,
hate bhīṣme tu yotsyāmi saha gāṇḍīvadhanvanā ॥25॥
5.156.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi sainyaniryāṇaparvaṇi bhīṣmasaināpatye ṣaṭpañcāśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥156॥
5.157.6: sarvān bhrātr̥̄n samānīya vāsudevaṁ ca śāśvatam ॥6॥
5.157.8: tasmāt saptasu senāsu praṇetr̥̄n mama paśyata ॥8॥
5.157.11: dhr̥ṣṭadyumnaṁ ca pāñcālyaṁ dhr̥ṣṭaketuṁ ca pārthiva ॥11॥
5.157.12: śikhaṇḍinaṁ ca pāñcālyaṁ sahadevaṁ ca māgadham,
5.157.15: arjunasyāpi netā ca saṁyantā caiva vājinām ॥15॥
5.157.22: tatastaṁ pāṇḍavo rājā kare pasparśa pāṇinā ॥22॥
5.157.29: pāṇḍavā hi yathāsmākaṁ tathā duryodhano nr̥paḥ,
tasyāpi kriyatāṁ sāhyaṁ sa paryeti punaḥ punaḥ ॥29॥
5.157.30: tacca me nākarod vākyaṁ tvadarthe madhusūdanaḥ,
5.157.31: dhruvo jayaḥ pāṇḍavānāmiti me niścitā matiḥ,
5.157.33: ubhau śiṣyau hi me vīrau gadāyuddhaviśāradau,
5.157.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi sainyaniryāṇaparvaṇi balarāmatīrthayātrāgamane saptapañcāśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥157॥
5.158.5: vāruṇaṁ gāṇḍivaṁ tatra māhendraṁ vijayaṁ dhanuḥ,
śārṅgaṁ tu vaiṣṇavaṁ prāhurdivyaṁ tejomayaṁ dhanuḥ ॥5॥
5.158.14: vyaṁsito vrīḍito rājan nājagāma sa kuṇḍinam,
5.158.16: puraṁ tad bhuvi vikhyātaṁ nāmnā bhojakaṭaṁ nr̥pa,
5.158.17: tataḥ sa kavaca dhanvī talī khaḍgī śarāsanī ॥17॥
5.158.20: pratigr̥hya tu tān sarvān viśrāntaḥ sahasainikaḥ,
5.158.21: sahāyo’smi sthito yuddhe yadi bhīto’si pāṇḍava,
5.158.22: na hi me vikrame tulyaḥ pumānastīha kaścana,
haniṣyāmi raṇe bhāgaṁ yanme dāsyasi pāṇḍava ॥22॥
5.158.26: kauravāṇāṁ kule jātaḥ pāṇḍoḥ putro viśeṣataḥ ॥26॥
5.158.27: bhīto’smīti kathaṁ brūyāṁ dadhāno gāṇḍivaṁ dhanuḥ ॥27॥
5.158.32: upajīvya raṇe rudraṁ śakraṁ vaiśravaṇaṁ yamam,
varuṇaṁ pāvakaṁ caiva kr̥paṁ droṇaṁ ca mādhavam ॥32॥
5.158.35: yathākāmaṁ yathāyogaṁ gaccha vānyatra tiṣṭha vā ॥35॥
5.158.35d1: tacchrutvā vacanaṁ tasya vijayasya hi dhīmataḥ,
5.158.39: gate rāme tīrthayātrāṁ bhīṣmakasya sute tathā,
5.158.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi sainyaniryāṇaparvaṇi rukmipratyākhyāne aṣṭapañcāśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥158॥
5.159.5: na śaknomi niyantuṁ vā kartuṁ vā hitamātmanaḥ ॥5॥
5.159.7: evaṁ gate vai yad bhāvi tad bhaviṣyati sañjaya,
kṣatradharmaḥ kila raṇe tanutyāgo hi pūjitaḥ ॥7॥
5.159.9: na sa kālaṁ na vā devānenasā gantumarhati ॥9॥
5.159.12: hayānāṁ ca gajānāṁ ca rājñāṁ cāmitatejasām,
vaiśasaṁ samare vr̥ttaṁ yat tanme śr̥ṇu sarvaśaḥ ॥12॥
5.159.14: na hyeva kartā puruṣaḥ karmaṇoḥ śubhapāpayoḥ,
5.159.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi sainyaniryāṇaparvaṇi sañjayavākye ekonaṣaṣṭyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥159॥
5.160.3: ārakṣasya vidhiṁ kr̥tvā yodhānāṁ tatra bhārata,
karṇaṁ duḥśāsanaṁ caiva śakuniṁ cāpi saubalam ॥3॥
5.160.4: tatra duryodhano rājā karṇena saha bhārata ॥4॥
5.160.5: sambhāṣitvā ca karṇena bhrātrā duḥśāsanena ca,
5.160.7: gatvā mama vaco brūhi vāsudevasya śr̥ṇvataḥ,
5.160.10: yathā vaḥ sampratijñātaṁ tat sarvaṁ kriyatāmiti,
5.160.11: kathaṁ vā dhārmiko bhūtvā tvamadharme manaḥ kr̥thāḥ ॥11॥
5.160.12: ya icchasi jagat sarvaṁ naśyamānaṁ nr̥śaṁsavat,
abhayaṁ sarvabhūtebhyo dātā tvamiti me matiḥ ॥12॥
5.160.13: śrūyate hi purā gītaḥ śloko’yaṁ bharatarṣabha,
prahrādenātha bhadraṁ te hr̥te rājye tu daivataiḥ ॥13॥
5.160.14: yasya dharmadhvajo nityaṁ surā dhvaja ivocchritaḥ,
pracchannāni ca pāpāni baiḍālaṁ nāma tad vratam ॥14॥
5.160.17: sa vai kr̥tvā manaḥśuddhiṁ pratyayārthaṁ śarīriṇām,
5.160.18: sametya ca praśaṁsanti mārjāraṁ taṁ viśāmpate ॥18॥
5.160.19: ātmakāryaṁ kr̥taṁ mene caryāyāśca kr̥taṁ phalam ॥19॥
5.160.20: atha dīrghasya kālasya taṁ deśaṁ mūṣikā yayuḥ,
dadr̥śustaṁ ca te tatra dhārmikaṁ vratacāriṇam ॥20॥
5.160.22: bahumitrā vayaṁ sarve teṣāṁ no mātulo hyayam,
5.160.24: bhavān no gatiravyagrā bhavān naḥ paramaḥ suhr̥t,
te vayaṁ sahitāḥ sarve bhavantaṁ śaraṇaṁ gatāḥ ॥24॥
5.160.25: bhavān dharmaparo nityaṁ bhavān dharme vyavasthitaḥ,
sa no rakṣa mahāprajña tridaśāniva vajrabhr̥t ॥25॥
5.160.27: dvayoryogaṁ na paśyāmi tapaso rakṣaṇasya ca,
avaśyaṁ tu mayā kāryaṁ vacanaṁ bhavatāṁ hitam ॥27॥
5.160.29: na cāpi gamane śaktiṁ kāñcit paśyāmi cintayan,
so’smi neyaḥ sadā tāta nadīkūlamitaḥ param ॥29॥
5.160.31: tataḥ sa pāpo duṣṭātmā mūṣikānatha bhakṣayan,
5.160.33: mātulo vardhate nityaṁ vayaṁ kṣīyāmahe bhr̥śam ॥33॥
5.160.36: sādhu sādhviti te sarve pūjayāñcakrire tadā,
5.160.38: tatra vr̥ddhatamaḥ kaścit koliko nāma mūṣikaḥ,
5.160.43: anyathā kila te vākyamanyathā karma dr̥śyate,
5.160.44: tyaktvā chadma tvidaṁ rājan kṣatradharmaṁ samāśritaḥ,
5.160.47: yudhyāmahe kathaṁ saṅkhye kopayema ca pāṇḍavān ॥47॥
5.160.48: jātuṣe ca gr̥he dāhaṁ smara taṁ puruṣo bhava ॥48॥
5.160.49: ayamasmi sthito rājan śamāya samarāya ca ॥49॥
5.160.51: kiṁ nu yuddhāt paraṁ lābhaṁ kṣatriyo bahu manyate,
kiṁ ca tvaṁ kṣatriyakule jātaḥ samprathito bhuvi ॥51॥
5.160.53: ātmārthaṁ pāṇḍavārthaṁ ca yattā māṁ prati yodhaya ॥53॥
5.160.54: sabhāmadhye ca yad rūpaṁ māyayā kr̥tavānasi,
tat tathaiva punaḥ kr̥tvā sārjuno māmabhidrava ॥54॥
5.160.55: indrajālaṁ ca māyā vai kuhakā vāpi bhīṣaṇā,
5.160.56: vayamapyutsahema dyāṁ khaṁ ca gacchema māyayā,
rasātalaṁ viśāmo’pi aindraṁ vā purameva tu ॥56॥
5.160.58: manasaiva hi bhūtāni dhātaiva kurute vaśe,
yad bravīṣi ca vārṣṇeya dhārtarāṣṭrānahaṁ raṇe ॥58॥
5.160.59: ācacakṣe ca me sarvaṁ sañjayastava bhāṣitam ॥59॥
5.160.61: yudhyasvādya raṇe yattaḥ paśyāmaḥ puruṣo bhava,
5.160.62: karoti dviṣatāṁ śokaṁ sa jīvati sujīvitam,
akasmāccaiva te kr̥ṣṇa khyātaṁ loke mahad yaśaḥ ॥62॥
5.160.65: virāṭanagare pārtha yastvaṁ sūdo hyabhūḥ purā ॥65॥
5.160.66: pratijñātaṁ bhāmadhye na tanmithyā tvayā purā ॥66॥
5.160.67: yad bravīmi ca kaunteya dhārtarāṣṭrānahaṁ raṇe ॥67॥
5.160.68: tvaṁ hi bhājye puraskāryo bhakṣye peye ca bhārata ॥68॥
5.160.69: kva yuddhaṁ kva ca bhoktavyaṁ yudhyasva puruṣo bhava,
5.160.70: tad vr̥thā ca sabhāmadhye valgitaṁ te vr̥kodara,
5.160.71: yudhiṣṭhirānurāgaṁ ca dveṣaṁ ca mayi bhārata,
5.160.72: brūyāstvaṁ sahadevaṁ ca rājamadhye vaco mama,
yuddhyedānīṁ raṇe yattaḥ kleśān smara ca pāṇḍava ॥72॥
5.160.75: te yūyaṁ saṁhatā bhūtvā tadvadhārthaṁ mamāpi ca,
ātmārthaṁ pāṇḍavārthaṁ ca prayuddhyadhvaṁ mayā saha ॥75॥
5.160.76: eṣa te samayaḥ prāpto labdhavyaśca tvayāpi saḥ ॥76॥
5.160.77: yudhyasva sasuhr̥t pāpaṁ kuru karma suduṣkaram ॥77॥
5.160.79: kuru karma raṇe yattaḥ paśyāmaḥ pauruṣaṁ tava ॥79॥
5.160.81: asmān vā tvaṁ parājitya praśādhi pr̥thivīmimām,
5.160.83: balaṁ vīryaṁ ca śauryaṁ ca paraṁ cāpyastralāghavam ॥83॥
5.160.84: pauruṣaṁ darśayan yuddhe kopasya kuru niṣkr̥tim,
hr̥dayaṁ kasya na sphoṭedaiśvaryād bhraṁśitasya ca ॥84॥
5.160.85: āsthitaṁ rājyamākramya kopaṁ kasya na dīpayet ॥85॥
5.160.86: yat taduktaṁ mahad vākyaṁ karmaṇā tad vibhāvyatām,
5.160.87: amitrāṇāṁ vaśe sthānaṁ rājyaṁ ca punaruddhara,
dvāvarthau yuddhakāmasya tasmāt tat kuru pauruṣam ॥87॥
5.160.89: dvādaśaiva tu varṣāṇi vane dhiṣṇyād vivāsitaḥ,
5.160.91: apriyāṇāṁ ca vacanaṁ prabruvatsu punaḥ punaḥ,
5.160.92: iha te dr̥śyatāṁ pārtha yuddhyasva puruṣo bhava ॥92॥
5.160.93: puṣṭāste’śvā bhr̥tā yodhāḥ śvo yuddhyasva sakeśavaḥ ॥93॥
5.160.95: evaṁ katthasi kaunteya akatthan puruṣo bhava,
sūtaputraṁ sadurdharṣaṁ śalyaṁ ca balināṁ baram ॥95॥
5.160.96: droṇaṁ ca balināṁ śreṣṭhaṁ śacīpatisamaṁ yudhi,
5.160.98: na hi śuśruma vātena merumunmathitaṁ girim ॥98॥
5.160.99: yugaṁ vā parivarteta yadyevaṁ syād yathā’’ttha mām ॥99॥
5.160.100: pārtho vā itaro vāpi ko’nyaḥsvasti gr̥hān vrajet ॥100॥
5.160.105: akṣayyāviṣudhī caiva agnidattaṁ ca te ratham,
jānīmo hi raṇe pārtha ketuṁ divyaṁ ca bhārata ॥105॥
5.160.107: sarve bhaveyuḥ siddhārthāḥ katthane ko hi durgataḥ ॥107॥
5.160.109: na tu paryāyadharmeṇa siddhiṁ prāpnoti mānavaḥ,
5.160.111: kva tadā gāṇḍivaṁ te’bhūd yat tvaṁ dāsapaṇairjitaḥ,
5.160.112: sagadād bhīmasenād vā phālgunād vā sagāṇḍivāt,
na vai mokṣastadābhūd vo vinā kr̥ṣṇāmaninditām ॥112॥
5.160.113: sā vo dāsye samāpannān mocayāmāsa pārṣatī,
5.160.114: dhr̥tā hi veṇī pārthena virāṭanagare tadā ॥114॥
5.160.115: bhīmasenena kaunteya yat tu tanmama pauruṣam ॥115॥
5.160.116: evameva sadā daṇḍaṁ kṣatriyāḥ kṣatriye dadhuḥ,
5.160.117: na bhayād vāsudevasya na cāpi tava phālguna,
5.160.118: na māyā hīndrajālaṁ vā kuhakā vāpi bhīṣaṇā,
5.160.120: saṁyugaṁ gaccha bhīṣmeṇa bhindhi vā śirasā girim,
5.160.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi ulūkadūtāgamanaparvaṇi duryodhanavākye ṣaṣṭyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥160॥
5.161.3: ulūka na bhayaṁ te’sti brūhi tvaṁ vigatajvaraḥ,
5.161.4: sr̥ñjayānāṁ ca matsyānāṁ kr̥ṣṇasya ca yaśasvinaḥ ॥4॥
5.161.5: bhūmipānāṁ ca sarveṣāṁ madhye vākyaṁ jagāda ha ॥5॥
5.161.8: dvādaśaiva tu varṣāṇi vane dhiṣṇyād vivāsitaḥ,
5.161.11: samaḥ panthā bhr̥tāste’śvāḥ śvo yudhyasva sakeśavaḥ ॥11॥
5.161.13: evaṁ katthasi kaunteya akatthan puruṣo bhava,
sūtaputraṁ sadurdharṣaṁ śalyaṁ ca balināṁ varam ॥13॥
5.161.14: droṇaṁ ca balināṁ śreṣṭhaṁ śacīpatisamaṁ yudhi,
5.161.16: na hi śuśruma vātena merumunmathitaṁ girim ॥16॥
5.161.17: yugaṁ vā parivarteta yadyevaṁ syād yathā’’ttha mām ॥17॥
5.161.18: gajo vājī ratho vāpi punaḥ svasti gr̥hān vrajet ॥18॥
5.161.25: sarve bhaveyuḥ siddhārthāḥ katthane ko hi durgataḥ ॥25॥
5.161.27: na tu paryāyadharmeṇa rājyaṁ prāpnoti mānuṣaḥ,
5.161.29: kva tadā gāṇḍivaṁ te’bhūd yat tvaṁ dāsa paṇairjitaḥ,
5.161.30: sagadād bhīmasenād vā pārthād vāpi sagāṇḍivāt,
na vai mokṣastadā vo’bhūd vinā kr̥ṣṇāmaninditām ॥30॥
5.161.31: sā vo dāsye samāpannān mokṣayāmāsa pārṣatī,
5.161.32: dhr̥tā hi veṇī pārthena virāṭanagare tadā ॥32॥
5.161.34: evametat sadā daṇḍaṁ kṣatriyāḥ kṣatriye dadhuḥ,
5.161.35: na bhayād vāsudevasya na cāpi tava phālguna,
5.161.36: na māyā hīndrajālaṁ vā kuhakā vāpi bhīṣaṇā,
5.161.38: saṁyugaṁ gaccha bhīṣmeṇa bhindhi vā śirasā girim,
5.161.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi ulūkadūtāgamanaparvaṇi ulūkavākye ekaṣaṣṭyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥161॥
5.162.2: tasya tad vacanaṁ śrutvā ruṣitāḥ pāṇḍavā bhr̥śam,
5.162.6: śrutaṁ vākyaṁ gr̥hīto’rtho mataṁ yat te tathāstu tat ॥6॥
5.162.8: sr̥ñjayānāṁ ca sarveṣāṁ kr̥ṣṇasya ca yaśasvinaḥ,
5.162.9: bhūmipānāṁ ca sarveṣāṁ madhye vākyaṁ jagāda ha,
5.162.11: ulūkasya tu tad vākyaṁ pāpaṁ dāruṇamīritam,
5.162.12: tadavasthaṁ tadā dr̥ṣṭvā pārthaṁ sā samitirnr̥pa,
5.162.18: udvr̥tya sahasā netre dantān kaṭakaṭāyya ca ॥18॥
5.162.20: śrutaṁ te vacanaṁ mūrkha yat tvāṁ duryodhano’bravīt,
tanme kathayate manda śr̥ṇu vākyaṁ durāsadam ॥20॥
5.162.21: sarvakṣatrasya madhye taṁ yad vakṣyasi suyodhanam,
5.162.22: marṣitaṁ te durācāra tat tvaṁ na bahu manyase ॥22॥
5.162.25: mayāpi ca pratijñāto vadhaḥ sabhrātr̥kasya te,
sa tathā bhavitā pāpa nātra kāryā vicāraṇā ॥25॥
5.162.27: sahāyaste yadi yamaḥ kubero rudra eva vā,
5.162.28: api bhīṣmaṁ puraskr̥tya taṁ neṣyāmi yamakṣayam ॥28॥
5.162.31: śr̥ṇu pāpa vaco mahyaṁ yadvācyo hi pitā tvayā ॥31॥
5.162.32: nāsmākaṁ bhavitā bhedaḥ kadācit kurubhiḥ saha,
dhr̥tarāṣṭrasya sambandho yadi na syāt tvayā saha ॥32॥
5.162.37: bhīmasena na te santi yeṣāṁ vairaṁ tvayā saha ॥37॥
5.162.38: ulūkaśca na te vācyaḥ paruṣaṁ puruṣottama ॥38॥
5.162.42: samagraṁ pārthivaṁ kṣatraṁ sarvaṁ na gaṇayāmyaham ॥42॥
5.162.46: anunīya ca tān sarvān yathāmānyaṁ yathāvayaḥ,
5.162.51: ulūka gaccha kaitavya brūhi tāta suyodhanam,
5.162.52: pāṇḍaveṣu sadā pāpa nityaṁ jihmaṁ pravartase,
svavīryād yaḥ parākramya pāpa āhvayate parān,
abhītaḥ pūrayan vākyameṣa vai kṣatriyaḥ pumān ॥52॥
5.162.53: sa pāpaḥ kṣatriyo bhūtvā asmānāhūya saṁyuge,
mānyāmānyān puraskr̥tya yuddhaṁ mā gāḥ kulādhama ॥53॥
5.162.54: āhvayasva raṇe pārthān sarvathā kṣatriyo bhava ॥54॥
5.162.56: sa tvaṁ pareṣāṁ vīryeṇa ātmānaṁ bahu manyase,
5.162.57: śva idānīṁ prapadyethāḥ puruṣo bhava durmate ॥57॥
5.162.58: manyase yacca mūḍha tvaṁ na yotsyati janārdanaḥ,
sārathyena vr̥taḥ pārthairiti tvaṁ na bibheṣi ca ॥58॥
5.162.63: na tvāṁ samīkṣate pārtho nāpi rājā yudhiṣṭhiraḥ,
5.162.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi ulūkadūtābhigamanaparvaṇi kr̥ṣṇādivākye dviṣaṣṭyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥162॥
5.163.3: svavīryaṁ yaḥ samāśritya samāhvayati vai parān,
abhīto yudhyate śatrūn sa vai puruṣa ucyate ॥3॥
5.163.5: sa tvaṁ pareṣāṁ vīryeṇa manyase vīryamātmanaḥ,
5.163.7: na haniṣyanti gāṅgeyaṁ pāṇḍavā ghr̥ṇayeti hi ॥7॥
5.163.11: tato hi te labdhatamaṁ ca rājya-
5.163.20: āśā te jīvite mūḍha rājye vā kena hetunā ॥20॥
5.163.21: śānte bhīṣme tathā droṇe sūtaputre ca pātite,
nirāśo jīvite rājye putreṣu ca bhaviṣyasi ॥21॥
5.163.22: bhrātr̥ṇāṁ nidhanaṁ śrutvā putrāṇāṁ ca suyodhana,
5.163.23: na dvitīyāṁ pratijñāṁ hi pratijānāmi kaitava,
satyaṁ bravīmyahaṁ hyetat sarvaṁ satyaṁ bhaviṣyati ॥23॥
5.163.24: ulūka madvaco brūhi gatvā tāta suyodhanam ॥24॥
5.163.25: svena vr̥ttena me vr̥ttaṁ nādhigantuṁ tvamarhasi,
5.163.27: etadarthaṁ mayā tāta pañca grāmā vr̥tāḥ purā,
kathaṁ tava sudurbuddhe na prekṣe vyasanaṁ mahat ॥27॥
5.163.28: tathaiva vāsudevasya na gr̥hṇāsi hitaṁ vacaḥ ॥28॥
5.163.29: kiṁ cedānīṁ bahūktena yudhyasva saha bāndhavaiḥ,
5.163.30: śrutaṁ vākyaṁ gr̥hīto’rtho mataṁ yat te tathāstu tat,
5.163.32: gr̥dhrodare vā vastavyaṁ pure vā nāgasāhvaye,
5.163.33: kartāhaṁ tad vacaḥ satyaṁ satyenaiva śapāmi te,
5.163.34: sakthinī tava bhaṅktvaiva hatvā hi tava sodarān,
5.163.36: hatvā suyodhana tvāṁ vai sahitaṁ sarvasodaraiḥ,
5.163.38: śrutaṁ te gadato vākyaṁ sarvameva yathātatham,
tathā kartāsmi kauravya yathā tvamanuśāssi mām ॥38॥
5.163.39: suyodhana matiryā te vr̥thaiṣā te bhaviṣyati ॥39॥
5.163.40: imaṁ ca kleśamasmākaṁ hr̥ṣṭo yat tvaṁ vikatthase ॥40॥
5.163.41: tau ca dāsāvadāsau vā pauruṣaṁ yasya yādr̥śam ॥41॥
5.163.43: paśya tvaṁ māṁ raṇe rājan kurvāṇaṁ karma dāruṇam,
yasya vīryaṁ samāsādya manyase vijayaṁ yudhi ॥43॥
5.163.44: ahaṁ bhīṣmavadhāt sr̥ṣṭo nūnaṁ dhātrā mahātmanā ॥44॥
5.163.46: suyodhano mama vaco vaktavyo nr̥pateḥ sutaḥ,
5.163.47: avaśyaṁ ca mayā kāryaṁ pūrveṣāṁ caritaṁ mahat,
kartā cāhaṁ tathā karma yathā nānyaḥ kariṣyati ॥47॥
5.163.49: sa gaccha mā ciraṁ tāta ulūka yadi manyase ॥49॥
5.163.50: iha vā tiṣṭha bhadraṁ te vayaṁ hi tava bāndhavāḥ,
5.163.51: āmantrya prayayau tatra yatra rājā suyodhanaḥ,
5.163.54: kaitavyasya tu tad vākyaṁ niśamya bharatarṣabhaḥ,
duḥśāsanaṁ ca karṇaṁ ca śakuniṁ cāpi bhārata ॥54॥
5.163.57: tūrṇaṁ pariyayuḥ senāṁ kr̥tsnāṁ karṇasya śāsanāt,
5.163.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi ulūkadūtāgamanaparvaṇi ulūkāpayāne triṣaṣṭyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥163॥
5.164.6: aśvatthāmne ca nakulaṁ śaibyaṁ ca kr̥tavarmaṇe ॥6॥
5.164.9: sa samarthaṁ hi taṁ mene pārthādabhyadhikaṁ raṇe ॥9॥
5.164.10: evaṁ vibhajya yodhāṁstān pr̥thak ca saha caiva ha,
5.164.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi ulūkadūtāgamanaparvaṇi senāpatiniyoge catuḥṣaṣṭyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥164॥
5.165.2: hatameva hi paśyāmi gāṅgeyaṁ pitaraṁ raṇe,
5.165.9: yātrāyāne ca yuddhe ca tathā praśamaneṣu ca,
bhr̥śaṁ veda mahārāja yathā veda br̥haspatiḥ ॥9॥
5.165.10: tairahaṁ mohayiṣyāmi pāṇḍavān vyetu te jvaraḥ ॥10॥
5.165.11: yathāvacchāstrato rājan vyetu te mānaso jvaraḥ ॥11॥
5.165.12: vidyate me na gāṅgeya bhayaṁ devāsureṣvapi,
5.165.17: gāndhāre śr̥ṇu rājendra rathasaṅkhyāṁ svake bale,
5.165.18: rathānāṁ tava senāyāṁ yathāmukhyaṁ tu me śr̥ṇu ॥18॥
5.165.24: na tvātmano guṇān vaktumarhāmi vidito’smi te,
5.165.25: arthasiddhiṁ tava raṇe kariṣyati na saṁśayaḥ,
5.165.27: spardhate vāsudevena nityaṁ yo vai raṇe raṇe,
5.165.28: bhūriśravāḥ kr̥tāstraśca tava cāpi hitaḥ suhr̥t ॥28॥
5.165.30: sindhurājo mahārāja mato me dviguṇo rathaḥ,
5.165.32: etena hi tadā rājaṁstapa āsthāya dāruṇam,
5.165.33: sa eṣa rathaśārdūlastad vairaṁ saṁsmaran raṇe,
5.166.9: trigartā bhrātaraḥ pañca rathodārā matā mama,
5.166.11: te rathāḥ pañca rājendra yeṣāṁ satyaratho mukham,
5.166.15: yuddhānāṁ ca viśeṣajñau praṇetārau ca sarvaśaḥ ॥15॥
5.166.16: rathau tau kuruśārdūla matau me rathasattamau,
5.166.17: yotsyate tava saṅgrāme svena sainyena pālitaḥ ॥17॥
5.166.19: eṣa yotsyati saṅgrāme svān bandhūn sampraharṣayan,
5.167.5: naiṣa śakyo mayā vīraḥ saṅkhyātuṁ rathasattamaḥ,
5.167.7: na me ratho nātiratho mataḥ pārthivasattama ॥7॥
5.167.12: raṇe karma mahat kartā atra me nāsti saṁśayaḥ ॥12॥
5.167.14: bhāradvājātmajaḥ kartā karma tīvraṁ hitaṁ tava ॥14॥
5.167.23: pradhakṣyati ripūṇāṁ te balaṁ tu balināṁ varaḥ ॥23॥
5.167.26: ratha eṣa mahārāja mato me rājasattama,
5.167.27: eṣa vikrāntayodhī ca citrayodhī ca saṅgare,
vītabhīścāpi te rājan śatrubhiḥ saha yotsyate ॥27॥
5.167.28: mama rājan mato yuddhe śūro vaivasvatopamaḥ ॥28॥
5.167.29: na hyeṣa samaraṁ prāpya nivarteta kathañcana,
yathā satatago rājan sa hi hanyāt parān raṇe ॥29॥
5.167.31: etasya samaraṁ dr̥ṣṭvā na vyathāsti kathañcana,
5.168.3: sakhā te dayito nityaṁ ya eṣa raṇakarkaśaḥ,
5.168.4: mantrī netā ca bandhuśca mānī cātyantamucchritaḥ ॥4॥
5.168.5: eṣa naiva rathaḥ karṇo na cāpyatiratho raṇe,
5.168.6: kuṇḍalābhyāṁ ca divyābhyāṁ viyuktaḥ satataṁ ghr̥ṇī,
5.168.8: evametad yathā’’ttha tvaṁ na mithyāsti kadācana ॥8॥
5.168.9: ghr̥ṇī karṇaḥ pramādī ca tena me’rdharatho mataḥ ॥9॥
5.168.12: marṣayāmi ca tat sarvaṁ duryodhanakr̥tena vai,
tvaṁ tu māṁ manyase mandaṁ yathā kāpuruṣaṁ tathā ॥12॥
5.168.13: bhavānardharatho mahyaṁ mato vai nātra saṁśayaḥ,
sarvasya jagataścaiva gāṅgeyo na mr̥ṣā vadet ॥13॥
5.168.16: na hāyanairna palitairna vittairna ca bandhubhiḥ,
5.168.20: bhinnā hi senā nr̥pate duḥsandheyā bhavatyuta,
5.168.21: eṣāṁ dvaidhaṁ samutpannaṁ yodhānāṁ yudhi bhārata,
5.168.22: rathānāṁ kva ca vijñānaṁ kva ca bhīṣmo’lpacetanaḥ,
5.168.24: kva ca yuddhaṁ vimardo vā mantre suvyāhr̥tāni ca,
kva ca bhīṣmo gatavayā mandātmā kālacoditaḥ ॥24॥
5.168.25: ekākī spardhate nityaṁ sarveṇa jagatā saha,
5.168.26: na tveva hyativr̥ddhānāṁ punarbālā hi te matāḥ ॥26॥
5.168.28: senāpatau yaśo gantā na tu yodhān kathañcana ॥28॥
5.168.29: nāhaṁ jīvati gāṅgeye yotsye rājan kathañcana,
hate bhīṣme tu yoddhāsmi sarvaireva mahārathaiḥ ॥29॥
5.168.31: mitho bhedo na me kāryastena jīvasi sūtaja ॥31॥
5.168.32: na hyahaṁ tvadya vikramya sthaviro’pi śiśostava,
5.168.33: na me vyathā kr̥tā kācit tvaṁ tu me kiṁ kariṣyasi ॥33॥
5.168.38: yuddhyasva samare pārthaṁ yena vispardhase saha,
5.168.39: māṁ samīkṣasva gāṅgeya kāryaṁ hi mahadudyatam ॥39॥
5.168.40: ubhāvapi bhavantau me mahat karma kariṣyataḥ ॥40॥
5.168.42: prabhātāyāṁ rajanyāṁ vai idaṁ yuddhaṁ bhaviṣyati ॥42॥
5.168.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi rathātirathasaṅkhyānaparvaṇi bhīṣmakarṇasaṁvāde aṣṭaṣaṣṭyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥168॥
5.169.2: yadi kautūhalaṁ te’dya pāṇḍavānāṁ bale nr̥pa,
5.169.3: agnivat samare tāta cariṣyati na saṁśayaḥ ॥3॥
5.169.4: na tasyāsti samo yuddhe gadayā sāyakairapi ॥4॥
5.169.5: nāgāyutabalo mānī tejasā na sa mānuṣaḥ,
5.169.7: rudravat pracariṣyanti tatra me nāsti saṁśayaḥ,
5.169.11: na caiṣāṁ puruṣāḥ kecidāyudhāni gadāḥ śarān,
5.169.12: udyantuṁ vā gadā gurvīḥ śarān vā kṣeptumāhave,
5.169.13: etat sainyaṁ samāsādya sarva eva balotkaṭāḥ ॥13॥
5.169.14: vidhvaṁsayiṣyanti raṇe mā sma taiḥ saha saṅgamaḥ,
5.169.15: draupadyāśca parikleśaṁ dyūte ca paruṣā giraḥ ॥15॥
5.169.16: te smarantaśca saṅgrāme cariṣyanti ca rudravat,
5.169.17: na hi deveṣu sarveṣu nāsureṣūrageṣu ca ॥17॥
5.169.18: rākṣaseṣvatha yakṣeṣu nareṣu kuta eva tu,
bhūto’thavā bhaviṣyo vā rathaḥ kaścinmayā śrutaḥ ॥18॥
5.169.20: gāṇḍīvaṁ ca dhanurdivyaṁ te cāśvā vātaraṁhasaḥ,
5.169.21: astragrāmaśca māhendro raudraḥ kaubera eva ca,
5.169.24: tava senāṁ mahābāhuḥ svāṁ caiva paripālayan,
5.169.27: etacchrutvā tu bhīṣmasya rājñāṁ dadhvaṁsire tadā,
5.169.28: manobhiḥ saha saṁvegaiḥ saṁsmr̥tya ca purātanam,
5.169.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi rathātirathasaṅkhyānaparvaṇi pāṇḍavarathātirathasaṅkhyāyām ekonasaptatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥169॥
5.170.7: pāṇḍavaiḥ saha rājendra tava senāsu bhārata,
5.170.9: yatiṣyete paraṁ śaktyā sthitau vīragate pathi ॥9॥
5.170.11: kāraṇaṁ prāpya tu narāḥ sarva eva mahābhujāḥ,
śūrā vā kātarā vāpi bhavanti kurupuṅgava ॥11॥
5.171.1: śikhaṇḍī rathamukhyo me mataḥ pārthasya bhārata ॥1॥
5.171.5: eṣa yotsyati saṅgrāme sūdayan vai parān raṇe,
5.171.7: kṣatradharmā tu rājendra mato me’rdharatho nr̥pa,
5.171.9: eṣa cedipatiḥ śūraḥ saha putreṇa bhārata,
5.171.12: yotsyante samare tāta saṁrabdhā iva kuñjarāḥ,
5.171.13: yotsyete balinau śūrau paraṁ śaktyā kṣayiṣyataḥ,
5.171.18: sa hi saṅgrāmaśobhī ca bhaktaścāpi kirīṭinaḥ,
5.171.19: matau mama rathodārau pāṇḍavānāṁ na saṁśayaḥ ॥19॥
5.171.20: yaḥ samo vāsudevena bhīmasenena vā vibho ॥20॥
5.171.21: sa yotsyati hi vikramya samare tava sainikaiḥ,
māṁ ca droṇaṁ kr̥paṁ caiva yathā sammanyate bhavān ॥21॥
5.171.23: ayaṁ ca yudhi vikrānto mantavyo’ṣṭaguṇo rathaḥ ॥23॥
5.172.2: mātulo bhīmasenasya sa ca me’tiratho mataḥ ॥2॥
5.172.3: eṣa vīro maheṣvāsaḥ kr̥tī ca nipuṇaśca ha,
citrayodhī ca śaktaśca mato me rathapuṅgavaḥ ॥3॥
5.172.4: sa yotsyati hi vikramya maghavāniva dānavaiḥ,
yodhā ye cāsya vikhyātāḥ sarve yuddhaviśāradāḥ ॥4॥
5.172.5: sumahat karma pāṇḍūnāṁ sthitaḥ priyahite rataḥ ॥5॥
5.172.7: ye cāsya rākṣasā vīrāḥ sacivā vaśavartinaḥ ॥7॥
5.172.10: neṣyanti samare senāṁ bhīmāṁ yaudhiṣṭhirīṁ nr̥pa,
5.172.13: ye caiva te rathodārāḥ pāṇḍuputrasya sainikāḥ,
5.172.15: arjunaṁ vāsudevaṁ ca ye cānye tatra pārthivāḥ,
5.172.16: pāñcālyaṁ tu mahābāho nāhaṁ hanyāṁ śikhaṇḍinam,
5.172.19: naiva hanyāṁ striyaṁ jātu na strīpūrvaṁ kadācana ॥19॥
5.172.20: sa hi strīpūrvako rājan śikhaṇḍī yadi te śrutaḥ,
kanyā bhūtvā pumān jāto na yotsye tena bhārata ॥20॥
5.172.21: yān sameṣyāmi samare na tu kuntīsutān nr̥pa ॥21॥
5.173.3: yadarthaṁ yudhi samprekṣya nāhaṁ hanyāṁ śikhaṇḍinam ॥3॥
5.173.6: tasmiṁśca nidhanaṁ prāpte satyavatyā mate sthitaḥ,
5.173.12: apaśyaṁ tā mahābāho tisraḥ kanyāḥ svalaṅkr̥tāḥ,
5.173.13: tato’haṁ tān nr̥pān sarvānāhūya samare sthitān,
5.173.14: vīryaśulkāśca tā jñātvā samāropya rathaṁ tadā,
bhīṣmaḥ śāntanavaḥ kanyā haratīti punaḥ punaḥ ॥14॥
5.173.15: te yatadhvaṁ paraṁ śaktyā sarve mokṣāya pārthivāḥ,
prasahya hi harāmyeṣa miṣatāṁ vo nararṣabhāḥ ॥15॥
5.173.18: tataste māṁ mahīpālāḥ sarva eva viśāmpate,
5.173.22: te nivr̥ttāśca bhagnāśca dr̥ṣṭvā tallāghavaṁ mama,
5.173.22d1: tata ādāya tāḥ kanyā nr̥patīṁśca visr̥jya tān.
5.173.23: tato’haṁ tāśca kanyā vai bhrāturarthāya bhārata,
5.173.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi ambopākhyānaparvaṇi kanyāharaṇe trisaptatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥173॥
5.174.2: imāḥ kāśipateḥ kanyā mayā nirjitya pārthivān,
5.174.3: āha satyavatī hr̥ṣṭā diṣṭyā putra jitaṁ tvayā ॥3॥
5.174.4: uvāca vākyaṁ savrīḍā jyeṣṭhā kāśipateḥ sutā ॥4॥
5.174.5: śrutvā ca vacanaṁ dharmyaṁ mahyaṁ kartumihārhasi ॥5॥
5.174.6: tena cāsmi vr̥tā pūrvaṁ rahasyavidite pituḥ ॥6॥
5.174.7: vāsayethā gr̥he bhīṣma kauravaḥ san viśeṣataḥ ॥7॥
5.174.9: sa māṁ pratīkṣate vyaktaṁ śālvarājo viśāmpate,
5.174.10: kr̥pāṁ kuru mahābāho mayi dharmabhr̥tāṁ vara,
tvaṁ hi satyavrato vīra pr̥thivyāmiti naḥ śrutam ॥10॥
5.174.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi ambopākhyānaparvaṇi ambāvākye catuḥsaptatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥174॥
5.175.2: anujñātā yayau sā tu kanyā śālvapateḥ puram ॥2॥
5.175.4d1: abhinandasva māṁ rājan sadā priyahite ratām,
pratipādaya māṁ rājan dharmārthaṁ caiva dharmataḥ.
5.175.6: gaccha bhadre punastatra sakāśaṁ bhīṣmakasya vai,
nāhamicchāmi bhīṣmeṇa gr̥hītāṁ tvāṁ prasahya vai ॥6॥
5.175.7: tvaṁ hi bhīṣmeṇa nirjitya nītā prītimatī tadā,
5.175.9: yatheṣṭaṁ gamyatāṁ bhadre mā tvāṁ kālo’tyagādayam ॥9॥
5.175.12: bhaktānāṁ hi parityāgo na dharmeṣu praśasyate ॥12॥
5.175.15: bhaginyau mama ye nīte ambikāmbālike nr̥pa,
5.175.16: yathā śālvapate nānyaṁ varaṁ dhyāmi kathañcana,
5.175.19: tāmevaṁ bhāṣamāṇāṁ tu śālvaḥ kāśipateḥ sutām,
5.175.21: tataḥ sā manyunā’’viṣṭā jyeṣṭhā kāśipateḥ sutā,
5.175.22: tvayā tyaktā gamiṣyāmi yatra tatra viśāmpate,
tatra me gatayaḥ santu santaḥ satyaṁ yathā dhruvam ॥22॥
5.175.23: evaṁ tāṁ bhāṣamāṇāṁ tu kanyāṁ śālvapatistadā,
5.175.24: gaccha gaccheti tāṁ śālvaḥ punaḥ punarabhāṣata,
bibhemi bhīṣmāt suśroṇi tvaṁ ca bhīṣmaparigrahaḥ ॥24॥
5.175.25: niścakrāma purād dīnā rudatī kurarī yathā ॥25॥
5.175.27: na ca śakyaṁ punargantuṁ mayā vāraṇasāhvayam ॥27॥
5.175.29: athavā pitaraṁ mūḍhaṁ yo me’kārṣīt svayaṁvaram,
mayāyaṁ svakr̥to doṣo yāhaṁ bhīṣmarathāt tadā ॥29॥
5.175.30: pravr̥tte dāruṇe yuddhe śālvārthaṁ nāpataṁ purā,
5.175.31: dhig bhīṣmaṁ dhik ca me mandaṁ pitaraṁ mūḍhacetasam,
5.175.32: dhiṅmāṁ dhik śālvarājānaṁ dhig dhātāramathāpi vā,
5.175.33: anayasyāsya tu mukhaṁ bhīṣmaḥ śāntanavo mama ॥33॥
5.175.34: tapasā vā yudhā vāpi duḥkhahetuḥ sa me mataḥ ॥34॥
5.175.35: ko nu bhīṣmaṁ yudhā jetumutsaheta mahīpatiḥ,
evaṁ sā pariniścitya jagāma nagarād bahiḥ ॥35॥
5.175.37: haraṇaṁ ca visargaṁ ca śālvena ca visarjanam ॥37॥
5.175.39: ārtāṁ tāmāha sa muniḥ śaikhāvatyo mahātapāḥ,
5.175.40: evaṁ gate tu kiṁ bhadre śakyaṁ kartuṁ tapasvibhiḥ,
5.175.42: mayaiva yāni karmāṇi pūrvadehe tu mūḍhayā,
kr̥tāni nūnaṁ pāpāni teṣāmetat phalaṁ dhruvam ॥42॥
5.175.43: notsahe tu punargantuṁ svajanaṁ prati tāpasāḥ,
5.175.45: sāntvayāmāsa kāryaṁ ca pratijajñe dvijaiḥ saha ॥45॥
5.175.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi ambopākhyānaparvaṇi śaikhāvatyāmbāsaṁvāde pañcasaptatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥175॥
5.176.1: tāṁ kanyāṁ cintayantaste kiṁ kāryamiti dharmiṇaḥ ॥1॥
5.176.3: neti kecid vyavasyanti pratyākhyātā hi tena sā ॥3॥
5.176.4: evaṁ gate tu kiṁ śakyaṁ bhadre kartuṁ manīṣibhiḥ,
5.176.5: alaṁ pravrajiteneha bhadre śr̥ṇu hitaṁ vacaḥ,
ito gacchasva bhadraṁ te pitureva niveśanam ॥5॥
5.176.6: pratipatsyati rājā sa pitā te yadanantaram,
5.176.7: na ca te’nyā gatirnyāyyā bhaved bhadre yathā pitā,
5.176.8: gatiḥ patiḥ samasthāyā viṣame ca pitā gatiḥ,
5.176.9: bhadre doṣā hi vidyante bahavo varavarṇini ॥9॥
5.176.10: āśrame vai vasantyāste na bhaveyuḥ piturgr̥he,
5.176.13: nāhaṁ gamiṣye bhadraṁ vastatra yatra pitā mama,
5.176.14: yathā pare’pi me loke na syādevaṁ mahātyayaḥ,
5.176.16: tataste tāpasāḥ sarve pūjayanti sma taṁ nr̥pam,
5.176.17: punareva kathāṁ cakruḥ kanyāṁ prati vanaukasaḥ ॥17॥
5.176.19: tāṁ tathāvādinīṁ śrutvā dr̥ṣṭvā ca sa mahātapāḥ,
5.176.20: sa vepamāna utthāya mātustasyāḥ pitā tadā,
5.176.21: sā ca tasmai yathāvr̥ttaṁ vistareṇa nyavedayat ॥21॥
5.176.23: mā gāḥ piturgr̥haṁ bhadre mātuste janako hyaham ॥23॥
5.176.24: duḥkhaṁ chindyāmahaṁ te vai mayi vartasva putrike,
paryāptaṁ te mano vatse yadevaṁ pariśuṣyasi ॥24॥
5.176.26: haniṣyati raṇe bhīṣmaṁ na kariṣyati ced vacaḥ,
5.176.27: pratiṣṭhāpayitā sa tvāṁ same pathi mahātapāḥ,
5.176.28: abravīt pitaraṁ mātuḥ sā tadā hotravāhanam,
5.176.29: kathaṁ ca tīvraṁ duḥkhaṁ me nāśayiṣyati bhārgavaḥ,
etadicchāmyahaṁ jñātuṁ yathā yāsyāmi tatra vai ॥29॥
5.176.30: rāmaṁ drakṣyasi bhadre tvaṁ jāmadagnyaṁ mahāvane,
5.176.31: mahendraṁ vai giriśreṣṭhaṁ rāmo nityamupāsti ha,
5.176.32: tatra gacchasva bhadraṁ te brūyāścainaṁ vaco mama,
abhivādya ca taṁ mūrdhnā tapovr̥ddhaṁ dr̥ḍhavratam ॥32॥
5.176.33: brūyāścainaṁ punarbhadre yat te kāryaṁ manīṣitam,
mayi saṅkīrtite rāmaḥ sarvaṁ tat te kariṣyati ॥33॥
5.176.34: mama rāmaḥ sakhā vatme prītiyuktaḥ suhr̥cca me,
5.176.35: evaṁ bruvati kanyāṁ tu pārthive hotravāhane,
5.176.36: sa ca rājā vayovr̥ddhaḥ sr̥ñjayo hotravāhanaḥ ॥36॥
5.176.40: akr̥tavraṇa śakyo vai draṣṭuṁ vedavidāṁ varaḥ ॥40॥
5.176.42: iha rāmaḥ prabhāte śvo bhaviteti matirmama,
5.176.43: iyaṁ ca kanyā rājarṣe kimarthaṁ vanamāgatā,
kasya ceyaṁ tava ca kā bhavatīcchāmi veditum ॥43॥
5.176.47: tataḥ kila mahāvīryo bhīṣmaḥ śāntanavo nr̥pān,
5.176.50: taṁ tu vaivāhikaṁ dr̥ṣṭvā kanyeyaṁ samupārjitam,
5.176.52: tacchrutvā vacanaṁ bhīṣmaḥ sammantrya saha mantribhiḥ,
5.176.53: anujñātā tu bhīṣmeṇa śālvaṁ saubhapatiṁ tataḥ,
5.176.59: yat tu māṁ bhagavān rāmo vakṣyati dvijasattama,
tanme kāryatamaṁ kāryamiti me bhagavan matiḥ ॥59॥
5.176.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi ambopākhyānaparvaṇi hotravāhanāmbāsaṁvāde ṣaṭsaptatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥176॥
5.177.1: pratikartavyamabale tat tvaṁ vatse vadasva me ॥1॥
5.177.3: raṇe vinirjitaṁ draṣṭuṁ kuryāt tadapi bhārgavaḥ ॥3॥
5.177.4: sr̥ñjayasya vacaḥ śrutvā tava caiva śucismite,
yadatra te bhr̥śaṁ kāryaṁ tadadyaiva vicintyatām ॥4॥
5.177.5: nābhijānāti me bhīṣmo brahman śālvagataṁ manaḥ ॥5॥
5.177.7: ubhayoreva vā brahman yuktaṁ yat tat samācara ॥7॥
5.177.9: dharmaṁ prati vaco brūyāḥ śr̥ṇu cedaṁ vaco mama ॥9॥
5.177.10: yadi tvāmāpageyo vai na nayed gajasāhvayam,
5.177.11: tena tvaṁ nirjitā bhadre yasmānnītāsi bhāvini,
5.177.12: bhīṣmaḥ puruṣamānī ca jitakāśī tathaiva ca,
tasmāt pratikriyā yuktā bhīṣme kārayituṁ tava ॥12॥
5.177.14: bhīṣmaṁ vā śālvarājaṁ vā yaṁ vā doṣeṇa gacchasi,
5.177.15: evaṁ kathayatāmeva teṣāṁ sa divaso gataḥ,
5.177.18: tatastaṁ tāpasā dr̥ṣṭvā sa ca rājā mahātapāḥ,
tasthuḥ prāñjalayo rājan sā ca kanyā tapasvinī ॥18॥
5.177.23: paramaṁ kathyatāṁ ceti tāṁ rāmaḥ pratyabhāṣata,
5.177.26: yathā tvaṁ sr̥ñjayasyāsya tathā me tvaṁ nr̥pātmaje,
brūhi yat te manoduḥkhaṁ kariṣye vacanaṁ tava ॥26॥
5.177.28: tasyāśca dr̥ṣṭvā rūpaṁ ca vapuścābhinavaṁ punaḥ,
5.177.32: kariṣyati vaco mahyaṁ śrutvā ca sa narādhipaḥ ॥32॥
5.177.33: na cet kariṣyati vaco mayoktaṁ jāhnavīsutaḥ,
5.177.34: athavā te matistatra rājaputri na vartate,
5.177.36: na ca māṁ pratyagr̥hṇāt sa cāritryapariśaṅkitaḥ ॥36॥
5.177.38: mama tu vyasanasyāsya bhīṣmo mūlaṁ mahāvrataḥ,
5.177.40: sa hi lubdhaśca nīcaśca jitakāśī ca bhārgava,
tasmāt pratikriyā kartuṁ yuktā tasmai tvayānagha ॥40॥
5.177.41: eṣa me kriyamāṇāyā bhāratena tadā vibho,
5.177.42: jahi bhīṣmaṁ mahābāho yathā vr̥traṁ purandaraḥ ॥42॥
5.177.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi ambopākhyānaparvaṇi rāmāmbāsaṁvāde saptasaptatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥177॥
5.178.1: uvāca rudatīṁ kanyāṁ codayantīṁ punaḥ punaḥ ॥1॥
5.178.2: kāśye na kāmaṁ gr̥hṇāmi śastraṁ vai varavarṇini,
r̥te brahmavidāṁ hetoḥ kimanyat karavāṇi te ॥2॥
5.178.3: vācā bhīṣmaśca śālvaśca mama rājñi vaśānugau,
5.178.4: na tu śastraṁ grahīṣyāmi kathañcidapi bhāvini,
r̥te niyogād viprāṇāmeṣa me samayaḥ kr̥taḥ ॥4॥
5.178.5: tacca bhīṣmaprasūtaṁ me taṁ jahīśvara mā ciram ॥5॥
5.178.7: jahi bhīṣmaṁ raṇe rāma garjantamasuraṁ yathā,
samāhūto raṇe rāma mama cedicchasi priyam,
pratiśrutaṁ ca yadapi tat satyaṁ kartumarhasi ॥7॥
5.178.9: yadi bhīṣmo raṇe rāma samāhūtastvayā mr̥dhe ॥9॥
5.178.10: nirjito’smīti vā brūyāt kuryād vā vacanaṁ tava,
5.178.11: vākyaṁ satyaṁ ca te vīra bhaviṣyati kr̥taṁ vibho,
iyaṁ cāpi pratijñā te tadā rāma mahāmune ॥11॥
5.178.12: jitvā vai kṣatriyān sarvān brāhmaṇeṣu pratiśrutā,
brāhmaṇaḥ kṣatriyo vaiśyaḥ śūdraścaiva raṇe yadi ॥12॥
5.178.13: brahmadviḍ bhavitā taṁ vai haniṣyāmīti bhārgava,
5.178.14: na śakṣyāmi parityāgaṁ kartuṁ jīvan kathañcana,
yaśca kr̥tsnaṁ raṇe kṣatraṁ vijeṣyati samāgatam ॥14॥
5.178.15: sa evaṁ vijayī rāma bhīṣmaḥ kurukulodvahaḥ,
5.178.16: tathaiva ca cariṣyāmi yathā sāmnaiva lapsyate ॥16॥
5.178.17: gamiṣyāmi svayaṁ tatra kanyāmādāya yatra saḥ ॥17॥
5.178.18: yadi bhīṣmo raṇaślāghī na kariṣyati me vacaḥ,
5.178.19: na hi bāṇā mayotsr̥ṣṭāḥ sajjantīha śarīriṇām,
5.178.21: tataste tāmuṣitvā tu rajanīṁ tatra tāpasāḥ,
5.178.24: kuru priyaṁ sa me rājan prāpto’smīti mahāvrataḥ ॥24॥
5.178.29: parāmr̥ṣṭāṁ tvayā hīmāṁ ko hi gantumihārhati ॥29॥
5.178.35: na kariṣyasi cedetad vākyaṁ me narapuṅgava ॥35॥
5.178.37: ayācaṁ bhr̥guśārdūlaṁ na caiva praśaśāma saḥ ॥37॥
5.178.38: abruvaṁ kāraṇaṁ kiṁ tad yat tvaṁ yuddhaṁ mayecchasi ॥38॥
