5.178.40: jānīṣe māṁ guruṁ bhīṣma gr̥hṇāsīmāṁ na caiva ha ॥40॥
5.178.41: na hi te vidyate śāntiranyathā kurunandana ॥41॥
5.178.43: naitadevaṁ punarbhāvi brahmarṣe kiṁ śrameṇa te ॥43॥
5.178.44: prasādaye tvāṁ bhagavaṁstyaktaiṣā tu purā mayā ॥44॥
5.178.45: ko jātu parabhāvāṁ hi nārīṁ vyālīmiva sthitām,
vāsayeta gr̥he jānan strīṇāṁ doṣo mahātyayaḥ ॥45॥
5.178.46: na bhayād vāsavasyāpi dharmaṁ jahyāṁ mahāvrata,
prasīda mā vā yad vā te kāryaṁ tat kuru mā ciram ॥46॥
5.178.47: ayaṁ cāpi viśuddhātman purāṇe śrūyate vibho,
5.178.49: sa tvaṁ gururiti premṇā mayā sammānito bhr̥śam,
guruvr̥ttiṁ na jānīṣe tasmād yotsyāmi vai tvayā ॥49॥
5.178.50: guruṁ na hanyāṁ samare brāhmaṇaṁ ca viśeṣataḥ,
5.178.52: brahmahatyā na tasya syāditi dharmeṣu niścayaḥ,
5.178.54: arthe vā yadi vā dharme samartho deśakālavit,
5.178.56: paśya me bāhuvīryaṁ ca vikramaṁ cātimānuṣam,
evaṁ gate’pi tu mayā yacchakyaṁ bhr̥gunandana ॥56॥
5.178.57: tat kariṣye kurukṣetre yotsye vipra tvayā saha,
dvandve rāma yatheṣṭaṁ me sajjībhava mahādyute ॥57॥
5.178.58: tatra tvaṁ nihato rāma mayā śaraśatārditaḥ,
5.178.60: api yatra tvayā rāma kr̥taṁ śaucaṁ purā pituḥ,
tatrāhamapi hatvā tvāṁ śaucaṁ kartāsmi bhārgava ॥60॥
5.178.62: yaccāpi katthase rāma bahuśaḥ pariṣatsu vai,
5.178.63: na tadā jātavān bhīṣmaḥ kṣatriyo vāpi madvidhaḥ,
5.178.64: yaste yuddhamayaṁ darpaṁ kāmaṁ ca vyapanāśayet,
vyapaneṣyāmi te darpaṁ yuddhe rāma na saṁśayaḥ ॥64॥
5.178.65: diṣṭyā bhīṣma mayā sārdhaṁ yoddhumicchasi saṅgare ॥65॥
5.178.66: ayaṁ gacchāmi kauravya kurukṣetraṁ tvayā saha,
5.178.67: tatra tvāṁ nihataṁ mātā mayā śaraśatācitam,
5.178.70: ehi gaccha mayā bhīṣma yuddhakāmuka durmada,
5.178.73: dvijātīn vācya puṇyāhaṁ svasti caiva mahādyute ॥73॥
5.178.81: gatvāhaṁ tat kurukṣetraṁ sa ca rāmaḥ pratāpavān,
5.178.84: vāditrāṇi ca divyāni meghavr̥ndāni caiva ha ॥84॥
5.178.86: mātā svarūpiṇī rājan kimidaṁ te cikīrṣitam ॥86॥
5.178.87: bhīṣmeṇa saha mā yotsīḥ śiṣyeṇeti punaḥ punaḥ ॥87॥
5.178.88: mā maivaṁ putra nirbandhaṁ kuru vipreṇa pārthiva,
5.178.91: yathā ca rāmo rājendra mayā pūrvaṁ pracoditaḥ,
5.178.92: tataḥ sā rāmamabhyetya jananī me mahānadī,
5.178.93: bhīṣmeṇa saha mā yotsīḥ śiṣyeṇeti vaco’bravīt,
sa ca tāmāha yācantīṁ bhīṣmameva nivartaya,
na ca me kurute kāmamityahaṁ tamupāgamam ॥93॥
5.178.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi ambopākhyānaparvaṇi paraśurāmabhīṣmayoḥ kurukṣetrāvataraṇe aṣṭasaptatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥178॥
5.179.2: āroha syandanaṁ vīra kavacaṁ ca mahābhuja,
badhāna samare rāma yadi yoddhuṁ mayecchasi ॥2॥
5.179.3: ratho me medinī bhīṣma vāhā vedāḥ sadaśvavat ॥3॥
5.179.5: evaṁ bruvāṇo gāndhāre rāmo māṁ satyavikramaḥ,
5.179.10: āhvayānaḥ sa māṁ yuddhe mano harṣayatīva me,
5.179.12: tato’haṁ bāṇapāteṣu triṣu vāhān nigr̥hya vai,
5.179.14: yotsye tvayā raṇe rāma sadr̥śenādhikena vā,
5.179.15: dharmo hyeṣa mahābāho viśiṣṭaiḥ saha yudhyatām ॥15॥
5.179.16: yudhyasva tvaṁ raṇe yatto dhairyamālambya kaurava ॥16॥
5.179.17: na tu te jayamāśāse tvāṁ vijetumahaṁ sthitaḥ,
gaccha yudhyasva dharmeṇa prīto’smi caritena te ॥17॥
5.179.19: tato yuddhaṁ samabhavanmama tasya ca bhārata,
5.179.20: sa me tasmin raṇe pūrvaṁ prāharat kaṅkapatribhiḥ,
5.179.23: ācāryatā mānitā me nirmaryāde hyapi tvayi,
bhūyaśca śr̥ṇu me brahman sampadaṁ dharmasaṅgrahe ॥23॥
5.179.24: ye te vedāḥ śarīrasthā brāhmaṇyaṁ yacca te mahat,
tapaśca te mahat taptaṁ na tebhyaḥ praharāmyaham ॥24॥
5.179.25: prahare kṣatradharmasya yaṁ rāma tvaṁ samāśritaḥ,
5.179.26: paśya me dhanuṣo vīryaṁ paśya bāhvorbalaṁ mama,
eṣa te kārmukaṁ vīra chinadmi niśiteṣuṇā ॥26॥
5.179.29: celuḥ kṣaranto rudhiraṁ nāgā iva ca te śarāḥ ॥29॥
5.179.31: babhau rāmastathā rājan praphulla iva kiṁśukaḥ ॥31॥
5.179.33: te samāsādya māṁ raudrā bahudhā marmabhedinaḥ,
5.179.37: aho bata kr̥taṁ pāpaṁ meyadaṁ kṣatradharmaṇā ॥37॥
5.179.38: tato na prāharaṁ bhūyo jāmadagnyāya bhārata ॥38॥
5.179.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi ambopākhyānaparvaṇi rāmabhīṣmayuddhe ekonāśītyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥179॥
5.180.1: ātmanastu tataḥ sūto hayānāṁ ca viśāmpate,
5.180.3: dr̥ṣṭvā māṁ tūrṇamāyāntaṁ daṁśitaṁ syandane sthitam,
5.180.6: sa ca māṁ śaravarṣeṇa varṣantaṁ samavākirat ॥6॥
5.180.10: tato divi mahān nādaḥ prādurāsīt samantataḥ ॥10॥
5.180.11: pratyājaghne ca tad rāmo guhyakāstreṇa bhārata ॥11॥
5.180.12: vāruṇenaiva tad rāmo vārayāmāsa me vibhuḥ ॥12॥
5.180.14: tato māṁ savyato rājan rāmaḥ kurvan dvijottamaḥ,
5.180.18: yāhi sūta yato rāmaḥ sajjo’haṁ gatavedanaḥ ॥18॥
5.180.22: tataste sūditāḥ sarve mama bāṇāḥ susaṁśitāḥ,
5.180.23: tataḥ punaḥ śaraṁ dīptaṁ suprabhaṁ kālasammitam,
5.180.24: mumoha samare rāmo bhūmau ca nipapāta ha ॥24॥
5.180.28: tataḥ sa vihvalaṁ vākyaṁ rāma utthāya cābravīt,
tiṣṭha bhīṣma hato’sīti bāṇaṁ sandhāya kārmuke ॥28॥
5.180.29: sa mukto nyapatat tūrṇaṁ savye pārśve mahāhave,
5.180.33: tato vāyoḥ prakampācca sūryasya ca gabhastibhiḥ ॥33॥
5.180.35: bhūmau sarve tadā rājan bhasmabhūtāḥ prapedire,
5.180.36: rāmaḥ śarāṇāṁ saṅkruddho mayi tūrṇaṁ nyapātayat ॥36॥
5.180.38: sandhyākāle vyatīte tu vyapāyāt sa ca me guruḥ ॥38॥
5.180.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi ambopākhyānaparvaṇi rāmabhīṣmayuddhe aśītyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥180॥
5.181.2: ayojayat sa dharmātmā divase divase vibhuḥ ॥2॥
5.182.1: tataḥ prabhāte rājendra sūrye vimalatāṁ gate,
5.182.2: tato’bhrānte rathe tiṣṭhan rāmaḥ praharatāṁ varaḥ,
5.182.5: muhūrtādiva rājendra māṁ ca bhīrāviśat tadā ॥5॥
5.182.6: tataḥ sūte hate tasmin kṣipatastasya me śarān,
5.182.7: tataḥ sūtavyasaninaṁ viplutaṁ māṁ sa bhārgavaḥ,
5.182.8: sa me bhujāntare rājan nipatya rudhirāśanaḥ,
5.182.9: matvā tu nihataṁ rāmastato māṁ bharatarṣabha,
5.182.10: tathā tu patite rājan mayi rāmo mudā yutaḥ,
5.182.11: mama tatrābhavan ye tu kuravaḥ pārśvataḥ sthitāḥ,
ārtiṁ paramikāṁ jagmuste tadā patite mayi ॥11॥
5.182.15: mā bhairiti samaṁ sarve svasti te’stviti cāsakr̥t,
5.182.17: rarakṣa sā māṁ sarathaṁ hayāṁścopaskarāṇi ca,
5.182.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi ambopākhyānaparvaṇi rāmabhīṣmayuddhe dvyaśītyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥182॥
5.183.1: tato’haṁ niśi rājendra praṇamya śirasā tadā,
brāhmaṇānāṁ pitr̥̄ṇāṁ ca devatānāṁ ca sarvaśaḥ ॥1॥
5.183.4: na ca rāmaṁ mahāvīryaṁ śaknomi raṇamūrdhani,
5.183.5: yadi śakyo mayā jetuṁ jāmadagnyaḥ pratāpavān,
5.183.6: tato niśi ca rājendra prasuptaḥ śaravikṣataḥ,
5.183.7: utthāpito dhr̥taścaiva mā bhairiti ca sāntvitaḥ ॥7॥
5.183.8: ta eva māṁ mahārāja svapnadarśanametya vai,
5.183.9: uttiṣṭha mā bhairgāṅgeya na bhayaṁ te’sti kiñcana,
rakṣāmahe tvāṁ kauravya svaśarīraṁ hi no bhavān ॥9॥
5.183.10: na tvāṁ rāmo raṇe jetā jāmadagnyaḥ kathañcana,
5.183.12: na hīdaṁ veda rāmo’pi pr̥thivyāṁ vā pumān kvacit ॥12॥
5.183.13: tat smarasva mahābāho bhr̥śaṁ saṁyojayasva ca,
5.183.14: na ca rāmaḥ kṣayaṁ gantā tenāstreṇa narādhipa ॥14॥
5.183.15: enasā na tu saṁyogaṁ prāpsyase jātu mānada,
5.183.17: prasuptaṁ vā mr̥taṁ veti tulyaṁ manyāmahe vayam ॥17॥
5.183.18: na ca rāmeṇa martavyaṁ kadācidapi pārthiva,
5.183.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi ambopākhyānaparvaṇi bhīṣmaprasvāpanāstralābhe tryaśītyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥183॥
5.184.2: tataḥ samabhavad yuddhaṁ mama tasya ca bhārata,
5.184.3: tato bāṇamayaṁ varṣaṁ vavarṣa mayi bhārgavaḥ,
5.184.4: hyastanena ca kopena śaktiṁ vai prāhiṇonmayi ॥4॥
5.184.11: sa vakṣasi papātograḥ śaro vyāla iva śvasan,
5.184.12: samprāpya tu punaḥ sañjñāṁ jāmadagnyāya dhīmate,
5.184.14: tata enaṁ pariṣvajya sakhā vipro mahātapāḥ,
5.184.17: asamprāpyaiva rāmaṁ ca māṁ ca bhāratasattama ॥17॥
5.184.18: tato vyomni prādurabhūt teja eva hi kevalam,
5.184.21: prajajvāla nabho rājan dhūmāyante diśo daśa,
5.184.23: vicitraṁ ca tadastraṁ me manasi pratyabhāt tadā ॥23॥
5.184.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi ambopākhyānaparvaṇi parasparabrahmāstraprayoge caturaśītyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥184॥
5.185.3: ete viyati kauravya divi devagaṇāḥ sthitāḥ,
te tvāṁ nivārayantyadya prasvāpaṁ mā prayojaya ॥3॥
5.185.4: tasyāvamānaṁ kauravya mā sma kārṣīḥ kathañcana ॥4॥
5.185.10: mā smaivaṁ sāhasaṁ tāta punaḥ kārṣīḥ kathañcana,
5.185.11: kṣatriyasya tu dharmo’yaṁ yad yuddhaṁ bhr̥gunandana,
5.185.16: rāmeṇa saha mā yotsīrguruṇeti punaḥ punaḥ,
na hi rāmo raṇe jetuṁ tvayā nyāyyaḥ kurūdvaha ॥16॥
5.185.17: vayaṁ tu guravastubhyaṁ tasmāt tvāṁ vārayāmahe ॥17॥
5.185.25: mama vratamidaṁ loke nāhaṁ yuddhāt kadācana ॥25॥
5.185.27: tyajeyaṁ śāśvataṁ dharmamiti me niścitā matiḥ,
5.185.28: bhāgīrathī ca me mātā raṇamadhyaṁ prapedire,
5.185.29: nāvanītaṁ hi hr̥dayaṁ viprāṇāṁ śāmya bhārgava ॥29॥
5.185.30: avadhyo vai tvayā bhīṣmastvaṁ ca bhīṣmasya bhārgava ॥30॥
5.185.33: te māṁ sapraṇayaṁ vākyamabruvan samare sthitam,
praihi rāmaṁ mahābāho guruṁ lokahitaṁ kuru ॥33॥
5.185.34: dr̥ṣṭvā nivartitaṁ rāma suhr̥dvākyena tena vai,
5.185.37: mama caiva samakṣaṁ tāṁ kanyāmāhūya bhārgavaḥ,
uktavān dīnayā vācā madhye teṣāṁ mahātmanām ॥37॥
5.185.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi ambopākhyānaparvaṇi yuddhanivr̥ttau pañcāśītyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥185॥
5.186.1: yathāśaktyā mayā yuddhaṁ kr̥taṁ vai pauruṣaṁ param ॥1॥
5.186.2: na caivamapi śaknomi bhīṣmaṁ śastrabhr̥tāṁ varam,
5.186.3: eṣā me paramā śaktiretanme paramaṁ balam,
yatheṣṭaṁ gamyatāṁ bhadre kimanyad vā karomi te ॥3॥
5.186.4: bhīṣmameva prapadyasva na te’nyā vidyate gatiḥ,
5.186.7: yathāśakti yathotsāhaṁ mama kāryaṁ kr̥taṁ tvayā,
5.186.9: gamiṣyāmi tu tatrāhaṁ yatra bhīṣmaṁ tapodhana,
5.186.10: tāpasye dhr̥tasaṅkalpā sā me cintayatī vadham ॥10॥
5.186.13: yathāvr̥ttaṁ mahārāja sā ca māṁ pratyanandata,
5.186.14: pratyāharaṁśca me yuktāḥ sthitāḥ priyahite sadā ॥14॥
5.186.15: yadaiva hi vanaṁ prāyāt sā kanyā tapase dhr̥tā,
5.186.16: na hi māṁ kṣatriyaḥ kaścid vīryeṇa vyajayad yudhi,
5.186.17: vyāse caiva tathā kāryaṁ tau cobhau māmavocatām ॥17॥
5.186.18: na viṣādastvayā kāryo bhīṣma kāśisutāṁ prati,
5.186.26: cavanasyāśrame caiva brahmaṇaḥ sthāna eva ca ॥26॥
5.186.30: tāmabravīcca kauravya mama mātā jale sthitā,
kimarthaṁ kliśyase bhadre tathyameva vadasva me ॥30॥
5.186.33: vicarāmi mahīṁ devi yathā hanyāmahaṁ nr̥pam,
etad vrataphalaṁ devi paramasmin yathā hi me ॥33॥
5.186.35: yadi bhīṣmavināśāya kāśye carasi vai vratam,
vratasthā ca śarīraṁ tvaṁ yadi nāma vimokṣyasi ॥35॥
5.186.36: dustīrthā na tu vijñeyā vārṣikī nāṣṭamāsikī ॥36॥
5.186.40: sā nadī vatsabhūmyāṁ tu prathitāmbeti bhārata,
5.186.41: sā kanyā tapasā tena dehārdhena vyajāyata,
nadī ca rājan vatseṣu kanyā caivābhavat tadā ॥41॥
5.186.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi ambopākhyānaparvaṇi ambātapasyāyāṁ ṣaḍaśītyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥186॥
5.187.3: vadhārthaṁ tasya dīkṣā me na lokārthaṁ tapodhanāḥ,
5.187.4: patilokād vihīnā ca naiva strī na pumāniha ॥4॥
5.187.5: eṣa me hr̥di saṅkalpo yadidaṁ kathitaṁ mayā ॥5॥
5.187.6: bhīṣme praticikīrṣāmi nāsmi vāryeti vai punaḥ ॥6॥
5.187.7: madhye teṣāṁ maharṣīṇāṁ svena rūpeṇa tāpasīm ॥7॥
5.187.9: tataḥ sā punarevātha kanyā rudramuvāca ha,
upapadyeta kathaṁ deva striyā yudhi jayo mama ॥9॥
5.187.10: strībhāvena ca me gāḍhaṁ manaḥ śāntamumāpate,
5.187.11: yathā sa satyo bhavati tathā kuru vr̥ṣadhvaja,
yathā hanyāṁ samāgamya bhīṣmaṁ śāntanavaṁ yudhi ॥11॥
5.187.12: na me vāganr̥taṁ prāha satyaṁ bhadre bhaviṣyati ॥12॥
5.187.13: haniṣyasi raṇe bhīṣmaṁ puruṣatvaṁ ca lapsyase,
smariṣyasi ca tat sarvaṁ dehamanyaṁ gatā satī ॥13॥
5.187.18: citāṁ kr̥tvā sumahatīṁ pradāya ca hutāśanam,
5.187.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi ambopākhyānaparvaṇi ambāhutāśanapraveśe saptāśītyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥187॥
5.188.1: kathaṁ śikhaṇḍī gāṅgeya kanyā bhūtvā purā tadā,
5.188.2: bhāryā tu tasya rājendra drupadasya mahīpateḥ,
5.188.3: etasminneva kāle tu drupado vai mahīpatiḥ,
5.188.4: r̥te kanyāṁ mahādeva putro me syāditi bruvan ॥4॥
5.188.6: sa tu gatvā ca nagaraṁ bhāryāmidamuvāca ha ॥6॥
5.188.7: kanyā bhūtvā pumān bhāvī iti cokto’smi śambhunā ॥7॥
5.188.8: na tadanyacca bhavitā bhavitavyaṁ hi tat tathā ॥8॥
5.188.9: tataḥ sā niyatā bhūtvā r̥tukāle manasvinī,
5.188.11: tato dadhāra sā devī garbhaṁ rājīvalocanā,
tāṁ sa rājā priyāṁ bhāryāṁ drupadaḥ kurunandana ॥11॥
5.188.13: yathākālaṁ tu sā devī mahiṣī drupadasya ha ॥13॥
5.188.14: aputrasya tu rājñaḥ sā drupadasya manasvinī ॥14॥
5.188.15: khyāpayāmāsa rājendra putro hyeṣa mameti vai,
tataḥ sa rājā drupadaḥ pracchannāyā narādhipa ॥15॥
5.188.16: rakṣaṇaṁ caiva mantrasya mahiṣī drupadasya sā ॥16॥
5.188.17: na ca tāṁ veda nagare kaścidanyatra pārṣatāt ॥17॥
5.188.18: chādayāmāsa tāṁ kanyā pumāniti ca so’bravīt ॥18॥
5.188.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi ambopākhyānaparvaṇi śikhaṇḍyutpattau aṣṭāśītyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥188॥
5.189.1: tato lekhyādiṣu tathā śilpeṣu ca parantapa ॥1॥
5.189.2: iṣvastrai caiva rājendra droṇaśiṣyo babhūva ha,
5.189.3: striyaṁ matvā tataścintāṁ prapede saha bhāryayā ॥3॥
5.189.6: yadi te rocate rājan vakṣyāmi śr̥ṇu me vacaḥ,
5.189.7: bhavitā tadvacaḥ satyamiti me niścitā matiḥ ॥7॥
5.189.8: tatastau niścayaṁ kr̥tvā tasmin kārye’tha dampatī,
5.189.10: sa ca prādānmahīpālaḥ kanyāṁ tasmai śikhaṇḍine ॥10॥
5.189.11: sa ca rājā daśārṇeṣu mahānāsīt sudurjayaḥ,
5.189.12: kr̥te vivāhe tu tadā sā kanyā rājasattama,
yauvanaṁ samanuprāptā sā ca kanyā śikhaṇḍinī ॥12॥
5.189.13: tataḥ sā veda tāṁ kanyāṁ kañcit kālaṁ striyaṁ kila ॥13॥
5.189.14: hiraṇyavarmaṇaḥ kanyā jñātvā tāṁ tu śikhaṇḍinīm,
dhātrīṇāṁ ca sakhīnāṁ ca vrīḍamānā nyavedayat,
kanyāṁ pañcālarājasya sutāṁ tāṁ vai śikhaṇḍinīm ॥14॥
5.189.16: vipralambhaṁ yathāvr̥ttaṁ sa ca cukrodha pārthivaḥ ॥16॥
5.189.22: avamanyase māṁ nr̥pate nūnaṁ durmantritaṁ tava,
5.189.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi ambopākhyānaparvaṇi hiraṇyavarmadūtāgamane ekonanavatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥189॥
5.190.3: sa rājā bhūya evātha jñātvā tattvamathāgamat,
5.190.5: abhiyāne matiṁ cakre drupadaṁ prati bhārata ॥5॥
5.190.7: tatra vai niścitaṁ teṣāmabhūd rājñāṁ mahātmanām,
tathyaṁ bhavati cedetat kanyā rājan śikhaṇḍinī ॥7॥
5.190.11: sa hi prakr̥tyā vai bhītaḥ kilviṣī ca narādhipaḥ,
5.190.17: kimatra tathyaṁ suśroṇi mithyā kiṁ brūhi śobhane,
śrutvā tvattaḥ śubhaṁ vākyaṁ saṁvidhāsyāmyahaṁ tathā ॥17॥
5.190.18: ahaṁ hi saṁśayaṁ prāpto bālā ceyaṁ śikhaṇḍinī,
tvaṁ ca rājñi mahat kr̥cchraṁ samprāptā varavarṇini ॥18॥
5.190.20: śikhaṇḍini ca mā bhaistvaṁ vidhāsye tatra tattvataḥ,
5.190.21: mayā dāśārṇako rājā vañcitaḥ sa mahīpatiḥ,
5.190.22: jānatā hi narendreṇa khyāpanārthaṁ parasya vai,
5.190.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi ambopākhyānaparvaṇi drupadapraśne navatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥190॥
5.191.2: kanyā śikhaṇḍinī jātā puruṣo vai niveditā ॥2॥
5.191.4: bhāryā coḍhā tvayā rājan daśārṇādhipateḥ sutā,
5.191.8: ārtiṁ ca paramāṁ rājā jagāma saha bhāryayā,
5.191.9: kathaṁ sambandhinā sārdhaṁ na me svād vigraho mahān,
5.191.10: taṁ tu dr̥ṣṭvā tadā rājan devī devaparaṁ tadā,
5.191.13: ayuddhena nivr̥ttiṁ ca manasā cintaya prabho,
5.191.15: daivaṁ hi mānuṣopetaṁ bhr̥śaṁ siddhyati pārthiva,
5.191.16: tasmād vidhāya nagare vidhānaṁ sacivaiḥ saha,
5.191.19: evaṁ sā niścayaṁ kr̥tvā bhr̥śaṁ śokaparāyaṇā,
nirjagāma gr̥haṁ tyaktvā gahanaṁ nirjanaṁ vanam ॥19॥
5.191.20: tadbhayādeva ca jano visarjayati tad vanam ॥20॥
5.191.22: tat praviśya śikhaṇḍī sā drupadasyātmajā nr̥pa,
5.191.23: kimartho’yaṁ tavārambhaḥ kariṣye brūhi mā ciram ॥23॥
5.191.24: aśakyamiti sā yakṣaṁ punaḥ punaruvāca ha,
5.191.25: adeyamapi dāsyāmi brūhi yat te vivakṣitam ॥25॥
5.191.27: aputro me pitā yakṣa na cirānnāśameṣyati,
5.191.28: tasmād rakṣasva māṁ yakṣa mātaraṁ pitaraṁ ca me ॥28॥
5.191.30: yāvadeva sa rājā vai nopayāti puraṁ mama,
5.191.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi ambopākhyānaparvaṇi sthūṇākarṇasamāgame ekanavatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥191॥
5.192.2: bhavitavyaṁ tathā taddhi mama duḥkhāya kaurava,
bhadre kāmaṁ kariṣyāmi samayaṁ tu nibodha me ॥2॥
5.192.2d1: svaṁ te puṁstvaṁ pradāsyāmi strītvaṁ dhārayitāsmi te,
5.192.3: kiñcit kālāntare dāsye pum̐lliṅgaṁ svamidaṁ tava,
āgantavyaṁ tvayā kāle satyaṁ caiva vadasva me ॥3॥
5.192.4: matprasādāt puraṁ caiva trāhi bandhūṁśca kevalam ॥4॥
5.192.5: satyaṁ me pratijānīhi kariṣyāmi priyaṁ tava ॥5॥
5.192.8: ityuktvā samayaṁ tatra cakrāte tāvubhau nr̥pa,
5.192.9: yakṣarūpaṁ ca tad dīptaṁ śikhaṇḍī pratyapadyata ॥9॥
5.192.10: viveśa nagaraṁ hr̥ṣṭaḥ pitaraṁ ca samāsadat ॥10॥
5.192.11: yathāvr̥ttaṁ tu tat sarvamācakhyau drupadasya tat,
5.192.13: puruṣo’yaṁ mama sutaḥ śraddhattāṁ me bhavāniti,
5.192.15: brūhi madvacanād dūta pāñcālyaṁ taṁ nr̥pādhamam ॥15॥
5.192.18: tasmai pāñcālako rājā gāmarghyaṁ ca susatkr̥tam ॥18॥
5.192.19: tāṁ pūjāṁ nābhyanandat sa vākyaṁ cedamuvāca ha ॥19॥
5.192.21: tasya pāpasya karaṇāt phalaṁ prāpnuhi durmate,
5.192.24: yadāha māṁ bhavān brahman sambandhivacanād vacaḥ,
5.192.26: tad vākyamādade rājan yaduktaṁ drupadena ha ॥26॥
5.192.27: āgamaḥ kriyatāṁ vyaktaḥ kumāro’yaṁ suto mama,
5.192.30: tataḥ kr̥tvā tu rājā sa āgamaṁ prītimānatha,
5.192.31: śikhaṇḍine ca muditaḥ prādād vittaṁ janeśvaraḥ,
5.192.36: tat sthānaṁ tasya dr̥ṣṭvā tu sarvataḥ samalaṅkr̥tam,
5.192.38: nopasarpati māṁ caiva kasmādadya sa mandadhīḥ ॥38॥
5.192.39: tasmāt tasmai mahādaṇḍo dhāryaḥ syāditi me matiḥ ॥39॥
5.192.40: drupadasya sutā rājan rājño jātā śikhaṇḍinī,
5.192.42: etasmāt kāraṇād rājan sthūṇo na tvādya sarpati,
5.192.43: kartāsmi nigrahaṁ tasya pratyuvāca punaḥ punaḥ ॥43॥
5.192.47: tasmādadya prabhr̥tyeva strī tvaṁ sā puruṣastathā ॥47॥
5.192.50: śikhaṇḍini hate yakṣāḥ svaṁ rūpaṁ pratipatsyate,
5.192.52: sthūṇastu śāpaṁ samprāpya tatraiva nyavasat tadā,
samaye cāgamat tūrṇaṁ śikhaṇḍī taṁ kṣapācaram ॥52॥
5.192.53: tamabravīt tataḥ sthūṇaḥ prīto’smīti punaḥ punaḥ ॥53॥
5.192.56: gamanaṁ tava ceto hi paulastyasya ca darśanam ॥56॥
5.192.59: mudaṁ ca paramāṁ lebhe pāñcālyaḥ saha bāndhavaiḥ ॥59॥
5.192.68: etat tattvamahaṁ veda janma tāta śikhaṇḍinaḥ,
5.192.69: yadi bhīṣmaḥ striyaṁ hanyāt santaḥ kuryurvigarhaṇam,
5.192.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi ambopākhyānaparvaṇi śikhaṇḍipuṁstvaprāptau dvinavatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥192॥
5.193.5: ācāryo vā maheṣvāsaḥ kr̥po vā sumahābalaḥ ॥5॥
5.193.6: divyāstraviduṣaḥ sarve bhavanto hi bale mama ॥6॥
5.193.7: etadicchāmyahaṁ jñātuṁ paraṁ kautūhalaṁ hi me,
5.193.9: śr̥ṇu rājan mama raṇe yā śaktiḥ paramā bhavet,
5.193.11: divase divase kr̥tvā bhāgaṁ prāgāhnikaṁ mama ॥11॥
5.193.14: muñceyaṁ yadi vāstrāṇi mahānti samare sthitaḥ,
5.193.15: śrutvā bhīṣmasya tad vākyaṁ rājā duryodhanastataḥ,
5.193.16: nihanyā iti taṁ droṇaḥ pratyuvāca hasanniva ॥16॥
5.193.18: eṣā me paramā śaktiretanme paramaṁ balam ॥18॥
5.193.21: jahāsa sasvanaṁ hāsaṁ vākyaṁ cedamuvāca ha,
na hi yāvad raṇe pārthaṁ bāṇaśaṅkhadhanurdharam ॥21॥
5.193.22: śakyamevaṁ ca bhūyaśca tvayā vaktuṁ yatheṣṭataḥ ॥22॥
5.193.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi ambopākhyānaparvaṇi bhīṣmādiśaktikathane trinavatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāya ॥193॥
5.194.2: te pravr̥ttiṁ prayacchanti mamemāṁ vyuṣitāṁ niśām ॥2॥
5.194.3: kena kālena pāṇḍūnāṁ hanyāḥ sainyamiti prabho ॥3॥
5.194.10: apaitu te manastāpo yathā satyaṁ bravīmyaham,
5.194.11: bhūtaṁ bhavyaṁ bhaviṣyaṁ ca nimeṣāditi me matiḥ ॥11॥
5.194.12: yat tad ghoraṁ paśupatiḥ prādādastraṁ mahanmama,
kairāte dvandvayuddhe tu tadidaṁ mayi vartate ॥12॥
5.194.14: tanna jānāti gāṅgeyo na droṇo na ca gautamaḥ,
na ca droṇasuto rājan kuta eva tu sūtajaḥ ॥14॥
5.194.15: na tu yuktaṁ raṇe hantuṁ divyairastraiḥ pr̥thagjanam,
5.194.22: sa kṣipraṁ na bhaved vyaktamiti tvāṁ vedmi kaurava ॥22॥
5.194.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi ambopākhyānaparvaṇi arjunavākye caturnavatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥194॥
5.195.13: na viśeṣaṁ vijānanti purasya śibirasya vā,
5.195.19: vaṇijo gaṇikāścārā ye caiva prekṣakā janāḥ,
5.195.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi ambopākhyānaparvaṇi kauravasainyaniryāṇe pañcanavatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥195॥
5.196.9: bhīmaṁ ca yuyudhānaṁ ca pāṇḍavaṁ ca dhanañjayam,
5.196.15: ayutaṁ ca padātīnāṁ rathāḥ pañcaśataṁ tathā ॥15॥
5.196.16: madhyame ca virāṭaṁ ca jayatsenaṁ ca pāṇḍavaḥ ॥16॥
5.196.26: phalgu sarvaṁ kalatraṁ ca yatkiñcit kr̥śadurbalam ॥26॥
5.196.28: śreṇimān vasudānaśca putraḥ kāśyasya vā vibhuḥ ॥28॥
5.196.33: evaṁ tasya balaṁ bhīmaṁ kuntīputrasya dhīmataḥ,
5.196.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate udyogaparvaṇi ambopākhyānaparvaṇi pāṇḍavasenāniryāṇe ṣaṇṇavatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥196॥
